1.zh: 以下所记的是摩西在约但河东的旷野 、 疏弗对面的亚拉巴 ─ 就是巴兰 、 陀弗 、 拉班 、 哈洗录 、 底撒哈中间 ─ 向以色列众人所说的话。
1.en: These are the words Moses spoke to all Israel in the desert east of the Jordan-that is, in the Arabah-opposite Suph, between Paran and Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth and Dizahab.

1.zh: 从何烈山经过西珥山到加低斯巴尼亚有十一天的路程。）
1.en: (It takes eleven days to go from Horeb to Kadesh Barnea by the Mount Seir road.)

1.zh: 出埃及第四十年十一月初一日，摩西照耶和华藉著他所吩咐以色列人的话都晓谕他们。
1.en: In the fortieth year, on the first day of the eleventh month, Moses proclaimed to the Israelites all that the Lord had commanded him concerning them.

1.zh: 那时，他已经击杀了住希实本的亚摩利王西宏和住以得来 、 亚斯他录的巴珊王噩。
1.en: This was after he had defeated Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, and at Edrei had defeated Og king of Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth.

1.zh: 摩西在约但河东的摩押地讲律法说：
1.en: East of the Jordan in the territory of Moab, Moses began to expound this law, saying:

1.zh: 耶和华 ─ 我们的神在何烈山晓谕我们说：你们在这山上住的日子够了；
1.en: The Lord our God said to us at Horeb, "You have stayed long enough at this mountain.

1.zh: 要起行转到亚摩利人的山地和靠近这山地的各处，就是亚拉巴 、 山地 、 高原 、 南地，沿海一带迦南人的地，并利巴嫩山又到伯拉大河。
1.en: Break camp and advance into the hill country of the Amorites; go to all the neighboring peoples in the Arabah, in the mountains, in the western foothills, in the Negev and along the coast, to the land of the Canaanites and to Lebanon, as far as the great river, the Euphrates.

1.zh: 如今我将这地摆在你们面前；你们要进去得这地，就是耶和华向你们列祖亚伯拉罕 、 以撒 、 雅各起誓应许赐给他们和他们后裔为业之地。
1.en: See, I have given you this land. Go in and take possession of the land that the Lord swore he would give to your fathers-to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob-and to their descendants after them."

1.zh: 那时，我对你们说：管理你们的重任，我独自担当不起。
1.en: At that time I said to you, "You are too heavy a burden for me to carry alone.

1.zh: 耶和华 ─ 你们的神使你们多起来。看哪，你们今日像天上的星那样多。
1.en: The Lord your God has increased your numbers so that today you are as many as the stars in the sky.

1.zh: 惟愿耶和华 ─ 你们列祖的神使你们比如今更多千倍，照他所应许你们的话赐福与你们。
1.en: May the Lord , the God of your fathers, increase you a thousand times and bless you as he has promised!

1.zh: 但你们的麻烦，和管理你们的重任，并你们的争讼，我独自一人怎能担当得起呢？
1.en: But how can I bear your problems and your burdens and your disputes all by myself?

1.zh: 你们要按著各支派选举有智慧 、 有见识 、 为众人所认识的，我立他们为你们的首领。
1.en: Choose some wise, understanding and respected men from each of your tribes, and I will set them over you."

1.zh: 你们回答我说：照你所说的行了为妙。
1.en: You answered me, "What you propose to do is good."

1.zh: 我便将你们各支派的首领，有智慧 、 为众人所认识的，照你们的支派，立他们为官长 、 千夫长 、 百夫长 、 五十夫长 、 十夫长，管理你们。
1.en: So I took the leading men of your tribes, wise and respected men, and appointed them to have authority over you-as commanders of thousands, of hundreds, of fifties and of tens and as tribal officials.

1.zh: 当时，我嘱咐你们的审判官说：你们听讼，无论是弟兄彼此争讼，是与同居的外人争讼，都要按公义判断。
1.en: And I charged your judges at that time: Hear the disputes between your brothers and judge fairly, whether the case is between brother Israelites or between one of them and an alien.

1.zh: 审判的时候，不可看人的外貌；听讼不可分贵贱，不可惧怕人，因为审判是属乎神的。若有难断的案件，可以呈到我这里，我就判断。
1.en: Do not show partiality in judging; hear both small and great alike. Do not be afraid of any man, for judgment belongs to God. Bring me any case too hard for you, and I will hear it.

1.zh: 那时，我将你们所当行的事都吩咐你们了。
1.en: And at that time I told you everything you were to do.

1.zh: 我们照著耶和华 ─ 我们神所吩咐的从何烈山起行，经过你们所看见那大而可怕的旷野，往亚摩利人的山地去，到了加低斯巴尼亚。
1.en: Then, as the Lord our God commanded us, we set out from Horeb and went toward the hill country of the Amorites through all that vast and dreadful desert that you have seen, and so we reached Kadesh Barnea.

1.zh: 我对你们说：你们已经到了耶和华 ─ 我们神所赐给我们的亚摩利人之山地。
1.en: Then I said to you, "You have reached the hill country of the Amorites, which the Lord our God is giving us.

1.zh: 看哪，耶和华 ─ 你的神已将那地摆在你面前，你要照耶和华 ─ 你列祖的神所说的上去得那地为业；不要惧怕，也不要惊惶。
1.en: See, the Lord your God has given you the land. Go up and take possession of it as the Lord , the God of your fathers, told you. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged."

1.zh: 你们都就近我来说：我们要先打发人去，为我们窥探那地，将我们上去该走何道，必进何城，都回报我们。
1.en: Then all of you came to me and said, "Let us send men ahead to spy out the land for us and bring back a report about the route we are to take and the towns we will come to."

1.zh: 这话我以为美，就从你们中间选了十二个人，每支派一人。
1.en: The idea seemed good to me; so I selected twelve of you, one man from each tribe.

1.zh: 于是他们起身上山地去，到以实各谷，窥探那地。
1.en: They left and went up into the hill country, and came to the Valley of Eshcol and explored it.

1.zh: 他们手里拿著那地的果子下来，到我们那里，回报说：耶和华 ─ 我们的神所赐给我们的是美地。
1.en: Taking with them some of the fruit of the land, they brought it down to us and reported, "It is a good land that the Lord our God is giving us."

1.zh: 你们却不肯上去，竟违背了耶和华 ─ 你们神的命令，
1.en: But you were unwilling to go up; you rebelled against the command of the Lord your God.

1.zh: 在帐棚内发怨言说：耶和华因为恨我们，所以将我们从埃及地领出来，要交在亚摩利人手中，除灭我们。
1.en: You grumbled in your tents and said, "The Lord hates us; so he brought us out of Egypt to deliver us into the hands of the Amorites to destroy us.

1.zh: 我们上那里去呢？我们的弟兄使我们的心消化，说那地的民比我们又大又高，城邑又广大又坚固，高得顶天，并且我们在那里看见亚衲族的人。
1.en: Where can we go? Our brothers have made us lose heart. They say, 'The people are stronger and taller than we are; the cities are large, with walls up to the sky. We even saw the Anakites there.' "

1.zh: 我就对你们说：不要惊恐，也不要怕他们。
1.en: Then I said to you, "Do not be terrified; do not be afraid of them.

1.zh: 在你们前面行的耶和华 ─ 你们的神必为你们争战，正如他在埃及和旷野，在你们眼前所行的一样。
1.en: The Lord your God, who is going before you, will fight for you, as he did for you in Egypt, before your very eyes,

1.zh: 你们在旷野所行的路上，也曾见耶和华 ─ 你们的神抚养你们，如同人抚养儿子一般，直等你们来到这地方。
1.en: and in the desert. There you saw how the Lord your God carried you, as a father carries his son, all the way you went until you reached this place."

1.zh: 你们在这事上却不信耶和华 ─ 你们的神。
1.en: In spite of this, you did not trust in the Lord your God,

1.zh: 他在路上，在你们前面行，为你们找安营的地方；夜间在火柱里，日间在云柱里，指示你们所当行的路。
1.en: who went ahead of you on your journey, in fire by night and in a cloud by day, to search out places for you to camp and to show you the way you should go.

1.zh: 耶和华听见你们这话，就发怒，起誓说：
1.en: When the Lord heard what you said, he was angry and solemnly swore:

1.zh: 这恶世代的人，连一个也不得见我起誓应许赐给你们列祖的美地；
1.en: "Not a man of this evil generation shall see the good land I swore to give your forefathers,

1.zh: 惟有耶孚尼的儿子迦勒必得看见，并且我要将他所踏过的地 { 赐给他和他的子孙，因为他专心跟从我。
1.en: except Caleb son of Jephunneh. He will see it, and I will give him and his descendants the land he set his feet on, because he followed the Lord wholeheartedly."

1.zh: 耶和华为你们的缘故也向我发怒，说：你必不得进入那地。
1.en: Because of you the Lord became angry with me also and said, "You shall not enter it, either.

1.zh: 伺候你 、 嫩的儿子约书亚，他必得进入那地；你要勉励他，因为他要使以色列人承受那地为业。
1.en: But your assistant, Joshua son of Nun, will enter it. Encourage him, because he will lead Israel to inherit it.

1.zh: 并且你们的妇人孩子，就是你们所说 、 必被掳掠的，和今日不知善恶的儿女，必进入那地。我要将那地赐给他们，他们必得为业。
1.en: And the little ones that you said would be taken captive, your children who do not yet know good from bad-they will enter the land. I will give it to them and they will take possession of it.

1.zh: 至于你们，要转回，从红海的路往旷野去。
1.en: But as for you, turn around and set out toward the desert along the route to the Red Sea. "

1.zh: 那时，你们回答我说：我们得罪了耶和华，情愿照耶和华 ─ 我们神一切所吩咐的上去争战。于是你们各人带著兵器，争先上山地去了。
1.en: Then you replied, "We have sinned against the Lord . We will go up and fight, as the Lord our God commanded us." So every one of you put on his weapons, thinking it easy to go up into the hill country.

1.zh: 耶和华吩咐我说：你对他们说：不要上去，也不要争战；因我不在你们中间，恐怕你们被仇敌杀败了。
1.en: But the Lord said to me, "Tell them, 'Do not go up and fight, because I will not be with you. You will be defeated by your enemies.' "

1.zh: 我就告诉了你们，你们却不听从，竟违背耶和华的命令，擅自上山地去了。
1.en: So I told you, but you would not listen. You rebelled against the Lord 's command and in your arrogance you marched up into the hill country.

1.zh: 住那山地的亚摩利人就出来攻击你们，追赶你们，如蜂拥一般，在西珥杀退你们，直到何珥玛。
1.en: The Amorites who lived in those hills came out against you; they chased you like a swarm of bees and beat you down from Seir all the way to Hormah.

1.zh: 你们便回来，在耶和华面前哭号；耶和华却不听你们的声音，也不向你们侧耳。
1.en: You came back and wept before the Lord , but he paid no attention to your weeping and turned a deaf ear to you.

1.zh: 于是你们在加低斯住了许多日子。
1.en: And so you stayed in Kadesh many days-all the time you spent there.

2.zh: 此后，我们转回，从红海的路往旷野去，是照耶和华所吩咐我的。我们在西珥山绕行了许多日子。
2.en: Then we turned back and set out toward the desert along the route to the Red Sea, as the Lord had directed me. For a long time we made our way around the hill country of Seir.

2.zh: 耶和华对我说：
2.en: Then the Lord said to me,

2.zh: 你们绕行这山的日子够了，要转向北去。
2.en: "You have made your way around this hill country long enough; now turn north.

2.zh: 你吩咐百姓说：你们弟兄以扫的子孙住在西珥，你们要经过他们的境界。他们必惧怕你们，所以你们要分外谨慎。
2.en: Give the people these orders: 'You are about to pass through the territory of your brothers the descendants of Esau, who live in Seir. They will be afraid of you, but be very careful.

2.zh: 不可与他们争战；他们的地，连脚掌可踏之处，我都不给你们，因我已将西珥山赐给以扫为业。
2.en: Do not provoke them to war, for I will not give you any of their land, not even enough to put your foot on. I have given Esau the hill country of Seir as his own.

2.zh: 你们要用钱向他们买粮吃，也要用钱向他们买水喝。
2.en: You are to pay them in silver for the food you eat and the water you drink.' "

2.zh: 因为耶和华 ─ 你的神在你手里所办的一切事上已赐福与你。你走这大旷野，他都知道了。这四十年，耶和华 ─ 你的神常与你同在，故此你一无所缺。
2.en: The Lord your God has blessed you in all the work of your hands. He has watched over your journey through this vast desert. These forty years the Lord your God has been with you, and you have not lacked anything.

2.zh: 于是，我们离了我们弟兄以扫子孙所住的西珥，从亚拉巴的路，经过以拉他 、 以旬迦别，转向摩押旷野的路去。
2.en: So we went on past our brothers the descendants of Esau, who live in Seir. We turned from the Arabah road, which comes up from Elath and Ezion Geber, and traveled along the desert road of Moab.

2.zh: 耶和华吩咐我说：不可扰害摩押人，也不可与他们争战。他们的地，我不赐给你为业，因我已将亚珥赐给罗得的子孙为业。
2.en: Then the Lord said to me, "Do not harass the Moabites or provoke them to war, for I will not give you any part of their land. I have given Ar to the descendants of Lot as a possession."

2.zh: （先前，有以米人住在那里，民数众多，身体高大，像亚衲人一样。
2.en: (The Emites used to live there-a people strong and numerous, and as tall as the Anakites.

2.zh: 这以米人像亚衲人；也算为利乏音人；摩押人称他们为以米人。
2.en: Like the Anakites, they too were considered Rephaites, but the Moabites called them Emites.

2.zh: 先前，何利人也住在西珥，但以扫的子孙将他们除灭，得了他们的地，接著居住，就如以色列在耶和华赐给他为业之地所行的一样。）
2.en: Horites used to live in Seir, but the descendants of Esau drove them out. They destroyed the Horites from before them and settled in their place, just as Israel did in the land the Lord gave them as their possession.)

2.zh: 现在，起来过撒烈溪！于是我们过了撒烈溪。
2.en: And the Lord said, "Now get up and cross the Zered Valley." So we crossed the valley.

2.zh: 自从离开加低斯巴尼亚，到过了撒烈溪的时候，共有三十八年，等那世代的兵丁都从营中灭尽，正如耶和华向他们所起的誓。
2.en: Thirty-eight years passed from the time we left Kadesh Barnea until we crossed the Zered Valley. By then, that entire generation of fighting men had perished from the camp, as the Lord had sworn to them.

2.zh: 耶和华的手也攻击他们，将他们从营中除灭，直到灭尽。
2.en: The Lord 's hand was against them until he had completely eliminated them from the camp.

2.zh: 兵丁从民中都灭尽死亡以后，
2.en: Now when the last of these fighting men among the people had died,

2.zh: 耶和华吩咐我说：
2.en: the Lord said to me,

2.zh: 你今天要从摩押的境界亚珥经过，
2.en: "Today you are to pass by the region of Moab at Ar.

2.zh: 走近亚扪人之地，不可扰害他们，也不可与他们争战。亚扪人的地，我不赐给你们为业，因我已将那地赐给罗得的子孙为业。
2.en: When you come to the Ammonites, do not harass them or provoke them to war, for I will not give you possession of any land belonging to the Ammonites. I have given it as a possession to the descendants of Lot."

2.zh: （那地也算为利乏音人之地，先前利乏音人住在那里，亚扪人称他们为散送冥。
2.en: (That too was considered a land of the Rephaites, who used to live there; but the Ammonites called them Zamzummites.

2.zh: 那民众多，身体高大，像亚衲人一样，但耶和华从亚扪人面前除灭他们，亚扪人就得了他们的地，接著居住。
2.en: They were a people strong and numerous, and as tall as the Anakites. The Lord destroyed them from before the Ammonites, who drove them out and settled in their place.

2.zh: 正如耶和华从前为住西珥的以扫子孙将何利人从他们面前除灭 、 他们得了何利人的地 、 接著居住一样，直到今日。
2.en: The Lord had done the same for the descendants of Esau, who lived in Seir, when he destroyed the Horites from before them. They drove them out and have lived in their place to this day.

2.zh: 从迦斐托出来的迦斐托人将先前住在乡村直到迦萨的亚卫人除灭，接著居住。）
2.en: And as for the Avvites who lived in villages as far as Gaza, the Caphtorites coming out from Caphtor destroyed them and settled in their place.)

2.zh: 你们起来前往，过亚嫩谷；我已将亚摩利人希实本王西宏和他的地交在你手中，你要与他争战，得他的地为业。
2.en: "Set out now and cross the Arnon Gorge. See, I have given into your hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his country. Begin to take possession of it and engage him in battle.

2.zh: 从今日起，我要使天下万民听见你的名声都惊恐惧怕，且因你发颤伤恸。
2.en: This very day I will begin to put the terror and fear of you on all the nations under heaven. They will hear reports of you and will tremble and be in anguish because of you."

2.zh: 我从基底莫的旷野差遣使者去见希实本王西宏，用和睦的话说：
2.en: From the desert of Kedemoth I sent messengers to Sihon king of Heshbon offering peace and saying,

2.zh: 求你容我从你的地经过，只走大道，不偏左右。
2.en: "Let us pass through your country. We will stay on the main road; we will not turn aside to the right or to the left.

2.zh: 你可以卖粮给我吃，也可以卖水给我喝，只要容我步行过去，
2.en: Sell us food to eat and water to drink for their price in silver. Only let us pass through on foot-

2.zh: 就如住西珥的以扫子孙和住亚珥的摩押人待我一样，等我过了约但河，好进入耶和华 ─ 我们神所赐给我们的地。
2.en: as the descendants of Esau, who live in Seir, and the Moabites, who live in Ar, did for us-until we cross the Jordan into the land the Lord our God is giving us."

2.zh: 但希实本王西宏不容我们从他那里经过；因为耶和华 ─ 你的神使他心中刚硬，性情顽梗，为要将他交在你手中，像今日一样。
2.en: But Sihon king of Heshbon refused to let us pass through. For the Lord your God had made his spirit stubborn and his heart obstinate in order to give him into your hands, as he has now done.

2.zh: 耶和华对我说：从此起首，我要将西宏和他的地交给你；你要得他的地为业。
2.en: The Lord said to me, "See, I have begun to deliver Sihon and his country over to you. Now begin to conquer and possess his land."

2.zh: 那时，西宏和他的众民出来攻击我们，在雅杂与我们交战。
2.en: When Sihon and all his army came out to meet us in battle at Jahaz,

2.zh: 耶和华 ─ 我们的神将他交给我们，我们就把他和他的儿子，并他的众民，都击杀了。
2.en: the Lord our God delivered him over to us and we struck him down, together with his sons and his whole army.

2.zh: 我们夺了他的一切城邑，将有人烟的各城，连女人带孩子，尽都毁灭，没有留下一个。
2.en: At that time we took all his towns and completely destroyed them-men, women and children. We left no survivors.

2.zh: 惟有牲畜和所夺的各城，并其中的财物，都取为自己的掠物。
2.en: But the livestock and the plunder from the towns we had captured we carried off for ourselves.

2.zh: 从亚嫩谷边的亚罗珥和谷中的城，直到基列，耶和华 ─ 我们的神都交给我们了，没有一座城高得使我们不能攻取的。
2.en: From Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Gorge, and from the town in the gorge, even as far as Gilead, not one town was too strong for us. The Lord our God gave us all of them.

2.zh: 惟有亚扪人之地，凡靠近雅博河的地，并山地的城邑，与耶和华 ─ 我们神所禁止我们去的地方，都没有挨近。
2.en: But in accordance with the command of the Lord our God, you did not encroach on any of the land of the Ammonites, neither the land along the course of the Jabbok nor that around the towns in the hills.

3.zh: 以后，我们转回，向巴珊去。巴珊王噩和他的众民都出来，在以得来与我们交战。
3.en: Next we turned and went up along the road toward Bashan, and Og king of Bashan with his whole army marched out to meet us in battle at Edrei.

3.zh: 耶和华对我说：不要怕他！因我已将他和他的众民，并他的地，都交在你手中；你要待他像从前待住希实本的亚摩利王西宏一样。
3.en: The Lord said to me, "Do not be afraid of him, for I have handed him over to you with his whole army and his land. Do to him what you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon."

3.zh: 于是耶和华 ─ 我们的神也将巴珊王噩和他的众民都交在我们手中；我们杀了他们，没有留下一个。
3.en: So the Lord our God also gave into our hands Og king of Bashan and all his army. We struck them down, leaving no survivors.

3.zh: 那时，我们夺了他所有的城，共有六十座，没有一座城不被我们所夺。这为亚珥歌伯的全境，就是巴珊地噩王的国。
3.en: At that time we took all his cities. There was not one of the sixty cities that we did not take from them-the whole region of Argob, Og's kingdom in Bashan.

3.zh: 这些城都有坚固的高墙，有门有闩。此外还有许多无城墙的乡村。
3.en: All these cities were fortified with high walls and with gates and bars, and there were also a great many unwalled villages.

3.zh: 我们将这些都毁灭了，像从前待希实本王西宏一样，把有人烟的各城，连女人带孩子，尽都毁灭；
3.en: We completely destroyed them, as we had done with Sihon king of Heshbon, destroying every city-men, women and children.

3.zh: 惟有一切牲畜和城中的财物都取为自己的掠物。
3.en: But all the livestock and the plunder from their cities we carried off for ourselves.

3.zh: 那时，我们从约但河东两个亚摩利王的手将亚嫩谷直到黑门山之地夺过来
3.en: So at that time we took from these two kings of the Amorites the territory east of the Jordan, from the Arnon Gorge as far as Mount Hermon.

3.zh: （这黑门山，西顿人称为西连，亚摩利人称为示尼珥），
3.en: (Hermon is called Sirion by the Sidonians; the Amorites call it Senir.)

3.zh: 就是夺了平原的各城 、 基列全地 、 巴珊全地，直到撒迦和以得来，都是巴珊王噩国内的城邑。
3.en: We took all the towns on the plateau, and all Gilead, and all Bashan as far as Salecah and Edrei, towns of Og's kingdom in Bashan.

3.zh: （利乏音人所剩下的只有巴珊王噩。他的床是铁的，长九肘，宽四肘，都是以人肘为度。现今岂不是在亚扪人的拉巴么？）
3.en: (Only Og king of Bashan was left of the remnant of the Rephaites. His bed was made of iron and was more than thirteen feet long and six feet wide. It is still in Rabbah of the Ammonites.)

3.zh: 那时，我们得了这地。从亚嫩谷边的亚罗珥起，我将基列山地的一半，并其中的城邑，都给了流便人和迦得人。
3.en: Of the land that we took over at that time, I gave the Reubenites and the Gadites the territory north of Aroer by the Arnon Gorge, including half the hill country of Gilead, together with its towns.

3.zh: 其余的基列地和巴珊全地，就是噩王的国，我给了玛拿西半支派。亚珥歌伯全地乃是巴珊全地；这叫做利乏音人之地。
3.en: The rest of Gilead and also all of Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I gave to the half tribe of Manasseh. (The whole region of Argob in Bashan used to be known as a land of the Rephaites.

3.zh: 玛拿西的子孙睚珥占了亚珥歌伯全境，直到基述人和玛迦人的交界，就按自己的名称这巴珊地为哈倭特睚珥，直到今日。
3.en: Jair, a descendant of Manasseh, took the whole region of Argob as far as the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites; it was named after him, so that to this day Bashan is called Havvoth Jair. )

3.zh: 我又将基列给了玛吉。
3.en: And I gave Gilead to Makir.

3.zh: 从基列到亚嫩谷，以谷中为界，直到亚扪人交界的雅博河，我给了流便人和迦得人，
3.en: But to the Reubenites and the Gadites I gave the territory extending from Gilead down to the Arnon Gorge (the middle of the gorge being the border) and out to the Jabbok River, which is the border of the Ammonites.

3.zh: 又将亚拉巴和靠近约但河之地，从基尼烈直到亚拉巴海，就是盐海，并毘斯迦山根东边之地，都给了他们。
3.en: Its western border was the Jordan in the Arabah, from Kinnereth to the Sea of the Arabah (the Salt Sea ), below the slopes of Pisgah.

3.zh: 那时，我吩咐你们说：耶和华 ─ 你们的神已将这地赐给你们为业；你们所有的勇士都要带著兵器，在你们的弟兄以色列人前面过去。
3.en: I commanded you at that time: "The Lord your God has given you this land to take possession of it. But all your able-bodied men, armed for battle, must cross over ahead of your brother Israelites.

3.zh: 但你们的妻子 、 孩子 、 牲畜（我知道你们有许多的牲畜）可以住在我所赐给你们的各城里。
3.en: However, your wives, your children and your livestock (I know you have much livestock) may stay in the towns I have given you,

3.zh: 等到你们弟兄在约但河那边，也得耶和华 ─ 你们神所赐给他们的地，又使他们得享平安，与你们一样，你们才可以回到我所赐给你们为业之地。
3.en: until the Lord gives rest to your brothers as he has to you, and they too have taken over the land that the Lord your God is giving them, across the Jordan. After that, each of you may go back to the possession I have given you."

3.zh: 那时我吩咐约书亚说：你亲眼看见了耶和华 ─ 你神向这二王所行的；耶和华也必向你所要去的各国照样行。
3.en: At that time I commanded Joshua: "You have seen with your own eyes all that the Lord your God has done to these two kings. The Lord will do the same to all the kingdoms over there where you are going.

3.zh: 你不要怕他们，因那为你争战的是耶和华 ─ 你的神。
3.en: Do not be afraid of them; the Lord your God himself will fight for you."

3.zh: 那时，我恳求耶和华说：
3.en: At that time I pleaded with the Lord :

3.zh: 主耶和华阿，你已将你的大力大能显给仆人看。在天上，在地下，有甚么神能像你行事 、 像你有大能的作为呢？
3.en: "O Sovereign Lord , you have begun to show to your servant your greatness and your strong hand. For what god is there in heaven or on earth who can do the deeds and mighty works you do?

3.zh: 求你容我过去，看约但河那边的美地，就是那佳美的山地和利巴嫩。
3.en: Let me go over and see the good land beyond the Jordan-that fine hill country and Lebanon."

3.zh: 但耶和华因你们的缘故向我发怒，不应允我，对我说：罢了！你不要向我再题这事。
3.en: But because of you the Lord was angry with me and would not listen to me. "That is enough," the Lord said. "Do not speak to me anymore about this matter.

3.zh: 你且上毘斯迦山顶去，向东 、 西 、 南 、 北举目观望，因为你必不能过这约但河。
3.en: Go up to the top of Pisgah and look west and north and south and east. Look at the land with your own eyes, since you are not going to cross this Jordan.

3.zh: 你却要嘱咐约书亚，勉励他，使他胆壮；因为他必在这百姓前面过去，使他们承受你所要观看之地。
3.en: But commission Joshua, and encourage and strengthen him, for he will lead this people across and will cause them to inherit the land that you will see."

3.zh: 于是我们住在伯毘珥对面的谷中。
3.en: So we stayed in the valley near Beth Peor.

4.zh: 以色列人哪，现在我所教训你们的律例典章，你们要听从遵行，好叫你们存活，得以进入耶和华 ─ 你们列祖之神所赐给你们的地，承受为业。
4.en: Hear now, O Israel, the decrees and laws I am about to teach you. Follow them so that you may live and may go in and take possession of the land that the Lord , the God of your fathers, is giving you.

4.zh: 所吩咐你们的话，你们不可加添，也不可删减，好叫你们遵守我所吩咐的，就是耶和华 ─ 你们神的命令。
4.en: Do not add to what I command you and do not subtract from it, but keep the commands of the Lord your God that I give you.

4.zh: 耶和华因巴力毘珥的事所行的，你们亲眼看见了。凡随从巴力毘珥的人，耶和华 ─ 你们的神都从你们中间除灭了。
4.en: You saw with your own eyes what the Lord did at Baal Peor. The Lord your God destroyed from among you everyone who followed the Baal of Peor,

4.zh: 惟有你们专靠耶和华 ─ 你们神的人，今日全都存活。
4.en: but all of you who held fast to the Lord your God are still alive today.

4.zh: 我照著耶和华 ─ 我神所吩咐的将律例典章教训你们，使你们在所要进去得为业的地上遵行。
4.en: See, I have taught you decrees and laws as the Lord my God commanded me, so that you may follow them in the land you are entering to take possession of it.

4.zh: 所以你们要谨守遵行；这就是你们在万民眼前的智慧 、 聪明。他们听见这一切律例，必说：这大国的人真是有智慧，有聪明！
4.en: Observe them carefully, for this will show your wisdom and understanding to the nations, who will hear about all these decrees and say, "Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people."

4.zh: 那一大国的人有神与他们相近，像耶和华 ─ 我们的神 、 在我们求告他的时候与我们相近呢？
4.en: What other nation is so great as to have their gods near them the way the Lord our God is near us whenever we pray to him?

4.zh: 又那一大国有这样公义的律例典章 、 像我今日在你们面前所陈明的这一切律法呢？
4.en: And what other nation is so great as to have such righteous decrees and laws as this body of laws I am setting before you today?

4.zh: 你只要谨慎，殷勤保守你的心灵，免得忘记你亲眼所看见的事，又免得你一生这事离开你的心；总要传给你的子子孙孙。
4.en: Only be careful, and watch yourselves closely so that you do not forget the things your eyes have seen or let them slip from your heart as long as you live. Teach them to your children and to their children after them.

4.zh: 你在何烈山站在耶和华 ─ 你神面前的那日，耶和华对我说：你为我招聚百姓，我要叫他们听见我的话，使他们存活在世的日子，可以学习敬畏我，又可以教训儿女这样行。
4.en: Remember the day you stood before the Lord your God at Horeb, when he said to me, "Assemble the people before me to hear my words so that they may learn to revere me as long as they live in the land and may teach them to their children."

4.zh: 那时你们近前来，站在山下；山上有火焰冲天，并有昏黑 、 密云 、 幽暗。
4.en: You came near and stood at the foot of the mountain while it blazed with fire to the very heavens, with black clouds and deep darkness.

4.zh: 耶和华从火焰中对你们说话，你们只听见声音，却没有看见形像。
4.en: Then the Lord spoke to you out of the fire. You heard the sound of words but saw no form; there was only a voice.

4.zh: 他将所吩咐你们当守的约指示你们，就是十条诫，并将这诫写在两块石版上。
4.en: He declared to you his covenant, the Ten Commandments, which he commanded you to follow and then wrote them on two stone tablets.

4.zh: 那时耶和华又吩咐我将律例典章教训你们，使你们在所要过去得为业的地上遵行。
4.en: And the Lord directed me at that time to teach you the decrees and laws you are to follow in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess.

4.zh: 所以，你们要分外谨慎；因为耶和华在何烈山 、 从火中对你们说话的那日，你们没有看见甚么形像。
4.en: You saw no form of any kind the day the Lord spoke to you at Horeb out of the fire. Therefore watch yourselves very carefully,

4.zh: 惟恐你们败坏自己，雕刻偶像，彷佛甚么男像女像，
4.en: so that you do not become corrupt and make for yourselves an idol, an image of any shape, whether formed like a man or a woman,

4.zh: 或地上走兽的像，或空中飞鸟的像，
4.en: or like any animal on earth or any bird that flies in the air,

4.zh: 或地上爬物的像，或地底下水中鱼的像。
4.en: or like any creature that moves along the ground or any fish in the waters below.

4.zh: 又恐怕你向天举目观看，见耶和华 ─ 你的神为天下万民所摆列的日月星，就是天上的万象，自己便被勾引敬拜事奉他。
4.en: And when you look up to the sky and see the sun, the moon and the stars-all the heavenly array-do not be enticed into bowing down to them and worshiping things the Lord your God has apportioned to all the nations under heaven.

4.zh: 耶和华将你们从埃及领出来，脱离铁炉，要特作自己产业的子民，像今日一样。
4.en: But as for you, the Lord took you and brought you out of the iron-smelting furnace, out of Egypt, to be the people of his inheritance, as you now are.

4.zh: 耶和华又因你们的缘故向我发怒，起誓必不容我过约但河，也不容我进入耶和华 ─ 你神所赐你为业的那美地。
4.en: The Lord was angry with me because of you, and he solemnly swore that I would not cross the Jordan and enter the good land the Lord your God is giving you as your inheritance.

4.zh: 我只得死在这地，不能过约但河；但你们必过去得那美地。
4.en: I will die in this land; I will not cross the Jordan; but you are about to cross over and take possession of that good land.

4.zh: 你们要谨慎，免得忘记耶和华 ─ 你们神与你们所立的约，为自己雕刻偶像，就是耶和华 ─ 你神所禁止你做的偶像；
4.en: Be careful not to forget the covenant of the Lord your God that he made with you; do not make for yourselves an idol in the form of anything the Lord your God has forbidden.

4.zh: 因为耶和华 ─ 你的神乃是烈火，是忌邪的神。
4.en: For the Lord your God is a consuming fire, a jealous God.

4.zh: 你们在那地住久了，生子生孙，就雕刻偶像，彷佛甚么形像，败坏自己，行耶和华 ─ 你神眼中看为恶的事，惹他发怒。
4.en: After you have had children and grandchildren and have lived in the land a long time-if you then become corrupt and make any kind of idol, doing evil in the eyes of the Lord your God and provoking him to anger,

4.zh: 我今日呼天唤地向你们作见证，你们必在过约但河得为业的地上速速灭尽！你们不能在那地上长久，必尽行除灭。
4.en: I call heaven and earth as witnesses against you this day that you will quickly perish from the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess. You will not live there long but will certainly be destroyed.

4.zh: 耶和华必使你们分散在万民中；在他所领你们到的万国里，你们剩下的人数稀少。
4.en: The Lord will scatter you among the peoples, and only a few of you will survive among the nations to which the Lord will drive you.

4.zh: 在那里，你们必事奉人手所造的神，就是用木石造成 、 不能看 、 不能听 、 不能吃 、 不能闻的神。
4.en: There you will worship man-made gods of wood and stone, which cannot see or hear or eat or smell.

4.zh: 但你们在那里必寻求耶和华 ─ 你的神。你尽心尽性寻求他的时候，就必寻见。
4.en: But if from there you seek the Lord your God, you will find him if you look for him with all your heart and with all your soul.

4.zh: 日后你遭遇一切患难的时候，你必归回耶和华 ─ 你的神，听从他的话。
4.en: When you are in distress and all these things have happened to you, then in later days you will return to the Lord your God and obey him.

4.zh: 耶和华 ─ 你神原是有怜悯的神；他总不撇下你，不灭绝你，也不忘记他起誓与你列祖所立的约。
4.en: For the Lord your God is a merciful God; he will not abandon or destroy you or forget the covenant with your forefathers, which he confirmed to them by oath.

4.zh: 你且考察在你以前的世代，自神造人在世以来，从天这边到天那边，曾有何民听见神在火中说话的声音，像你听见还能存活呢？
4.en: Ask now about the former days, long before your time, from the day God created man on the earth; ask from one end of the heavens to the other. Has anything so great as this ever happened, or has anything like it ever been heard of?

4.zh: 这样的大事何曾有 、 何曾听见呢？
4.en: Has any other people heard the voice of God speaking out of fire, as you have, and lived?

4.zh: 神何曾从别的国中将一国的人民领出来，用试验 、 神迹 、 奇事 、 争战 、 大能的手，和伸出来的膀臂，并大可畏的事，像耶和华 ─ 你们的神在埃及，在你们眼前为你们所行的一切事呢？
4.en: Has any god ever tried to take for himself one nation out of another nation, by testings, by miraculous signs and wonders, by war, by a mighty hand and an outstretched arm, or by great and awesome deeds, like all the things the Lord your God did for you in Egypt before your very eyes?

4.zh: 这是显给你看，要使你知道，惟有耶和华 ─ 他是神，除他以外，再无别神。
4.en: You were shown these things so that you might know that the Lord is God; besides him there is no other.

4.zh: 他从天上使你听见他的声音，为要教训你，又在地上使你看见他的烈火，并且听见他从火中所说的话。
4.en: From heaven he made you hear his voice to discipline you. On earth he showed you his great fire, and you heard his words from out of the fire.

4.zh: 因他爱你的列祖，所以拣选他们的后裔，用大能亲自领你出了埃及，
4.en: Because he loved your forefathers and chose their descendants after them, he brought you out of Egypt by his Presence and his great strength,

4.zh: 要将比你强大的国民从你面前赶出，领你进去，将他们的地赐你为业，像今日一样。
4.en: to drive out before you nations greater and stronger than you and to bring you into their land to give it to you for your inheritance, as it is today.

4.zh: 所以，今日你要知道，也要记在心上，天上地下惟有耶和华他是神，除他以外，再无别神。
4.en: Acknowledge and take to heart this day that the Lord is God in heaven above and on the earth below. There is no other.

4.zh: 我今日将他的律例诫命晓谕你，你要遵守，使你和你的子孙可以得福，并使你的日子在耶和华 ─ 你神所赐的地上得以长久。
4.en: Keep his decrees and commands, which I am giving you today, so that it may go well with you and your children after you and that you may live long in the land the Lord your God gives you for all time.

4.zh: 那时，摩西在约但河东，向日出之地，分定三座城，
4.en: Then Moses set aside three cities east of the Jordan,

4.zh: 使那素无仇恨 、 无心杀了人的，可以逃到这三城之中的一座城，就得存活：
4.en: to which anyone who had killed a person could flee if he had unintentionally killed his neighbor without malice aforethought. He could flee into one of these cities and save his life.

4.zh: 为流便人分定旷野平原的比悉；为迦得人分定基列的拉末；为玛拿西人分定巴珊的哥兰。
4.en: The cities were these: Bezer in the desert plateau, for the Reubenites; Ramoth in Gilead, for the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, for the Manassites.

4.zh: 摩西在以色列人面前所陈明的律法 ─
4.en: This is the law Moses set before the Israelites.

4.zh: 就是摩西在以色列人出埃及后所传给他们的法度 、 律例 、 典章；
4.en: These are the stipulations, decrees and laws Moses gave them when they came out of Egypt

4.zh: 在约但河东伯毘珥对面的谷中，在住希实本 、 亚摩利王西宏之地；这西宏是摩西和以色列人出埃及后所击杀的。
4.en: and were in the valley near Beth Peor east of the Jordan, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon and was defeated by Moses and the Israelites as they came out of Egypt.

4.zh: 他们得了他的地，又得了巴珊王噩的地，就是两个亚摩利王，在约但河东向日出之地。
4.en: They took possession of his land and the land of Og king of Bashan, the two Amorite kings east of the Jordan.

4.zh: 从亚嫩谷边的亚罗珥，直到西云山，就是黑门山。
4.en: This land extended from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Gorge to Mount Siyon (that is, Hermon),

4.zh: 还有约但河东的全亚拉巴，直到亚拉巴海，靠近毘斯迦山根。
4.en: and included all the Arabah east of the Jordan, as far as the Sea of the Arabah, below the slopes of Pisgah.

5.zh: 摩西将以色列众人召了来，对他们说：以色列人哪，我今日晓谕你们的律例典章，你们要听，可以学习，谨守遵行。
5.en: Moses summoned all Israel and said: Hear, O Israel, the decrees and laws I declare in your hearing today. Learn them and be sure to follow them.

5.zh: 耶和华 ─ 我们的神在何烈山与我们立约。
5.en: The Lord our God made a covenant with us at Horeb.

5.zh: 这约不是与我们列祖立的，乃是与我们今日在这里存活之人立的。
5.en: It was not with our fathers that the Lord made this covenant, but with us, with all of us who are alive here today.

5.zh: 耶和华在山上，从火中，面对面与你们说话 ─
5.en: The Lord spoke to you face to face out of the fire on the mountain.

5.zh: 那时我站在耶和华和你们中间，要将耶和华的话传给你们；因为你们惧怕那火，没有上山 ─ 说：
5.en: (At that time I stood between the Lord and you to declare to you the word of the Lord , because you were afraid of the fire and did not go up the mountain.) And he said:

5.zh: 我是耶和华 ─ 你的神，曾将你从埃及地为奴之家领出来。
5.en: "I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.

5.zh: 除了我以外，你不可有别的神。
5.en: "You shall have no other gods before me.

5.zh: 不可为自己雕刻偶像，也不可做甚么形像，彷佛上天 、 下地和地底下 、 水中的百物。
5.en: "You shall not make for yourself an idol in the form of anything in heaven above or on the earth beneath or in the waters below.

5.zh: 不可跪拜那些像，也不可事奉他，因为我耶和华 ─ 你的神是忌邪的神。恨我的，我必追讨他的罪，自父及子，直到三 、 四代；
5.en: You shall not bow down to them or worship them; for I, the Lord your God, am a jealous God, punishing the children for the sin of the fathers to the third and fourth generation of those who hate me,

5.zh: 爱我 、 守我诫命的，我必向他们发慈爱，直到千代。
5.en: but showing love to a thousand generations of those who love me and keep my commandments.

5.zh: 不可妄称耶和华 ─ 你神的名；因为妄称耶和华名的，耶和华必不以他为无罪。
5.en: "You shall not misuse the name of the Lord your God, for the Lord will not hold anyone guiltless who misuses his name.

5.zh: 当照耶和华 ─ 你神所吩咐的守安息日为圣日。
5.en: "Observe the Sabbath day by keeping it holy, as the Lord your God has commanded you.

5.zh: 六日要劳碌做你一切的工，
5.en: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,

5.zh: 但第七日是向耶和华 ─ 你神当守的安息日。这一日，你和你的儿女 、 仆婢 、 牛 、 驴 、 牲畜，并在你城里寄居的客旅，无论何工都不可做，使你的仆婢可以和你一样安息。
5.en: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the Lord your God. On it you shall not do any work, neither you, nor your son or daughter, nor your manservant or maidservant, nor your ox, your donkey or any of your animals, nor the alien within your gates, so that your manservant and maidservant may rest, as you do.

5.zh: 你也要记念你在埃及地作过奴仆；耶和华 ─ 你神用大能的手和伸出来的膀臂将你从那里领出来。因此，耶和华 ─ 你的神吩咐你守安息日。
5.en: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt and that the Lord your God brought you out of there with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm. Therefore the Lord your God has commanded you to observe the Sabbath day.

5.zh: 当照耶和华 ─ 你神所吩咐的孝敬父母，使你得福，并使你的日子在耶和华 ─ 你神所赐你的地上得以长久。
5.en: "Honor your father and your mother, as the Lord your God has commanded you, so that you may live long and that it may go well with you in the land the Lord your God is giving you.

5.zh: 不可杀人。
5.en: "You shall not murder.

5.zh: 不可奸淫。
5.en: "You shall not commit adultery.

5.zh: 不可偷盗。
5.en: "You shall not steal.

5.zh: 不可作假见证陷害人。
5.en: "You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.

5.zh: 不可贪恋人的妻子；也不可贪图人的房屋 、 田地 、 仆婢 、 牛 、 驴，并他一切所有的。
5.en: "You shall not covet your neighbor's wife. You shall not set your desire on your neighbor's house or land, his manservant or maidservant, his ox or donkey, or anything that belongs to your neighbor."

5.zh: 这些话是耶和华在山上，从火中 、 云中 、 幽暗中，大声晓谕你们全会众的；此外并没有添别的话。他就把这话写在两块石版上，交给我了。
5.en: These are the commandments the Lord proclaimed in a loud voice to your whole assembly there on the mountain from out of the fire, the cloud and the deep darkness; and he added nothing more. Then he wrote them on two stone tablets and gave them to me.

5.zh: 那时，火焰烧山，你们听见从黑暗中出来的声音；你们支派中所有的首领和长老都来就近我，
5.en: When you heard the voice out of the darkness, while the mountain was ablaze with fire, all the leading men of your tribes and your elders came to me.

5.zh: 说：看哪，耶和华 ─ 我们神将他的荣光和他的大能显给我们看，我们又听见他的声音从火中出来。今日我们得见神与人说话，人还存活。
5.en: And you said, "The Lord our God has shown us his glory and his majesty, and we have heard his voice from the fire. Today we have seen that a man can live even if God speaks with him.

5.zh: 现在这大火将要烧灭我们，我们何必冒死呢？若再听见耶和华 ─ 我们神的声音就必死亡。
5.en: But now, why should we die? This great fire will consume us, and we will die if we hear the voice of the Lord our God any longer.

5.zh: 凡属血气的，曾有何人听见永生神的声音从火中出来，像我们听见还能存活呢？
5.en: For what mortal man has ever heard the voice of the living God speaking out of fire, as we have, and survived?

5.zh: 求你近前去，听耶和华 ─ 我们神所要说的一切话，将他对你说的话都传给我们，我们就听从遵行。
5.en: Go near and listen to all that the Lord our God says. Then tell us whatever the Lord our God tells you. We will listen and obey."

5.zh: 你们对我说的话，耶和华都听见了。耶和华对我说：这百姓的话，我听见了；他们所说的都是。
5.en: The Lord heard you when you spoke to me and the Lord said to me, "I have heard what this people said to you. Everything they said was good.

5.zh: 惟愿他们存这样的心敬畏我，常遵守我的一切诫命，使他们和他们的子孙永远得福。
5.en: Oh, that their hearts would be inclined to fear me and keep all my commands always, so that it might go well with them and their children forever!

5.zh: 你去对他们说：你们回帐棚去罢！
5.en: "Go, tell them to return to their tents.

5.zh: 至于你，可以站在我这里，我要将一切诫命 、 律例 、 典章传给你；你要教训他们，使他们在我赐他们为业的地上遵行。
5.en: But you stay here with me so that I may give you all the commands, decrees and laws you are to teach them to follow in the land I am giving them to possess."

5.zh: 所以，你们要照耶和华 ─ 你们神所吩咐的谨守遵行，不可偏离左右。
5.en: So be careful to do what the Lord your God has commanded you; do not turn aside to the right or to the left.

5.zh: 耶和华 ─ 你们神所吩咐你们行的，你们都要去行，使你们可以存活得福，并使你们的日子在所要承受的地上得以长久。
5.en: Walk in all the way that the Lord your God has commanded you, so that you may live and prosper and prolong your days in the land that you will possess.

6.zh: 这是耶和华 ─ 你们神所吩咐教训你们的诫命 、 律例 、 典章，使你们在所要过去得为业的地上遵行，
6.en: These are the commands, decrees and laws the Lord your God directed me to teach you to observe in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess,

6.zh: 好叫你和你子子孙孙一生敬畏耶和华 ─ 你的神，谨守他的一切律例诫命，就是我所吩咐你的，使你的日子得以长久。
6.en: so that you, your children and their children after them may fear the Lord your God as long as you live by keeping all his decrees and commands that I give you, and so that you may enjoy long life.

6.zh: 以色列阿，你要听，要谨守遵行，使你可以在那流奶与蜜之地得以享福，人数极其增多，正如耶和华 ─ 你列祖的神所应许你的。
6.en: Hear, O Israel, and be careful to obey so that it may go well with you and that you may increase greatly in a land flowing with milk and honey, just as the Lord , the God of your fathers, promised you.

6.zh: 以色列阿，你要听！耶和华 ─ 我们神是独一的主。
6.en: Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God, the Lord is one.

6.zh: 你要尽心 、 尽性 、 尽力爱耶和华 ─ 你的神。
6.en: Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength.

6.zh: 我今日所吩咐你的话都要记在心上，
6.en: These commandments that I give you today are to be upon your hearts.

6.zh: 也要殷勤教训你的儿女。无论你坐在家里，行在路上，躺下，起来，都要谈论。
6.en: Impress them on your children. Talk about them when you sit at home and when you walk along the road, when you lie down and when you get up.

6.zh: 也要系在手上为记号，戴在额上为经文；
6.en: Tie them as symbols on your hands and bind them on your foreheads.

6.zh: 又要写在你房屋的门框上，并你的城门上。
6.en: Write them on the doorframes of your houses and on your gates.

6.zh: 耶和华 ─ 你的神领你进他向你列祖亚伯拉罕 、 以撒 、 雅各起誓应许给你的地。那里有城邑，又大又美，非你所建造的；
6.en: When the Lord your God brings you into the land he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, to give you-a land with large, flourishing cities you did not build,

6.zh: 有房屋，装满各样美物，非你所装满的；有凿成的水井，非你所凿成的；还有葡萄园 、 橄榄园，非你所栽种的；你吃了而且饱足。
6.en: houses filled with all kinds of good things you did not provide, wells you did not dig, and vineyards and olive groves you did not plant-then when you eat and are satisfied,

6.zh: 那时你要谨慎，免得你忘记将你从埃及地 、 为奴之家领出来的耶和华。
6.en: be careful that you do not forget the Lord , who brought you out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.

6.zh: 你要敬畏耶和华 ─ 你的神，事奉他，指著他的名起誓。
6.en: Fear the Lord your God, serve him only and take your oaths in his name.

6.zh: 不可随从别神，就是你们四围国民的神；
6.en: Do not follow other gods, the gods of the peoples around you;

6.zh: 因为在你们中间的耶和华 ─ 你神是忌邪的神，惟恐耶和华 ─ 你神的怒气向你发作，就把你从地上除灭。
6.en: for the Lord your God, who is among you, is a jealous God and his anger will burn against you, and he will destroy you from the face of the land.

6.zh: 你们不可试探耶和华 ─ 你们的神，像你们在玛撒那样试探他。
6.en: Do not test the Lord your God as you did at Massah.

6.zh: 要留意遵守耶和华 ─ 你们神所吩咐的诫命 、 法度 、 律例。
6.en: Be sure to keep the commands of the Lord your God and the stipulations and decrees he has given you.

6.zh: 耶和华眼中看为正 、 看为善的，你都要遵行，使你可以享福，并可以进去得耶和华向你列祖起誓应许的那美地，
6.en: Do what is right and good in the Lord 's sight, so that it may go well with you and you may go in and take over the good land that the Lord promised on oath to your forefathers,

6.zh: 照耶和华所说的，从你面前撵出你的一切仇敌。
6.en: thrusting out all your enemies before you, as the Lord said.

6.zh: 日后，你的儿子问你说：耶和华 ─ 我们神吩咐你们的这些法度 、 律例 、 典章是甚么意思呢？
6.en: In the future, when your son asks you, "What is the meaning of the stipulations, decrees and laws the Lord our God has commanded you?"

6.zh: 你就告诉你的儿子说：我们在埃及作过法老的奴仆；耶和华用大能的手将我们从埃及领出来，
6.en: tell him: "We were slaves of Pharaoh in Egypt, but the Lord brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

6.zh: 在我们眼前，将重大可怕的神迹奇事施行在埃及地和法老并他全家的身上，
6.en: Before our eyes the Lord sent miraculous signs and wonders-great and terrible-upon Egypt and Pharaoh and his whole household.

6.zh: 将我们从那里领出来，要领我们进入他向我们列祖起誓应许之地，把这地赐给我们。
6.en: But he brought us out from there to bring us in and give us the land that he promised on oath to our forefathers.

6.zh: 耶和华又吩咐我们遵行这一切律例，要敬畏耶和华 ─ 我们的神，使我们常得好处，蒙他保全我们的生命，像今日一样。
6.en: The Lord commanded us to obey all these decrees and to fear the Lord our God, so that we might always prosper and be kept alive, as is the case today.

6.zh: 我们若照耶和华 ─ 我们神所吩咐的一切诫命谨守遵行，这就是我们的义了。
6.en: And if we are careful to obey all this law before the Lord our God, as he has commanded us, that will be our righteousness."

7.zh: 耶和华 ─ 你神领你进入要得为业之地，从你面前赶出许多国民，就是赫人 、 革迦撒人 、 亚摩利人 、 迦南人 、 比利洗人 、 希未人 、 耶布斯人，共七国的民，都比你强大。
7.en: When the Lord your God brings you into the land you are entering to possess and drives out before you many nations-the Hittites, Girgashites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites, seven nations larger and stronger than you-

7.zh: 耶和华 ─ 你神将他们交给你击杀，那时你要把他们灭绝净尽，不可与他们立约，也不可怜恤他们。
7.en: and when the Lord your God has delivered them over to you and you have defeated them, then you must destroy them totally. Make no treaty with them, and show them no mercy.

7.zh: 不可与他们结亲。不可将你的女儿嫁他们的儿子，也不可叫你的儿子娶他们的女儿；
7.en: Do not intermarry with them. Do not give your daughters to their sons or take their daughters for your sons,

7.zh: 因为他必使你儿子转离不跟从主，去事奉别神，以致耶和华的怒气向你们发作，就速速地将你们灭绝。
7.en: for they will turn your sons away from following me to serve other gods, and the Lord 's anger will burn against you and will quickly destroy you.

7.zh: 你们却要这样待他们：拆毁他们的祭坛，打碎他们的柱像，砍下他们的木偶，用火焚烧他们雕刻的偶像。
7.en: This is what you are to do to them: Break down their altars, smash their sacred stones, cut down their Asherah poles and burn their idols in the fire.

7.zh: 因为你归耶和华 ─ 你神为圣洁的民；耶和华 ─ 你神从地上的万民中拣选你，特作自己的子民。
7.en: For you are a people holy to the Lord your God. The Lord your God has chosen you out of all the peoples on the face of the earth to be his people, his treasured possession.

7.zh: 耶和华专爱你们，拣选你们，并非因你们的人数多于别民，原来你们的人数在万民中是最少的。
7.en: The Lord did not set his affection on you and choose you because you were more numerous than other peoples, for you were the fewest of all peoples.

7.zh: 只因耶和华爱你们，又因要守他向你们列祖所起的誓，就用大能的手领你们出来，从为奴之家救赎你们脱离埃及王法老的手。
7.en: But it was because the Lord loved you and kept the oath he swore to your forefathers that he brought you out with a mighty hand and redeemed you from the land of slavery, from the power of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

7.zh: 所以，你要知道耶和华 ─ 你的神，他是神，是信实的神；向爱他 、 守他诫命的人守约，施慈爱，直到千代；
7.en: Know therefore that the Lord your God is God; he is the faithful God, keeping his covenant of love to a thousand generations of those who love him and keep his commands.

7.zh: 向恨他的人当面报应他们，将他们灭绝。凡恨他的人必报应他们，决不迟延。
7.en: But those who hate him he will repay to their face by destruction; he will not be slow to repay to their face those who hate him.

7.zh: 所以，你要谨守遵行我今日所吩咐你的诫命 、 律例 、 典章。
7.en: Therefore, take care to follow the commands, decrees and laws I give you today.

7.zh: 你们果然听从这些典章，谨守遵行，耶和华 ─ 你神就必照他向你列祖所起的誓守约，施慈爱。
7.en: If you pay attention to these laws and are careful to follow them, then the Lord your God will keep his covenant of love with you, as he swore to your forefathers.

7.zh: 他必爱你，赐福与你，使你人数增多，也必在他向你列祖起誓应许给你的地上赐福与你身所生的，地所产的，并你的五谷 、 新酒，和油，以及牛犊 、 羊羔。
7.en: He will love you and bless you and increase your numbers. He will bless the fruit of your womb, the crops of your land-your grain, new wine and oil-the calves of your herds and the lambs of your flocks in the land that he swore to your forefathers to give you.

7.zh: 你必蒙福胜过万民；你们的男女没有不能生养的，牲畜也没有不能生育的。
7.en: You will be blessed more than any other people; none of your men or women will be childless, nor any of your livestock without young.

7.zh: 耶和华必使一切的病症离开你；你所知道埃及各样的恶疾，他不加在你身上，只加在一切恨你的人身上。
7.en: The Lord will keep you free from every disease. He will not inflict on you the horrible diseases you knew in Egypt, but he will inflict them on all who hate you.

7.zh: 耶和华 ─ 你神所要交给你的一切人民，你要将他们除灭；你眼不可顾惜他们。你也不可事奉他们的神，因这必成为你的网罗。
7.en: You must destroy all the peoples the Lord your God gives over to you. Do not look on them with pity and do not serve their gods, for that will be a snare to you.

7.zh: 你若心里说，这些国的民比我更多，我怎能赶出他们呢？
7.en: You may say to yourselves, "These nations are stronger than we are. How can we drive them out?"

7.zh: 你不要惧怕他们，要牢牢记念耶和华 ─ 你神向法老和埃及全地所行的事，
7.en: But do not be afraid of them; remember well what the Lord your God did to Pharaoh and to all Egypt.

7.zh: 就是你亲眼所看见的大试验 、 神迹 、 奇事，和大能的手，并伸出来的膀臂，都是耶和华 ─ 你神领你出来所用的。耶和华 ─ 你神必照样待你所惧怕的一切人民。
7.en: You saw with your own eyes the great trials, the miraculous signs and wonders, the mighty hand and outstretched arm, with which the Lord your God brought you out. The Lord your God will do the same to all the peoples you now fear.

7.zh: 并且耶和华 ─ 你神必打发黄蜂飞到他们中间，直到那剩下而藏躲的人从你面前灭亡。
7.en: Moreover, the Lord your God will send the hornet among them until even the survivors who hide from you have perished.

7.zh: 你不要因他们惊恐，因为耶和华 ─ 你神在你们中间是大而可畏的神。
7.en: Do not be terrified by them, for the Lord your God, who is among you, is a great and awesome God.

7.zh: 耶和华 ─ 你神必将这些国的民从你面前渐渐赶出；你不可把他们速速灭尽，恐怕野地的兽多起来害你。
7.en: The Lord your God will drive out those nations before you, little by little. You will not be allowed to eliminate them all at once, or the wild animals will multiply around you.

7.zh: 耶和华 ─ 你神必将他们交给你，大大的扰乱他们，直到他们灭绝了；
7.en: But the Lord your God will deliver them over to you, throwing them into great confusion until they are destroyed.

7.zh: 又要将他们的君王交在你手中，你就使他们的名从天下消灭。必无一人能在你面前站立得住，直到你将他们灭绝了。
7.en: He will give their kings into your hand, and you will wipe out their names from under heaven. No one will be able to stand up against you; you will destroy them.

7.zh: 他们雕刻的神像，你们要用火焚烧；其上的金银，你不可贪图，也不可收取，免得你因此陷入网罗；这原是耶和华 ─ 你神所憎恶的。
7.en: The images of their gods you are to burn in the fire. Do not covet the silver and gold on them, and do not take it for yourselves, or you will be ensnared by it, for it is detestable to the Lord your God.

7.zh: 可憎的物，你不可带进家去；不然，你就成了当毁灭的，与那物一样。你要十分厌恶，十分憎嫌，因为这是当毁灭的物。
7.en: Do not bring a detestable thing into your house or you, like it, will be set apart for destruction. Utterly abhor and detest it, for it is set apart for destruction.

8.zh: 我今日所吩咐的一切诫命，你们要谨守遵行，好叫你们存活，人数增多，且进去得耶和华向你们列祖起誓应许的那地。
8.en: Be careful to follow every command I am giving you today, so that you may live and increase and may enter and possess the land that the Lord promised on oath to your forefathers.

8.zh: 你也要记念耶和华 ─ 你的神在旷野引导你这四十年，是要苦炼你，试验你，要知道你心内如何，肯守他的诫命不肯。
8.en: Remember how the Lord your God led you all the way in the desert these forty years, to humble you and to test you in order to know what was in your heart, whether or not you would keep his commands.

8.zh: 他苦炼你，任你饥饿，将你和你列祖所不认识的吗哪赐给你吃，使你知道，人活著不是单靠食物，乃是靠耶和华口里所出的一切话。
8.en: He humbled you, causing you to hunger and then feeding you with manna, which neither you nor your fathers had known, to teach you that man does not live on bread alone but on every word that comes from the mouth of the Lord .

8.zh: 这四十年，你的衣服没有穿破，你的脚也没有肿。
8.en: Your clothes did not wear out and your feet did not swell during these forty years.

8.zh: 你当心里思想，耶和华 ─ 你神管教你，好像人管教儿子一样。
8.en: Know then in your heart that as a man disciplines his son, so the Lord your God disciplines you.

8.zh: 你要谨守耶和华 ─ 你神的诫命，遵行他的道，敬畏他。
8.en: Observe the commands of the Lord your God, walking in his ways and revering him.

8.zh: 因为耶和华 ─ 你神领你进入美地，那地有河，有泉，有源，从山谷中流出水来。
8.en: For the Lord your God is bringing you into a good land-a land with streams and pools of water, with springs flowing in the valleys and hills;

8.zh: 那地有小麦 、 大麦 、 葡萄树 、 无花果树 、 石榴树 、 橄榄树，和蜜。
8.en: a land with wheat and barley, vines and fig trees, pomegranates, olive oil and honey;

8.zh: 你在那地不缺食物，一无所缺。那地的石头是铁，山内可以挖铜。
8.en: a land where bread will not be scarce and you will lack nothing; a land where the rocks are iron and you can dig copper out of the hills.

8.zh: 你吃得饱足，就要称颂耶和华 ─ 你的神，因他将那美地赐给你了。
8.en: When you have eaten and are satisfied, praise the Lord your God for the good land he has given you.

8.zh: 你要谨慎，免得忘记耶和华 ─ 你的神，不守他的诫命 、 典章 、 律例，就是我今日所吩咐你的；
8.en: Be careful that you do not forget the Lord your God, failing to observe his commands, his laws and his decrees that I am giving you this day.

8.zh: 恐怕你吃得饱足，建造美好的房屋居住，
8.en: Otherwise, when you eat and are satisfied, when you build fine houses and settle down,

8.zh: 你的牛羊加多，你的金银增添，并你所有的全都加增，
8.en: and when your herds and flocks grow large and your silver and gold increase and all you have is multiplied,

8.zh: 你就心高气傲，忘记耶和华 ─ 你的神，就是将你从埃及地为奴之家领出来的，
8.en: then your heart will become proud and you will forget the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.

8.zh: 引你经过那大而可怕的旷野，那里有火蛇 、 蝎子 、 干旱无水之地。他曾为你使水从坚硬的磐石中流出来，
8.en: He led you through the vast and dreadful desert, that thirsty and waterless land, with its venomous snakes and scorpions. He brought you water out of hard rock.

8.zh: 又在旷野将你列祖所不认识的吗哪赐给你吃，是要苦炼你，试验你，叫你终久享福；
8.en: He gave you manna to eat in the desert, something your fathers had never known, to humble and to test you so that in the end it might go well with you.

8.zh: 恐怕你心里说：这货财是我力量 、 我能力得来的。
8.en: You may say to yourself, "My power and the strength of my hands have produced this wealth for me."

8.zh: 你要记念耶和华 ─ 你的神，因为得货财的力量是他给你的，为要坚定他向你列祖起誓所立的约，像今日一样。
8.en: But remember the Lord your God, for it is he who gives you the ability to produce wealth, and so confirms his covenant, which he swore to your forefathers, as it is today.

8.zh: 你若忘记耶和华 ─ 你的神，随从别神，事奉敬拜，你们必定灭亡；这是我今日警戒你们的。
8.en: If you ever forget the Lord your God and follow other gods and worship and bow down to them, I testify against you today that you will surely be destroyed.

8.zh: 耶和华在你们面前怎样使列国的民灭亡，你们也必照样灭亡，因为你们不听从耶和华 ─ 你们神的话。
8.en: Like the nations the Lord destroyed before you, so you will be destroyed for not obeying the Lord your God.

9.zh: 以色列阿，你当听！你今日要过约但河，进去赶出比你强大的国民，得著广大坚固 、 高得顶天的城邑。
9.en: Hear, O Israel. You are now about to cross the Jordan to go in and dispossess nations greater and stronger than you, with large cities that have walls up to the sky.

9.zh: 那民是亚衲族的人，又大又高，是你所知道的；也曾听见有人指著他们说：谁能在亚衲族人面前站立得住呢？
9.en: The people are strong and tall-Anakites! You know about them and have heard it said: "Who can stand up against the Anakites?"

9.zh: 你今日当知道，耶和华 ─ 你的神在你前面过去，如同烈火，要灭绝他们，将他们制伏在你面前。这样，你就要照耶和华所说的赶出他们，使他们速速灭亡。
9.en: But be assured today that the Lord your God is the one who goes across ahead of you like a devouring fire. He will destroy them; he will subdue them before you. And you will drive them out and annihilate them quickly, as the Lord has promised you.

9.zh: 耶和华 ─ 你的神将这些国民从你面前撵出以后，你心里不可说：耶和华将我领进来得这地是因我的义。其实，耶和华将他们从你面前赶出去是因他们的恶。
9.en: After the Lord your God has driven them out before you, do not say to yourself, "The Lord has brought me here to take possession of this land because of my righteousness." No, it is on account of the wickedness of these nations that the Lord is going to drive them out before you.

9.zh: 你进去得他们的地，并不是因你的义，也不是因你心里正直，乃是因这些国民的恶，耶和华 ─ 你的神将他们从你面前赶出去，又因耶和华要坚定他向你列祖亚伯拉罕 、 以撒 、 雅各起誓所应许的话。
9.en: It is not because of your righteousness or your integrity that you are going in to take possession of their land; but on account of the wickedness of these nations, the Lord your God will drive them out before you, to accomplish what he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.

9.zh: 你当知道，耶和华 ─ 你神将这美地赐你为业，并不是因你的义；你本是硬著颈项的百姓。
9.en: Understand, then, that it is not because of your righteousness that the Lord your God is giving you this good land to possess, for you are a stiff-necked people.

9.zh: 你当记念不忘，你在旷野怎样惹耶和华 ─ 你神发怒。自从你出了埃及地的那日，直到你们来到这地方，你们时常悖逆耶和华。
9.en: Remember this and never forget how you provoked the Lord your God to anger in the desert. From the day you left Egypt until you arrived here, you have been rebellious against the Lord .

9.zh: 你们在何烈山又惹耶和华发怒；他恼怒你们，要灭绝你们。
9.en: At Horeb you aroused the Lord 's wrath so that he was angry enough to destroy you.

9.zh: 我上了山，要领受两块石版，就是耶和华与你们立约的版。那时我在山上住了四十昼夜，没有吃饭，也没有喝水。
9.en: When I went up on the mountain to receive the tablets of stone, the tablets of the covenant that the Lord had made with you, I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights; I ate no bread and drank no water.

9.zh: 耶和华把那两块石版交给我，是神用指头写的。版上所写的是照耶和华在大会的日子 、 在山上 、 从火中对你们所说的一切话。
9.en: The Lord gave me two stone tablets inscribed by the finger of God. On them were all the commandments the Lord proclaimed to you on the mountain out of the fire, on the day of the assembly.

9.zh: 过了四十昼夜，耶和华把那两块石版，就是约版，交给我。
9.en: At the end of the forty days and forty nights, the Lord gave me the two stone tablets, the tablets of the covenant.

9.zh: 对我说：你起来，赶快下去！因为你从埃及领出来的百姓已经败坏了自己；他们快快的偏离了我所吩咐的道，为自己铸成了偶像。
9.en: Then the Lord told me, "Go down from here at once, because your people whom you brought out of Egypt have become corrupt. They have turned away quickly from what I commanded them and have made a cast idol for themselves."

9.zh: 耶和华又对我说：我看这百姓是硬著颈项的百姓。
9.en: And the Lord said to me, "I have seen this people, and they are a stiff-necked people indeed!

9.zh: 你且由著我，我要灭绝他们，将他们的名从天下涂抹，使你的后裔比他们成为更大更强的国。
9.en: Let me alone, so that I may destroy them and blot out their name from under heaven. And I will make you into a nation stronger and more numerous than they."

9.zh: 于是我转身下山，山被火烧著，两块约版在我两手之中。
9.en: So I turned and went down from the mountain while it was ablaze with fire. And the two tablets of the covenant were in my hands.

9.zh: 我一看见你们得罪了耶和华 ─ 你们的神，铸成了牛犊，快快的偏离了耶和华所吩咐你们的道，
9.en: When I looked, I saw that you had sinned against the Lord your God; you had made for yourselves an idol cast in the shape of a calf. You had turned aside quickly from the way that the Lord had commanded you.

9.zh: 我就把那两块版从我手中扔下去，在你们眼前摔碎了。
9.en: So I took the two tablets and threw them out of my hands, breaking them to pieces before your eyes.

9.zh: 因你们所犯的一切罪，行了耶和华眼中看为恶的事，惹他发怒，我就像从前俯伏在耶和华面前四十昼夜，没有吃饭，也没有喝水。
9.en: Then once again I fell prostrate before the Lord for forty days and forty nights; I ate no bread and drank no water, because of all the sin you had committed, doing what was evil in the Lord 's sight and so provoking him to anger.

9.zh: 我因耶和华向你们大发烈怒，要灭绝你们，就甚害怕；但那次耶和华又应允了我。
9.en: I feared the anger and wrath of the Lord , for he was angry enough with you to destroy you. But again the Lord listened to me.

9.zh: 耶和华也向亚伦甚是发怒，要灭绝他；那时我又为亚伦祈祷。
9.en: And the Lord was angry enough with Aaron to destroy him, but at that time I prayed for Aaron too.

9.zh: 我把那叫你们犯罪所铸的牛犊用火焚烧，又捣碎磨得很细，以至细如灰尘，我就把这灰尘撒在从山上流下来的溪水中。
9.en: Also I took that sinful thing of yours, the calf you had made, and burned it in the fire. Then I crushed it and ground it to powder as fine as dust and threw the dust into a stream that flowed down the mountain.

9.zh: 你们在他备拉 、 玛撒 、 基博罗哈他瓦又惹耶和华发怒。
9.en: You also made the Lord angry at Taberah, at Massah and at Kibroth Hattaavah.

9.zh: 耶和华打发你们离开加低斯巴尼亚，说：你们上去得我所赐给你们的地。那时你们违背了耶和华 ─ 你们神的命令，不信服他，不听从他的话。
9.en: And when the Lord sent you out from Kadesh Barnea, he said, "Go up and take possession of the land I have given you." But you rebelled against the command of the Lord your God. You did not trust him or obey him.

9.zh: 自从我认识你们以来，你们常常悖逆耶和华。
9.en: You have been rebellious against the Lord ever since I have known you.

9.zh: 我因耶和华说要灭绝你们，就在耶和华面前照旧俯伏四十昼夜。
9.en: I lay prostrate before the Lord those forty days and forty nights because the Lord had said he would destroy you.

9.zh: 我祈祷耶和华说：主耶和华阿，求你不要灭绝你的百姓。他们是你的产业，是你用大力救赎的，用大能从埃及领出来的。
9.en: I prayed to the Lord and said, "O Sovereign Lord , do not destroy your people, your own inheritance that you redeemed by your great power and brought out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

9.zh: 求你记念你的仆人亚伯拉罕 、 以撒 、 雅各，不要想念这百姓的顽梗 、 邪恶 、 罪过，
9.en: Remember your servants Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. Overlook the stubbornness of this people, their wickedness and their sin.

9.zh: 免得你领我们出来的那地之人说，耶和华因为不能将这百姓领进他所应许之地，又因恨他们，所以领他们出去，要在旷野杀他们。
9.en: Otherwise, the country from which you brought us will say, 'Because the Lord was not able to take them into the land he had promised them, and because he hated them, he brought them out to put them to death in the desert.'

9.zh: 其实他们是你的百姓，你的产业，是你用大能和伸出来的膀臂领出来的。
9.en: But they are your people, your inheritance that you brought out by your great power and your outstretched arm."

10.zh: 那时，耶和华吩咐我说：你要凿出两块石版，和先前的一样，上山到我这里来，又要做一木柜。
10.en: At that time the Lord said to me, "Chisel out two stone tablets like the first ones and come up to me on the mountain. Also make a wooden chest.

10.zh: 你先前摔碎的那版，其上的字我要写在这版上；你要将这版放在柜中。
10.en: I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke. Then you are to put them in the chest."

10.zh: 于是我用皂荚木做了一柜，又凿出两块石版，和先前的一样，手里拿这两块版上山去了。
10.en: So I made the ark out of acacia wood and chiseled out two stone tablets like the first ones, and I went up on the mountain with the two tablets in my hands.

10.zh: 耶和华将那大会之日 、 在山上从火中所传与你们的十条诫，照先前所写的，写在这版上，将版交给我了。
10.en: The Lord wrote on these tablets what he had written before, the Ten Commandments he had proclaimed to you on the mountain, out of the fire, on the day of the assembly. And the Lord gave them to me.

10.zh: 我转身下山，将这版放在我所做的柜中，现今还在那里，正如耶和华所吩咐我的。
10.en: Then I came back down the mountain and put the tablets in the ark I had made, as the Lord commanded me, and they are there now.

10.zh: （以色列人从比罗比尼亚干（或作：亚干井）起行，到了摩西拉。亚伦死在那里，就葬在那里。他儿子以利亚撒接续他供祭司的职分。
10.en: (The Israelites traveled from the wells of the Jaakanites to Moserah. There Aaron died and was buried, and Eleazar his son succeeded him as priest.

10.zh: 他们从那里起行，到了谷歌大，又从谷歌大到了有溪水之地的约巴他。
10.en: From there they traveled to Gudgodah and on to Jotbathah, a land with streams of water.

10.zh: 那时，耶和华将利未支派分别出来，抬耶和华的约柜，又侍立在耶和华面前事奉他，奉他的名祝福，直到今日。
10.en: At that time the Lord set apart the tribe of Levi to carry the ark of the covenant of the Lord , to stand before the Lord to minister and to pronounce blessings in his name, as they still do today.

10.zh: 所以利未人在他弟兄中无分无业，耶和华是他的产业，正如耶和华 ─ 你神所应许他的。）
10.en: That is why the Levites have no share or inheritance among their brothers; the Lord is their inheritance, as the Lord your God told them.)

10.zh: 我又像从前在山上住了四十昼夜。那次耶和华也应允我，不忍将你灭绝。
10.en: Now I had stayed on the mountain forty days and nights, as I did the first time, and the Lord listened to me at this time also. It was not his will to destroy you.

10.zh: 耶和华吩咐我说：你起来引导这百姓，使他们进去得我向他们列祖起誓应许所赐之地。
10.en: "Go," the Lord said to me, "and lead the people on their way, so that they may enter and possess the land that I swore to their fathers to give them."

10.zh: 以色列阿，现在耶和华 ─ 你神向你所要的是甚么呢？只要你敬畏耶和华 ─ 你的神，遵行他的道，爱他，尽心尽性事奉他，
10.en: And now, O Israel, what does the Lord your God ask of you but to fear the Lord your God, to walk in all his ways, to love him, to serve the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul,

10.zh: 遵守他的诫命律例，就是我今日所吩咐你的，为要叫你得福。
10.en: and to observe the Lord 's commands and decrees that I am giving you today for your own good?

10.zh: 看哪，天和天上的天，地和地上所有的，都属耶和华 ─ 你的神。
10.en: To the Lord your God belong the heavens, even the highest heavens, the earth and everything in it.

10.zh: 耶和华但喜悦你的列祖，爱他们，从万民中拣选他们的后裔，就是你们，像今日一样。
10.en: Yet the Lord set his affection on your forefathers and loved them, and he chose you, their descendants, above all the nations, as it is today.

10.zh: 所以你们要将心里的污秽除掉，不可再硬著颈项。
10.en: Circumcise your hearts, therefore, and do not be stiff-necked any longer.

10.zh: 因为耶和华 ─ 你们的神 ─ 他是万神之神，万主之主，至大的神，大有能力，大而可畏，不以貌取人，也不受贿赂。
10.en: For the Lord your God is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great God, mighty and awesome, who shows no partiality and accepts no bribes.

10.zh: 他为孤儿寡妇伸冤，又怜爱寄居的，赐给他衣食。
10.en: He defends the cause of the fatherless and the widow, and loves the alien, giving him food and clothing.

10.zh: 所以你们要怜爱寄居的，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。
10.en: And you are to love those who are aliens, for you yourselves were aliens in Egypt.

10.zh: 你要敬畏耶和华 ─ 你的神，事奉他，专靠他，也要指著他的名起誓。
10.en: Fear the Lord your God and serve him. Hold fast to him and take your oaths in his name.

10.zh: 他是你所赞美的，是你的神，为你做了那大而可畏的事，是你亲眼所看见的。
10.en: He is your praise; he is your God, who performed for you those great and awesome wonders you saw with your own eyes.

10.zh: 你的列祖七十人下埃及；现在耶和华 ─ 你的神使你如同天上的星那样多。
10.en: Your forefathers who went down into Egypt were seventy in all, and now the Lord your God has made you as numerous as the stars in the sky.

11.zh: 你要爱耶和华 ─ 你的神，常守他的吩咐 、 律例 、 典章 、 诫命。
11.en: Love the Lord your God and keep his requirements, his decrees, his laws and his commands always.

11.zh: 你们今日当知道，我本不是和你们的儿女说话；因为他们不知道，也没有看见耶和华 ─ 你们神的管教 、 威严 、 大能的手，和伸出来的膀臂，
11.en: Remember today that your children were not the ones who saw and experienced the discipline of the Lord your God: his majesty, his mighty hand, his outstretched arm;

11.zh: 并他在埃及中向埃及王法老和其全地所行的神迹奇事；
11.en: the signs he performed and the things he did in the heart of Egypt, both to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to his whole country;

11.zh: 也没有看见他怎样待埃及的军兵 、 车马，他们追赶你们的时候，耶和华怎样使红海的水淹没他们，将他们灭绝，直到今日，
11.en: what he did to the Egyptian army, to its horses and chariots, how he overwhelmed them with the waters of the Red Sea as they were pursuing you, and how the Lord brought lasting ruin on them.

11.zh: 并他在旷野怎样待你们，以至你们来到这地方；
11.en: It was not your children who saw what he did for you in the desert until you arrived at this place,

11.zh: 也没有看见他怎样待流便子孙以利押的儿子大坍 、 亚比兰，地怎样在以色列人中间开口，吞了他们和他们的家眷，并帐棚与跟他们的一切活物。
11.en: and what he did to Dathan and Abiram, sons of Eliab the Reubenite, when the earth opened its mouth right in the middle of all Israel and swallowed them up with their households, their tents and every living thing that belonged to them.

11.zh: 惟有你们亲眼看见耶和华所做的一切大事。
11.en: But it was your own eyes that saw all these great things the Lord has done.

11.zh: 所以，你们要守我今日所吩咐的一切诫命，使你们胆壮，能以进去，得你们所要得的那地，
11.en: Observe therefore all the commands I am giving you today, so that you may have the strength to go in and take over the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess,

11.zh: 并使你们的日子在耶和华向你们列祖起誓 、 应许给他们和他们后裔的地上得以长久；那是流奶与蜜之地。
11.en: and so that you may live long in the land that the Lord swore to your forefathers to give to them and their descendants, a land flowing with milk and honey.

11.zh: 你要进去得为业的那地，本不像你出来的埃及地。你在那里撒种，用脚浇灌，像浇灌菜园一样。
11.en: The land you are entering to take over is not like the land of Egypt, from which you have come, where you planted your seed and irrigated it by foot as in a vegetable garden.

11.zh: 你们要过去得为业的那地乃是有山有谷 、 雨水滋润之地，
11.en: But the land you are crossing the Jordan to take possession of is a land of mountains and valleys that drinks rain from heaven.

11.zh: 是耶和华 ─ 你神所眷顾的；从岁首到年终，耶和华 ─ 你神的眼目时常看顾那地。
11.en: It is a land the Lord your God cares for; the eyes of the Lord your God are continually on it from the beginning of the year to its end.

11.zh: 你们若留意听从我今日所吩咐的诫命，爱耶和华 ─ 你们的神，尽心尽性事奉他，
11.en: So if you faithfully obey the commands I am giving you today-to love the Lord your God and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul-

11.zh: 他（原文是我）必按时降秋雨春雨在你们的地上，使你们可以收藏五谷 、 新酒和油，
11.en: then I will send rain on your land in its season, both autumn and spring rains, so that you may gather in your grain, new wine and oil.

11.zh: 也必使你吃得饱足，并使田野为你的牲畜长草。
11.en: I will provide grass in the fields for your cattle, and you will eat and be satisfied.

11.zh: 你们要谨慎，免得心中受迷惑，就偏离正路，去事奉敬拜别神。
11.en: Be careful, or you will be enticed to turn away and worship other gods and bow down to them.

11.zh: 耶和华的怒气向你们发作，就使天闭塞不下雨，地也不出产，使你们在耶和华所赐给你们的美地上速速灭亡。
11.en: Then the Lord 's anger will burn against you, and he will shut the heavens so that it will not rain and the ground will yield no produce, and you will soon perish from the good land the Lord is giving you.

11.zh: 你们要将我这话存在心内，留在意中，系在手上为记号，戴在额上为经文；
11.en: Fix these words of mine in your hearts and minds; tie them as symbols on your hands and bind them on your foreheads.

11.zh: 也要教训你们的儿女，无论坐在家里，行在路上，躺下，起来，都要谈论；
11.en: Teach them to your children, talking about them when you sit at home and when you walk along the road, when you lie down and when you get up.

11.zh: 又要写在房屋的门框上，并城门上，
11.en: Write them on the doorframes of your houses and on your gates,

11.zh: 使你们和你们子孙的日子在耶和华向你们列祖起誓 、 应许给他们的地上得以增多，如天覆地的日子那样多。
11.en: so that your days and the days of your children may be many in the land that the Lord swore to give your forefathers, as many as the days that the heavens are above the earth.

11.zh: 你们若留意谨守遵行我所吩咐这一切的诫命，爱耶和华 ─ 你们的神，行他的道，专靠他，
11.en: If you carefully observe all these commands I am giving you to follow-to love the Lord your God, to walk in all his ways and to hold fast to him-

11.zh: 他必从你们面前赶出这一切国民，就是比你们更大更强的国民，你们也要得他们的地。
11.en: then the Lord will drive out all these nations before you, and you will dispossess nations larger and stronger than you.

11.zh: 凡你们脚掌所踏之地都必归你们；从旷野和利巴嫩，并伯拉大河，直到西海，都要作你们的境界。
11.en: Every place where you set your foot will be yours: Your territory will extend from the desert to Lebanon, and from the Euphrates River to the western sea.

11.zh: 必无一人能在你们面前站立得住；耶和华 ─ 你们的神必照他所说的，使惧怕惊恐临到你们所踏之地的居民。
11.en: No man will be able to stand against you. The Lord your God, as he promised you, will put the terror and fear of you on the whole land, wherever you go.

11.zh: 看哪，我今日将祝福与咒诅的话都陈明在你们面前。
11.en: See, I am setting before you today a blessing and a curse-

11.zh: 你们若听从耶和华 ─ 你们神的诫命，就是我今日所吩咐你们的，就必蒙福。
11.en: the blessing if you obey the commands of the Lord your God that I am giving you today;

11.zh: 你们若不听从耶和华 ─ 你们神的诫命，偏离我今日所吩咐你们的道，去事奉你们素来所不认识的别神，就必受祸。
11.en: the curse if you disobey the commands of the Lord your God and turn from the way that I command you today by following other gods, which you have not known.

11.zh: 及至耶和华 ─ 你的神领你进入要去得为业的那地，你就要将祝福的话陈明在基利心山上，将咒诅的话陈明在以巴路山上。
11.en: When the Lord your God has brought you into the land you are entering to possess, you are to proclaim on Mount Gerizim the blessings, and on Mount Ebal the curses.

11.zh: 这二山岂不是在约但河那边，日落之处，在住亚拉巴的迦南人之地与吉甲相对，靠近摩利橡树么？
11.en: As you know, these mountains are across the Jordan, west of the road, toward the setting sun, near the great trees of Moreh, in the territory of those Canaanites living in the Arabah in the vicinity of Gilgal.

11.zh: 你们要过约但河，进去得耶和华 ─ 你们神所赐你们为业之地，在那地居住。
11.en: You are about to cross the Jordan to enter and take possession of the land the Lord your God is giving you. When you have taken it over and are living there,

11.zh: 你们要谨守遵行我今日在你们面前所陈明的一切律例典章。
11.en: be sure that you obey all the decrees and laws I am setting before you today.

12.zh: 你们存活于世的日子，在耶和华 ─ 你们列祖的神所赐你们为业的地上，要谨守遵行的律例典章乃是这些：
12.en: These are the decrees and laws you must be careful to follow in the land that the Lord , the God of your fathers, has given you to possess-as long as you live in the land.

12.zh: 你们要将所赶出的国民事奉神的各地方，无论是在高山，在小山，在各青翠树下，都毁坏了；
12.en: Destroy completely all the places on the high mountains and on the hills and under every spreading tree where the nations you are dispossessing worship their gods.

12.zh: 也要拆毁他们的祭坛，打碎他们的柱像，用火焚烧他们的木偶，砍下他们雕刻的神像，并将其名从那地方除灭。
12.en: Break down their altars, smash their sacred stones and burn their Asherah poles in the fire; cut down the idols of their gods and wipe out their names from those places.

12.zh: 你们不可照他们那样事奉耶和华 ─ 你们的神。
12.en: You must not worship the Lord your God in their way.

12.zh: 但耶和华 ─ 你们的神从你们各支派中选择何处为立他名的居所，你们就当往那里去求问，
12.en: But you are to seek the place the Lord your God will choose from among all your tribes to put his Name there for his dwelling. To that place you must go;

12.zh: 将你们的燔祭 、 平安祭 、 十分取一之物，和手中的举祭，并还愿祭 、 甘心祭，以及牛群羊群中头生的，都奉到那里。
12.en: there bring your burnt offerings and sacrifices, your tithes and special gifts, what you have vowed to give and your freewill offerings, and the firstborn of your herds and flocks.

12.zh: 在那里，耶和华 ─ 你们神的面前，你们和你们的家属都可以吃，并且因你手所办的一切事蒙耶和华 ─ 你的神赐福，就都欢乐。
12.en: There, in the presence of the Lord your God, you and your families shall eat and shall rejoice in everything you have put your hand to, because the Lord your God has blessed you.

12.zh: 我们今日在这里所行的是各人行自己眼中看为正的事，你们将来不可这样行；
12.en: You are not to do as we do here today, everyone as he sees fit,

12.zh: 因为你们还没有到耶和华 ─ 你神所赐你的安息地，所给你的产业。
12.en: since you have not yet reached the resting place and the inheritance the Lord your God is giving you.

12.zh: 但你们过了约但河，得以住在耶和华 ─ 你们神使你们承受为业之地，又使你们太平，不被四围的一切仇敌扰乱，安然居住。
12.en: But you will cross the Jordan and settle in the land the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance, and he will give you rest from all your enemies around you so that you will live in safety.

12.zh: 那时要将我所吩咐你们的燔祭 、 平安祭 、 十分取一之物，和手中的举祭，并向耶和华许愿献的一切美祭，都奉到耶和华 ─ 你们神所选择要立为他名的居所。
12.en: Then to the place the Lord your God will choose as a dwelling for his Name-there you are to bring everything I command you: your burnt offerings and sacrifices, your tithes and special gifts, and all the choice possessions you have vowed to the Lord .

12.zh: 你们和儿女 、 仆婢，并住在你们城里无分无业的利未人，都要在耶和华 ─ 你们的神面前欢乐。
12.en: And there rejoice before the Lord your God, you, your sons and daughters, your menservants and maidservants, and the Levites from your towns, who have no allotment or inheritance of their own.

12.zh: 你要谨慎，不可在你所看中的各处献燔祭。
12.en: Be careful not to sacrifice your burnt offerings anywhere you please.

12.zh: 惟独耶和华从你那一支派中所选择的地方，你就要在那里献燔祭，行我一切所吩咐你的。
12.en: Offer them only at the place the Lord will choose in one of your tribes, and there observe everything I command you.

12.zh: 然而，在你各城里都可以照耶和华 ─ 你神所赐你的福分，随心所欲宰牲吃肉；无论洁净人不洁净人都可以吃，就如吃羚羊与鹿一般。
12.en: Nevertheless, you may slaughter your animals in any of your towns and eat as much of the meat as you want, as if it were gazelle or deer, according to the blessing the Lord your God gives you. Both the ceremonially unclean and the clean may eat it.

12.zh: 只是不可吃血，要倒在地上，如同倒水一样。
12.en: But you must not eat the blood; pour it out on the ground like water.

12.zh: 你的五谷 、 新酒，和油的十分之一，或是牛群羊群中头生的，或是你许愿献的，甘心献的，或是手中的举祭，都不可在你城里吃。
12.en: You must not eat in your own towns the tithe of your grain and new wine and oil, or the firstborn of your herds and flocks, or whatever you have vowed to give, or your freewill offerings or special gifts.

12.zh: 但要在耶和华 ─ 你的神面前吃，在耶和华 ─ 你神所要选择的地方，你和儿女 、 仆婢，并住在你城里的利未人，都可以吃；也要因你手所办的，在耶和华 ─ 你神面前欢乐。
12.en: Instead, you are to eat them in the presence of the Lord your God at the place the Lord your God will choose-you, your sons and daughters, your menservants and maidservants, and the Levites from your towns-and you are to rejoice before the Lord your God in everything you put your hand to.

12.zh: 你要谨慎，在你所住的地方永不可丢弃利未人。
12.en: Be careful not to neglect the Levites as long as you live in your land.

12.zh: 耶和华 ─ 你的神照他所应许扩张你境界的时候，你心里想要吃肉，说：我要吃肉，就可以随心所欲地吃肉。
12.en: When the Lord your God has enlarged your territory as he promised you, and you crave meat and say, "I would like some meat," then you may eat as much of it as you want.

12.zh: 耶和华 ─ 你神所选择要立他名的地方若离你太远，就可以照我所吩咐的，将耶和华赐给你的牛羊取些宰了，可以随心所欲在你城里吃。
12.en: If the place where the Lord your God chooses to put his Name is too far away from you, you may slaughter animals from the herds and flocks the Lord has given you, as I have commanded you, and in your own towns you may eat as much of them as you want.

12.zh: 你吃那肉，要像吃羚羊与鹿一般；无论洁净人不洁净人都可以吃。
12.en: Eat them as you would gazelle or deer. Both the ceremonially unclean and the clean may eat.

12.zh: 只是你要心意坚定，不可吃血，因为血是生命；不可将血（原文作生命）与肉同吃。
12.en: But be sure you do not eat the blood, because the blood is the life, and you must not eat the life with the meat.

12.zh: 不可吃血，要倒在地上，如同倒水一样。
12.en: You must not eat the blood; pour it out on the ground like water.

12.zh: 不可吃血。这样，你行耶和华眼中看为正的事，你和你的子孙就可以得福。
12.en: Do not eat it, so that it may go well with you and your children after you, because you will be doing what is right in the eyes of the Lord .

12.zh: 只是你分别为圣的物和你的还愿祭要奉到耶和华所选择的地方去。
12.en: But take your consecrated things and whatever you have vowed to give, and go to the place the Lord will choose.

12.zh: 你的燔祭，连肉带血，都要献在耶和华 ─ 你神的坛上。平安祭的血要倒在耶和华 ─ 你神的坛上；平安祭的肉，你自己可以吃。
12.en: Present your burnt offerings on the altar of the Lord your God, both the meat and the blood. The blood of your sacrifices must be poured beside the altar of the Lord your God, but you may eat the meat.

12.zh: 你要谨守听从我所吩咐的一切话，行耶和华 ─ 你神眼中看为善，看为正的事。这样，你和你的子孙就可以永远享福。
12.en: Be careful to obey all these regulations I am giving you, so that it may always go well with you and your children after you, because you will be doing what is good and right in the eyes of the Lord your God.

12.zh: 耶和华 ─ 你神将你要去赶出的国民从你面前剪除，你得了他们的地居住，
12.en: The Lord your God will cut off before you the nations you are about to invade and dispossess. But when you have driven them out and settled in their land,

12.zh: 那时就要谨慎，不可在他们除灭之后随从他们的恶俗，陷入网罗，也不可访问他们的神说：这些国民怎样事奉他们的神，我也要照样行。
12.en: and after they have been destroyed before you, be careful not to be ensnared by inquiring about their gods, saying, "How do these nations serve their gods? We will do the same."

12.zh: 你不可向耶和华 ─ 你的神这样行，因为他们向他们的神行了耶和华所憎嫌所恨恶的一切事，甚至将自己的儿女用火焚烧，献与他们的神。
12.en: You must not worship the Lord your God in their way, because in worshiping their gods, they do all kinds of detestable things the Lord hates. They even burn their sons and daughters in the fire as sacrifices to their gods.

12.zh: 凡我所吩咐的，你们都要谨守遵行，不可加添，也不可删减。
12.en: See that you do all I command you; do not add to it or take away from it.

13.zh: 你们中间若有先知或是做梦的起来，向你显个神迹奇事，
13.en: If a prophet, or one who foretells by dreams, appears among you and announces to you a miraculous sign or wonder,

13.zh: 对你说：我们去随从你素来所不认识的别神，事奉他罢。他所显的神迹奇事虽有应验，
13.en: and if the sign or wonder of which he has spoken takes place, and he says, "Let us follow other gods" (gods you have not known) "and let us worship them,"

13.zh: 你也不可听那先知或是那做梦之人的话；因为这是耶和华 ─ 你们的神试验你们，要知道你们是尽心尽性爱耶和华 ─ 你们的神不是。
13.en: you must not listen to the words of that prophet or dreamer. The Lord your God is testing you to find out whether you love him with all your heart and with all your soul.

13.zh: 你们要顺从耶和华 ─ 你们的神，敬畏他，谨守他的诫命，听从他的话，事奉他，专靠他。
13.en: It is the Lord your God you must follow, and him you must revere. Keep his commands and obey him; serve him and hold fast to him.

13.zh: 那先知或是那做梦的既用言语叛逆那领你们出埃及地 、 救赎你脱离为奴之家的耶和华 ─ 你们的神，要勾引你离开耶和华 ─ 你神所吩咐你行的道，你便要将他治死。这样，就把那恶从你们中间除掉。
13.en: That prophet or dreamer must be put to death, because he preached rebellion against the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt and redeemed you from the land of slavery; he has tried to turn you from the way the Lord your God commanded you to follow. You must purge the evil from among you.

13.zh: 你的同胞弟兄，或是你的儿女，或是你怀中的妻，或是如同你性命的朋友，若暗中引诱你，说：我们不如去事奉你和你列祖素来所不认识的别神 ─
13.en: If your very own brother, or your son or daughter, or the wife you love, or your closest friend secretly entices you, saying, "Let us go and worship other gods" (gods that neither you nor your fathers have known,

13.zh: 是你四围列国的神。无论是离你近，离你远，从地这边到地那边的神，
13.en: gods of the peoples around you, whether near or far, from one end of the land to the other),

13.zh: 你不可依从他，也不可听从他，眼不可顾惜他。你不可怜恤他，也不可遮庇他，
13.en: do not yield to him or listen to him. Show him no pity. Do not spare him or shield him.

13.zh: 总要杀他；你先下手，然后众民也下手，将他治死。
13.en: You must certainly put him to death. Your hand must be the first in putting him to death, and then the hands of all the people.

13.zh: 要用石头打死他，因为他想要勾引你离开那领你出埃及地为奴之家的耶和华 ─ 你的神。
13.en: Stone him to death, because he tried to turn you away from the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.

13.zh: 以色列众人都要听见害怕，就不敢在你们中间再行这样的恶了。
13.en: Then all Israel will hear and be afraid, and no one among you will do such an evil thing again.

13.zh: 在耶和华 ─ 你神所赐你居住的各城中，你若听人说，有些匪类从你们中间的一座城出来勾引本城的居民，说：我们不如去事奉你们素来所不认识的别神；
13.en: If you hear it said about one of the towns the Lord your God is giving you to live in
that wicked men have arisen among you and have led the people of their town astray, saying, "Let us go and worship other gods" (gods you have not known),

13.zh: 你就要探听，查究，细细地访问，果然是真，准有这可憎恶的事行在你们中间，
13.en: then you must inquire, probe and investigate it thoroughly. And if it is true and it has been proved that this detestable thing has been done among you,

13.zh: 你必要用刀杀那城里的居民，把城里所有的，连牲畜，都用刀杀尽。
13.en: you must certainly put to the sword all who live in that town. Destroy it completely, both its people and its livestock.

13.zh: 你从那城里所夺的财物都要堆积在街市上，用火将城和其内所夺的财物都在耶和华 ─ 你神面前烧尽；那城就永为荒堆，不可再建造。
13.en: Gather all the plunder of the town into the middle of the public square and completely burn the town and all its plunder as a whole burnt offering to the Lord your God. It is to remain a ruin forever, never to be rebuilt.

13.zh: 那当毁灭的物连一点都不可粘你的手。你要听从耶和华 ─ 你神的话，遵守我今日所吩咐你的一切诫命，行耶和华 ─ 你神眼中看为正的事，耶和华就必转意，不发烈怒，恩待你，怜恤你，照他向你列祖所起的誓使你人数增多。
13.en: None of those condemned things shall be found in your hands, so that the Lord will turn from his fierce anger; he will show you mercy, have compassion on you, and increase your numbers, as he promised on oath to your forefathers,
because you obey the Lord your God, keeping all his commands that I am giving you today and doing what is right in his eyes.

14.zh: 你们是耶和华 ─ 你们神的儿女。不可为死人用刀划身，也不可将额上剃光。
14.en: You are the children of the Lord your God. Do not cut yourselves or shave the front of your heads for the dead,

14.zh: 因为你归耶和华 ─ 你神为圣洁的民，耶和华从地上的万民中拣选你特作自己的子民。
14.en: for you are a people holy to the Lord your God. Out of all the peoples on the face of the earth, the Lord has chosen you to be his treasured possession.

14.zh: 凡可憎的物都不可吃。
14.en: Do not eat any detestable thing.

14.zh: 可吃的牲畜就是牛 、 绵羊 、 山羊 、
14.en: These are the animals you may eat: the ox, the sheep, the goat,

14.zh: 鹿 、 羚羊 、 麃子 、 野山羊 、 麋鹿 、 黄羊 、 青羊。
14.en: the deer, the gazelle, the roe deer, the wild goat, the ibex, the antelope and the mountain sheep.

14.zh: 凡分蹄成为两瓣又倒嚼的走兽，你们都可以吃。
14.en: You may eat any animal that has a split hoof divided in two and that chews the cud.

14.zh: 但那些倒嚼或是分蹄之中不可吃的乃是骆驼 、 兔子 、 沙番 ─ 因为是倒嚼不分蹄，就与你们不洁净；
14.en: However, of those that chew the cud or that have a split hoof completely divided you may not eat the camel, the rabbit or the coney. Although they chew the cud, they do not have a split hoof; they are ceremonially unclean for you.

14.zh: 猪 ─ 因为是分蹄却不倒嚼，就与你们不洁净。这些兽的肉，你们不可吃，死的也不可摸。
14.en: The pig is also unclean; although it has a split hoof, it does not chew the cud. You are not to eat their meat or touch their carcasses.

14.zh: 水中可吃的乃是这些：凡有翅有鳞的都可以吃；
14.en: Of all the creatures living in the water, you may eat any that has fins and scales.

14.zh: 凡无翅无鳞的都不可吃，是与你们不洁净。
14.en: But anything that does not have fins and scales you may not eat; for you it is unclean.

14.zh: 凡洁净的鸟，你们都可以吃。
14.en: You may eat any clean bird.

14.zh: 不可吃的乃是雕 、 狗头雕 、 红头雕 、
14.en: But these you may not eat: the eagle, the vulture, the black vulture,

14.zh: 鹯 、 小鹰 、 鹞鹰与其类，
14.en: the red kite, the black kite, any kind of falcon,

14.zh: 乌鸦与其类，
14.en: any kind of raven,

14.zh: 鸵鸟 、 夜鹰 、 鱼鹰 、 鹰与其类，
14.en: the horned owl, the screech owl, the gull, any kind of hawk,

14.zh: 鸮鸟 、 猫头鹰 、 角鸱 、
14.en: the little owl, the great owl, the white owl,

14.zh: 鹈鹕 、 秃雕 、 鸬鹚 、
14.en: the desert owl, the osprey, the cormorant,

14.zh: 鹳 、 鹭鸶与其类，戴鵀与蝙蝠。
14.en: the stork, any kind of heron, the hoopoe and the bat.

14.zh: 凡有翅膀爬行的物是与你们不洁净，都不可吃。
14.en: All flying insects that swarm are unclean to you; do not eat them.

14.zh: 凡洁净的鸟，你们都可以吃。
14.en: But any winged creature that is clean you may eat.

14.zh: 凡自死的，你们都不可吃，可以给你城里寄居的吃，或卖与外人吃，因为你是归耶和华 ─ 你神为圣洁的民。不可用山羊羔母的奶煮山羊羔。
14.en: Do not eat anything you find already dead. You may give it to an alien living in any of your towns, and he may eat it, or you may sell it to a foreigner. But you are a people holy to the Lord your God. Do not cook a young goat in its mother's milk.

14.zh: 你要把你撒种所产的，就是你田地每年所出的，十分取一分；
14.en: Be sure to set aside a tenth of all that your fields produce each year.

14.zh: 又要把你的五谷 、 新酒 、 和油的十分之一，并牛群羊群中头生的，吃在耶和华 ─ 你神面前，就是他所选择要立为他名的居所。这样，你可以学习时常敬畏耶和华 ─ 你的神。
