14.en: Eat the tithe of your grain, new wine and oil, and the firstborn of your herds and flocks in the presence of the Lord your God at the place he will choose as a dwelling for his Name, so that you may learn to revere the Lord your God always.

14.zh: 当耶和华 ─ 你神赐福与你的时候，耶和华 ─ 你神所选择要立为他名的地方若离你太远，那路也太长，使你不能把这物带到那里去，
14.en: But if that place is too distant and you have been blessed by the Lord your God and cannot carry your tithe (because the place where the Lord will choose to put his Name is so far away),

14.zh: 你就可以换成银子，将银子包起来，拿在手中，往耶和华 ─ 你神所要选择的地方去。
14.en: then exchange your tithe for silver, and take the silver with you and go to the place the Lord your God will choose.

14.zh: 你用这银子，随心所欲，或买牛羊，或买清酒浓酒，凡你心所想的都可以买；你和你的家属在耶和华 ─ 你神的面前吃喝快乐。
14.en: Use the silver to buy whatever you like: cattle, sheep, wine or other fermented drink, or anything you wish. Then you and your household shall eat there in the presence of the Lord your God and rejoice.

14.zh: 住在你城里的利未人，你不可丢弃他，因为他在你们中间无分无业。
14.en: And do not neglect the Levites living in your towns, for they have no allotment or inheritance of their own.

14.zh: 每逢三年的末一年，你要将本年的土产十分之一都取出来，积存在你的城中。
14.en: At the end of every three years, bring all the tithes of that year's produce and store it in your towns,

14.zh: 在你城里无分无业的利未人，和你城里寄居的，并孤儿寡妇，都可以来，吃得饱足。这样，耶和华 ─ 你的神必在你手里所办的一切事上赐福与你。
14.en: so that the Levites (who have no allotment or inheritance of their own) and the aliens, the fatherless and the widows who live in your towns may come and eat and be satisfied, and so that the Lord your God may bless you in all the work of your hands.

15.zh: 每逢七年末一年，你要施行豁免。
15.en: At the end of every seven yearsyou must cancel debts.

15.zh: 豁免的定例乃是这样：凡债主要把所借给邻舍的豁免了；不可向邻舍和弟兄追讨，因为耶和华的豁免年已经宣告了。
15.en: This is how it is to be done: Every creditor shall cancel the loan he has made to his fellow Israelite. He shall not require payment from his fellow Israelite or brother, because the Lord 's time for canceling debts has been proclaimed.

15.zh: 若借给外邦人，你可以向他追讨；但借给你弟兄，无论是甚么，你要松手豁免了。
15.en: You may require payment from a foreigner, but you must cancel any debt your brother owes you.

15.zh: 你若留意听从耶和华 ─ 你神的话，谨守遵行我今日所吩咐你这一切的命令，就必在你们中间没有穷人了（在耶和华 ─ 你神所赐你为业的地上，耶和华必大大赐福与你。）
15.en: However, there should be no poor among you, for in the land the Lord your God is giving you to possess as your inheritance, he will richly bless you,

15.zh: a
15.en: if only you fully obey the Lord your God and are careful to follow all these commands I am giving you today.

15.zh: 因为耶和华 ─ 你的神必照他所应许你的赐福与你。你必借给许多国民，却不至向他们借贷；你必管辖许多国民，他们却不能管辖你。
15.en: For the Lord your God will bless you as he has promised, and you will lend to many nations but will borrow from none. You will rule over many nations but none will rule over you.

15.zh: 在耶和华 ─ 你神所赐你的地上，无论那一座城里，你弟兄中若有一个穷人，你不可忍著心 、 揝著手不帮补你穷乏的弟兄。
15.en: If there is a poor man among your brothers in any of the towns of the land that the Lord your God is giving you, do not be hardhearted or tightfisted toward your poor brother.

15.zh: 总要向他松开手，照他所缺乏的借给他，补他的不足。
15.en: Rather be openhanded and freely lend him whatever he needs.

15.zh: 你要谨慎，不可心里起恶念，说：第七年的豁免年快到了，你便恶眼看你穷乏的弟兄，甚么都不给他，以致他因你求告耶和华，罪便归于你了。
15.en: Be careful not to harbor this wicked thought: "The seventh year, the year for canceling debts, is near," so that you do not show ill will toward your needy brother and give him nothing. He may then appeal to the Lord against you, and you will be found guilty of sin.

15.zh: 你总要给他，给他的时候心里不可愁烦；因耶和华 ─ 你的神必在你这一切所行的，并你手里所办的事上，赐福与你。
15.en: Give generously to him and do so without a grudging heart; then because of this the Lord your God will bless you in all your work and in everything you put your hand to.

15.zh: 原来那地上的穷人永不断绝；所以我吩咐你说：总要向你地上困苦穷乏的弟兄松开手。
15.en: There will always be poor people in the land. Therefore I command you to be openhanded toward your brothers and toward the poor and needy in your land.

15.zh: 你弟兄中，若有一个希伯来男人或希伯来女人被卖给你，服事你六年，到第七年就要任他自由出去。
15.en: If a fellow Hebrew, a man or a woman, sells himself to you and serves you six years, in the seventh year you must let him go free.

15.zh: 你任他自由的时候，不可使他空手而去，
15.en: And when you release him, do not send him away empty-handed.

15.zh: 要从你羊群 、 禾场 、 酒醡之中多多的给他；耶和华 ─ 你的神怎样赐福与你，你也要照样给他。
15.en: Supply him liberally from your flock, your threshing floor and your winepress. Give to him as the Lord your God has blessed you.

15.zh: 要记念你在埃及地作过奴仆，耶和华 ─ 你的神将你救赎；因此，我今日吩咐你这件事。
15.en: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt and the Lord your God redeemed you. That is why I give you this command today.

15.zh: 他若对你说：我不愿意离开你，是因他爱你和你的家，且因在你那里很好，
15.en: But if your servant says to you, "I do not want to leave you," because he loves you and your family and is well off with you,

15.zh: 你就要拿锥子将他的耳朵在门上刺透，他便永为你的奴仆了。你待婢女也要这样。
15.en: then take an awl and push it through his ear lobe into the door, and he will become your servant for life. Do the same for your maidservant.

15.zh: 你任他自由的时候，不可以为难事，因他服事你六年，较比雇工的工价多加一倍了。耶和华 ─ 你的神就必在你所做的一切事上赐福与你。
15.en: Do not consider it a hardship to set your servant free, because his service to you these six years has been worth twice as much as that of a hired hand. And the Lord your God will bless you in everything you do.

15.zh: 你牛群羊群中头生的，凡是公的，都要分别为圣，归耶和华 ─ 你的神。牛群中头生的，不可用他耕地；羊群中头生的，不可剪毛。
15.en: Set apart for the Lord your God every firstborn male of your herds and flocks. Do not put the firstborn of your oxen to work, and do not shear the firstborn of your sheep.

15.zh: 这头生的，你和你的家属，每年要在耶和华所选择的地方，在耶和华 ─ 你神面前吃。
15.en: Each year you and your family are to eat them in the presence of the Lord your God at the place he will choose.

15.zh: 这头生的若有甚么残疾，就如瘸腿的 、 瞎眼的，无论有甚么恶残疾，都不可献给耶和华 ─ 你的神；
15.en: If an animal has a defect, is lame or blind, or has any serious flaw, you must not sacrifice it to the Lord your God.

15.zh: 可以在你城里吃；洁净人与不洁净人都可以吃，就如吃羚羊与鹿一般。
15.en: You are to eat it in your own towns. Both the ceremonially unclean and the clean may eat it, as if it were gazelle or deer.

15.zh: 只是不可吃他的血；要倒在地上，如同倒水一样。
15.en: But you must not eat the blood; pour it out on the ground like water.

16.zh: 你要注意亚笔月，向耶和华 ─ 你的神守逾越节，因为耶和华 ─ 你的神在亚笔月夜间领你出埃及。
16.en: Observe the month of Abib and celebrate the Passover of the Lord your God, because in the month of Abib he brought you out of Egypt by night.

16.zh: 你当在耶和华所选择要立为他名的居所，从牛群羊群中，将逾越节的祭牲献给耶和华 ─ 你的神。
16.en: Sacrifice as the Passover to the Lord your God an animal from your flock or herd at the place the Lord will choose as a dwelling for his Name.

16.zh: 你吃这祭牲，不可吃有酵的饼；七日之内要吃无酵饼，就是困苦饼 ─ 你本是急忙出了埃及地 ─ 要叫你一生一世记念你从埃及地出来的日子。
16.en: Do not eat it with bread made with yeast, but for seven days eat unleavened bread, the bread of affliction, because you left Egypt in haste-so that all the days of your life you may remember the time of your departure from Egypt.

16.zh: 在你四境之内，七日不可见面酵，头一日晚上所献的肉，一点不可留到早晨。
16.en: Let no yeast be found in your possession in all your land for seven days. Do not let any of the meat you sacrifice on the evening of the first day remain until morning.

16.zh: 在耶和华 ─ 你神所赐的各城中，你不可献逾越节的祭；
16.en: You must not sacrifice the Passover in any town the Lord your God gives you

16.zh: 只当在耶和华 ─ 你神所选择要立为他名的居所，晚上日落的时候，乃是你出埃及的时候，献逾越节的祭。
16.en: except in the place he will choose as a dwelling for his Name. There you must sacrifice the Passover in the evening, when the sun goes down, on the anniversary of your departure from Egypt.

16.zh: 当在耶和华 ─ 你神所选择的地方把肉烤了吃（烤：或作煮），次日早晨就回到你的帐棚去。
16.en: Roast it and eat it at the place the Lord your God will choose. Then in the morning return to your tents.

16.zh: 你要吃无酵饼六日，第七日要向耶和华 ─ 你的神守严肃会，不可做工。
16.en: For six days eat unleavened bread and on the seventh day hold an assembly to the Lord your God and do no work.

16.zh: 你要计算七七日：从你开镰收割禾稼时算起，共计七七日。
16.en: Count off seven weeks from the time you begin to put the sickle to the standing grain.

16.zh: 你要照耶和华 ─ 你神所赐你的福，手里拿著甘心祭，献在耶和华 ─ 你的神面前，守七七节。
16.en: Then celebrate the Feast of Weeks to the Lord your God by giving a freewill offering in proportion to the blessings the Lord your God has given you.

16.zh: 你和你儿女 、 仆婢，并住在你城里的利未人，以及在你们中间寄居的与孤儿寡妇，都要在耶和华 ─ 你神所选择立为他名的居所，在耶和华 ─ 你的神面前欢乐。
16.en: And rejoice before the Lord your God at the place he will choose as a dwelling for his Name-you, your sons and daughters, your menservants and maidservants, the Levites in your towns, and the aliens, the fatherless and the widows living among you.

16.zh: 你也要记念你在埃及作过奴仆。你要谨守遵行这些律例。
16.en: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt, and follow carefully these decrees.

16.zh: 你把禾场的谷 、 酒醡的酒收藏以后，就要守住棚节七日。
16.en: Celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles for seven days after you have gathered the produce of your threshing floor and your winepress.

16.zh: 守节的时候，你和你儿女 、 仆婢，并住在你城里的利未人，以及寄居的与孤儿寡妇，都要欢乐。
16.en: Be joyful at your Feast-you, your sons and daughters, your menservants and maidservants, and the Levites, the aliens, the fatherless and the widows who live in your towns.

16.zh: 在耶和华所选择的地方，你当向耶和华 ─ 你的神守节七日；因为耶和华 ─ 你神在你一切的土产上和你手里所办的事上要赐福与你，你就非常的欢乐。
16.en: For seven days celebrate the Feast to the Lord your God at the place the Lord will choose. For the Lord your God will bless you in all your harvest and in all the work of your hands, and your joy will be complete.

16.zh: 你一切的男丁要在除酵节 、 七七节 、 住棚节，一年三次，在耶和华 ─ 你神所选择的地方朝见他，却不可空手朝见。
16.en: Three times a year all your men must appear before the Lord your God at the place he will choose: at the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the Feast of Weeks and the Feast of Tabernacles. No man should appear before the Lord empty-handed:

16.zh: 各人要按自己的力量，照耶和华 ─ 你神所赐的福分，奉献礼物。
16.en: Each of you must bring a gift in proportion to the way the Lord your God has blessed you.

16.zh: 你要在耶和华 ─ 你神所赐的各城里，按著各支派设立审判官和官长。他们必按公义的审判判断百姓。
16.en: Appoint judges and officials for each of your tribes in every town the Lord your God is giving you, and they shall judge the people fairly.

16.zh: 不可屈枉正直；不可看人的外貌。也不可受贿赂；因为贿赂能叫智慧人的眼变瞎了，又能颠倒义人的话。
16.en: Do not pervert justice or show partiality. Do not accept a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and twists the words of the righteous.

16.zh: 你要追求至公至义，好叫你存活，承受耶和华 ─ 你神所赐你的地。
16.en: Follow justice and justice alone, so that you may live and possess the land the Lord your God is giving you.

16.zh: 你为耶和华 ─ 你的神筑坛，不可在坛旁栽甚么树木作为木偶。
16.en: Do not set up any wooden Asherah pole beside the altar you build to the Lord your God,

16.zh: 也不可为自己设立柱像；这是耶和华 ─ 你神所恨恶的。
16.en: and do not erect a sacred stone, for these the Lord your God hates.

17.zh: 凡有残疾，或有甚么恶病的牛羊，你都不可献给耶和华 ─ 你的神，因为这是耶和华 ─ 你神所憎恶的。
17.en: Do not sacrifice to the Lord your God an ox or a sheep that has any defect or flaw in it, for that would be detestable to him.

17.zh: 在你们中间，在耶和华 ─ 你神所赐你的诸城中，无论那座城里，若有人，或男或女，行耶和华 ─ 你神眼中看为恶的事，违背了他的约，
17.en: If a man or woman living among you in one of the towns the Lord gives you is found doing evil in the eyes of the Lord your God in violation of his covenant,

17.zh: 去事奉敬拜别神，或拜日头，或拜月亮，或拜天象，是主不曾吩咐的；
17.en: and contrary to my command has worshiped other gods, bowing down to them or to the sun or the moon or the stars of the sky,

17.zh: 有人告诉你，你也听见了，就要细细的探听，果然是真，准有这可憎恶的事行在以色列中，
17.en: and this has been brought to your attention, then you must investigate it thoroughly. If it is true and it has been proved that this detestable thing has been done in Israel,

17.zh: 你就要将行这恶事的男人或女人拉到城门外，用石头将他打死。
17.en: take the man or woman who has done this evil deed to your city gate and stone that person to death.

17.zh: 要凭两三个人的口作见证将那当死的人治死；不可凭一个人的口作见证将他治死。
17.en: On the testimony of two or three witnesses a man shall be put to death, but no one shall be put to death on the testimony of only one witness.

17.zh: 见证人要先下手，然后众民也下手将他治死。这样，就把那恶从你们中间除掉。
17.en: The hands of the witnesses must be the first in putting him to death, and then the hands of all the people. You must purge the evil from among you.

17.zh: 你城中若起了争讼的事，或因流血，或因争竞，或因殴打，是你难断的案件，你就当起来，往耶和华 ─ 你神所选择的地方
17.en: If cases come before your courts that are too difficult for you to judge-whether bloodshed, lawsuits or assaults-take them to the place the Lord your God will choose.

17.zh: 去见祭司利未人，并当时的审判官，求问他们，他们必将判语指示你。
17.en: Go to the priests, who are Levites, and to the judge who is in office at that time. Inquire of them and they will give you the verdict.

17.zh: 他们在耶和华所选择的地方指示你的判语，你必照著他们所指教你的一切话谨守遵行。
17.en: You must act according to the decisions they give you at the place the Lord will choose. Be careful to do everything they direct you to do.

17.zh: 要按他们所指教你的律法，照他们所断定的去行；他们所指示你的判语，你不可偏离左右。
17.en: Act according to the law they teach you and the decisions they give you. Do not turn aside from what they tell you, to the right or to the left.

17.zh: 若有人擅敢不听从那侍立在耶和华 ─ 你神面前的祭司，或不听从审判官，那人就必治死；这样，便将那恶从以色列中除掉。
17.en: The man who shows contempt for the judge or for the priest who stands ministering there to the Lord your God must be put to death. You must purge the evil from Israel.

17.zh: 众百姓都要听见害怕，不再擅敢行事。
17.en: All the people will hear and be afraid, and will not be contemptuous again.

17.zh: 到了耶和华 ─ 你神所赐你的地，得了那地居住的时候，若说：我要立王治理我，像四围的国一样。
17.en: When you enter the land the Lord your God is giving you and have taken possession of it and settled in it, and you say, "Let us set a king over us like all the nations around us,"

17.zh: 你总要立耶和华 ─ 你神所拣选的人为王。必从你弟兄中立一人；不可立你弟兄以外的人为王。
17.en: be sure to appoint over you the king the Lord your God chooses. He must be from among your own brothers. Do not place a foreigner over you, one who is not a brother Israelite.

17.zh: 只是王不可为自己加添马匹，也不可使百姓回埃及去，为要加添他的马匹，因耶和华曾吩咐你们说：不可再回那条路去。
17.en: The king, moreover, must not acquire great numbers of horses for himself or make the people return to Egypt to get more of them, for the Lord has told you, "You are not to go back that way again."

17.zh: 他也不可为自己多立妃嫔，恐怕他的心偏邪；也不可为自己多积金银。
17.en: He must not take many wives, or his heart will be led astray. He must not accumulate large amounts of silver and gold.

17.zh: 他登了国位，就要将祭司利未人面前的这律法书，为自己抄录一本，
17.en: When he takes the throne of his kingdom, he is to write for himself on a scroll a copy of this law, taken from that of the priests, who are Levites.

17.zh: 存在他那里，要平生诵读，好学习敬畏耶和华 ─ 他的神，谨守遵行这律法书上的一切言语和这些律例，
17.en: It is to be with him, and he is to read it all the days of his life so that he may learn to revere the Lord his God and follow carefully all the words of this law and these decrees

17.zh: 免得他向弟兄心高气傲，偏左偏右，离了这诫命。这样，他和他的子孙便可在以色列中，在国位上年长日久。
17.en: and not consider himself better than his brothers and turn from the law to the right or to the left. Then he and his descendants will reign a long time over his kingdom in Israel.

18.zh: 祭司利未人和利未全支派必在以色列中无分无业；他们所吃用的就是献给耶和华的火祭和一切所捐的。
18.en: The priests, who are Levites-indeed the whole tribe of Levi-are to have no allotment or inheritance with Israel. They shall live on the offerings made to the Lord by fire, for that is their inheritance.

18.zh: 他们在弟兄中必没有产业；耶和华是他们的产业，正如耶和华所应许他们的。
18.en: They shall have no inheritance among their brothers; the Lord is their inheritance, as he promised them.

18.zh: 祭司从百姓所当得的分乃是这样：凡献牛或羊为祭的，要把前腿和两腮并脾胃给祭司。
18.en: This is the share due the priests from the people who sacrifice a bull or a sheep: the shoulder, the jowls and the inner parts.

18.zh: 初收的五谷 、 新酒和油，并初剪的羊毛，也要给他；
18.en: You are to give them the firstfruits of your grain, new wine and oil, and the first wool from the shearing of your sheep,

18.zh: 因为耶和华 ─ 你的神从你各支派中将他拣选出来，使他和他子孙永远奉耶和华的名侍立，事奉。
18.en: for the Lord your God has chosen them and their descendants out of all your tribes to stand and minister in the Lord 's name always.

18.zh: 利未人无论寄居在以色列中的那一座城，若从那里出来，一心愿意到耶和华所选择的地方，
18.en: If a Levite moves from one of your towns anywhere in Israel where he is living, and comes in all earnestness to the place the Lord will choose,

18.zh: 就要奉耶和华 ─ 他神的名事奉，像他众弟兄利未人侍立在耶和华面前事奉一样。
18.en: he may minister in the name of the Lord his God like all his fellow Levites who serve there in the presence of the Lord .

18.zh: 除了他卖祖父产业所得的以外，还要得一分祭物与他们同吃。
18.en: He is to share equally in their benefits, even though he has received money from the sale of family possessions.

18.zh: 你到了耶和华 ─ 你神所赐之地，那些国民所行可憎恶的事，你不可学著行。
18.en: When you enter the land the Lord your God is giving you, do not learn to imitate the detestable ways of the nations there.

18.zh: 你们中间不可有人使儿女经火，也不可有占卜的 、 观兆的 、 用法术的 、 行邪术的 、
18.en: Let no one be found among you who sacrifices his son or daughter in the fire, who practices divination or sorcery, interprets omens, engages in witchcraft,

18.zh: 用迷术的 、 交鬼的 、 行巫术的 、 过阴的。
18.en: or casts spells, or who is a medium or spiritist or who consults the dead.

18.zh: 凡行这些事的都为耶和华所憎恶；因那些国民行这可憎恶的事，所以耶和华 ─ 你的神将他们从你面前赶出。
18.en: Anyone who does these things is detestable to the Lord , and because of these detestable practices the Lord your God will drive out those nations before you.

18.zh: 你要在耶和华 ─ 你的神面前作完全人。
18.en: You must be blameless before the Lord your God.

18.zh: 因你所要赶出的那些国民都听信观兆的和占卜的，至于你，耶和华 ─ 你的神从来不许你这样行。
18.en: The nations you will dispossess listen to those who practice sorcery or divination. But as for you, the Lord your God has not permitted you to do so.

18.zh: 耶和华 ─ 你的神要从你们弟兄中间给你兴起一位先知，像我，你们要听从他。
18.en: The Lord your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your own brothers. You must listen to him.

18.zh: 正如你在何烈山大会的日子求耶和华 ─ 你神一切的话，说：求你不再叫我听见耶和华 ─ 我神的声音，也不再叫我看见这大火，免得我死亡。
18.en: For this is what you asked of the Lord your God at Horeb on the day of the assembly when you said, "Let us not hear the voice of the Lord our God nor see this great fire anymore, or we will die."

18.zh: 耶和华就对我说：他们所说的是。
18.en: The Lord said to me: "What they say is good.

18.zh: 我必在他们弟兄中间给他们兴起一位先知，像你。我要将当说的话传给他；他要将我一切所吩咐的都传给他们。
18.en: I will raise up for them a prophet like you from among their brothers; I will put my words in his mouth, and he will tell them everything I command him.

18.zh: 谁不听他奉我名所说的话，我必讨谁的罪。
18.en: If anyone does not listen to my words that the prophet speaks in my name, I myself will call him to account.

18.zh: 若有先知擅敢托我的名说我所未曾吩咐他说的话，或是奉别神的名说话，那先知就必治死。
18.en: But a prophet who presumes to speak in my name anything I have not commanded him to say, or a prophet who speaks in the name of other gods, must be put to death."

18.zh: 你心里若说：耶和华所未曾吩咐的话，我们怎能知道呢？
18.en: You may say to yourselves, "How can we know when a message has not been spoken by the Lord ?"

18.zh: 先知托耶和华的名说话，所说的若不成就，也无效验，这就是耶和华所未曾吩咐的，是那先知擅自说的，你不要怕他。
18.en: If what a prophet proclaims in the name of the Lord does not take place or come true, that is a message the Lord has not spoken. That prophet has spoken presumptuously. Do not be afraid of him.

19.zh: 耶和华 ─ 你神将列国之民剪除的时候，耶和华 ─ 你神也将他们的地赐给你，你接著住他们的城邑并他们的房屋，
19.en: When the Lord your God has destroyed the nations whose land he is giving you, and when you have driven them out and settled in their towns and houses,

19.zh: 就要在耶和华 ─ 你神所赐你为业的地上分定三座城。
19.en: then set aside for yourselves three cities centrally located in the land the Lord your God is giving you to possess.

19.zh: 要将耶和华 ─ 你神使你承受为业的地分为三段；又要预备道路，使误杀人的，都可以逃到那里去。
19.en: Build roads to them and divide into three parts the land the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance, so that anyone who kills a man may flee there.

19.zh: 误杀人的逃到那里可以存活，定例乃是这样：凡素无仇恨，无心杀了人的，
19.en: This is the rule concerning the man who kills another and flees there to save his life-one who kills his neighbor unintentionally, without malice aforethought.

19.zh: 就如人与邻舍同入树林砍伐树木，手拿斧子一砍，本想砍下树木，不料，斧头脱了把，飞落在邻舍身上，以致于死，这人逃到那些城的一座城，就可以存活，
19.en: For instance, a man may go into the forest with his neighbor to cut wood, and as he swings his ax to fell a tree, the head may fly off and hit his neighbor and kill him. That man may flee to one of these cities and save his life.

19.zh: 免得报血仇的，心中火热追赶他，因路远就追上，将他杀死；其实他不该死，因为他与被杀的素无仇恨。
19.en: Otherwise, the avenger of blood might pursue him in a rage, overtake him if the distance is too great, and kill him even though he is not deserving of death, since he did it to his neighbor without malice aforethought.

19.zh: 所以我吩咐你说，要分定三座城。
19.en: This is why I command you to set aside for yourselves three cities.

19.zh: 耶和华 ─ 你神若照他向你列祖所起的誓扩张你的境界，将所应许赐你列祖的地全然给你，
19.en: If the Lord your God enlarges your territory, as he promised on oath to your forefathers, and gives you the whole land he promised them,

19.zh: 你若谨守遵行我今日所吩咐的这一切诫命，爱耶和华 ─ 你的神，常常遵行他的道，就要在这三座城之外，再添三座城，
19.en: because you carefully follow all these laws I command you today-to love the Lord your God and to walk always in his ways-then you are to set aside three more cities.

19.zh: 免得无辜之人的血流在耶和华 ─ 你神所赐你为业的地上，流血的罪就归于你。
19.en: Do this so that innocent blood will not be shed in your land, which the Lord your God is giving you as your inheritance, and so that you will not be guilty of bloodshed.

19.zh: 若有人恨他的邻舍，埋伏著起来击杀他，以致于死，便逃到这些城的一座城，
19.en: But if a man hates his neighbor and lies in wait for him, assaults and kills him, and then flees to one of these cities,

19.zh: 本城的长老就要打发人去，从那里带出他来，交在报血仇的手中，将他治死。
19.en: the elders of his town shall send for him, bring him back from the city, and hand him over to the avenger of blood to die.

19.zh: 你眼不可顾惜他，却要从以色列中除掉流无辜血的罪，使你可以得福。
19.en: Show him no pity. You must purge from Israel the guilt of shedding innocent blood, so that it may go well with you.

19.zh: 在耶和华 ─ 你神所赐你承受为业之地，不可挪移你邻舍的地界，那是先人所定的。
19.en: Do not move your neighbor's boundary stone set up by your predecessors in the inheritance you receive in the land the Lord your God is giving you to possess.

19.zh: 人无论犯甚么罪，作甚么恶，不可凭一个人的口作见证，总要凭两三个人的口作见证才可定案。
19.en: One witness is not enough to convict a man accused of any crime or offense he may have committed. A matter must be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.

19.zh: 若有凶恶的见证人起来，见证某人作恶，
19.en: If a malicious witness takes the stand to accuse a man of a crime,

19.zh: 这两个争讼的人就要站在耶和华面前，和当时的祭司，并审判官面前，
19.en: the two men involved in the dispute must stand in the presence of the Lord before the priests and the judges who are in office at the time.

19.zh: 审判官要细细的查究，若见证人果然是作假见证的，以假见证陷害弟兄，
19.en: The judges must make a thorough investigation, and if the witness proves to be a liar, giving false testimony against his brother,

19.zh: 你们就要待他如同他想要待的弟兄。这样，就把那恶从你们中间除掉。
19.en: then do to him as he intended to do to his brother. You must purge the evil from among you.

19.zh: 别人听见都要害怕，就不敢在你们中间再行这样的恶了。
19.en: The rest of the people will hear of this and be afraid, and never again will such an evil thing be done among you.

19.zh: 你眼不可顾惜，要以命偿命，以眼还眼，以牙还牙，以手还手，以脚还脚。
19.en: Show no pity: life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.

20.zh: 你出去与仇敌争战的时候，看见马匹 、 车辆，并有比你多的人民，不要怕他们，因为领你出埃及地的耶和华 ─ 你神与你同在。
20.en: When you go to war against your enemies and see horses and chariots and an army greater than yours, do not be afraid of them, because the Lord your God, who brought you up out of Egypt, will be with you.

20.zh: 你们将要上阵的时候，祭司要到百姓面前宣告
20.en: When you are about to go into battle, the priest shall come forward and address the army.

20.zh: 说：以色列人哪，你们当听，你们今日将要与仇敌争战，不要胆怯，不要惧怕战兢，也不要因他们惊恐；
20.en: He shall say: "Hear, O Israel, today you are going into battle against your enemies. Do not be fainthearted or afraid; do not be terrified or give way to panic before them.

20.zh: 因为耶和华 ─ 你们的神与你们同去，要为你们与仇敌争战，拯救你们。
20.en: For the Lord your God is the one who goes with you to fight for you against your enemies to give you victory."

20.zh: 官长也要对百姓宣告说：谁建造房屋，尚未奉献，他可以回家去，恐怕他阵亡，别人去奉献。
20.en: The officers shall say to the army: "Has anyone built a new house and not dedicated it? Let him go home, or he may die in battle and someone else may dedicate it.

20.zh: 谁种葡萄园，尚未用所结的果子，他可以回家去，恐怕他阵亡，别人去用。
20.en: Has anyone planted a vineyard and not begun to enjoy it? Let him go home, or he may die in battle and someone else enjoy it.

20.zh: 谁聘定了妻，尚未迎娶，他可以回家去，恐怕他阵亡，别人去娶。
20.en: Has anyone become pledged to a woman and not married her? Let him go home, or he may die in battle and someone else marry her."

20.zh: 官长又要对百姓宣告说：谁惧怕胆怯，他可以回家去，恐怕他弟兄的心消化，和他一样。
20.en: Then the officers shall add, "Is any man afraid or fainthearted? Let him go home so that his brothers will not become disheartened too."

20.zh: 官长对百姓宣告完了，就当派军长率领他们。
20.en: When the officers have finished speaking to the army, they shall appoint commanders over it.

20.zh: 你临近一座城 、 要攻打的时候，先要对城里的民宣告和睦的话。
20.en: When you march up to attack a city, make its people an offer of peace.

20.zh: 他们若以和睦的话回答你，给你开了城，城里所有的人都要给你效劳，服事你；
20.en: If they accept and open their gates, all the people in it shall be subject to forced labor and shall work for you.

20.zh: 若不肯与你和好，反要与你打仗，你就要围困那城。
20.en: If they refuse to make peace and they engage you in battle, lay siege to that city.

20.zh: 耶和华 ─ 你的神把城交付你手，你就要用刀杀尽这城的男丁。
20.en: When the Lord your God delivers it into your hand, put to the sword all the men in it.

20.zh: 惟有妇女 、 孩子 、 牲畜，和城内一切的财物，你可以取为自己的掠物。耶和华 ─ 你神把你仇敌的财物赐给你，你可以吃用。
20.en: As for the women, the children, the livestock and everything else in the city, you may take these as plunder for yourselves. And you may use the plunder the Lord your God gives you from your enemies.

20.zh: 离你甚远的各城，不是这些国民的城，你都要这样待他。
20.en: This is how you are to treat all the cities that are at a distance from you and do not belong to the nations nearby.

20.zh: 但这些国民的城，耶和华 ─ 你神既赐你为业，其中凡有气息的，一个不可存留；
20.en: However, in the cities of the nations the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance, do not leave alive anything that breathes.

20.zh: 只要照耶和华 ─ 你神所吩咐的将这赫人 、 亚摩利人 、 迦南人 、 比利洗人 、 希未人 、 耶布斯人都灭绝净尽，
20.en: Completely destroy them-the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites-as the Lord your God has commanded you.

20.zh: 免得他们教导你们学习一切可憎恶的事，就是他们向自己神所行的，以致你们得罪耶和华 ─ 你们的神。
20.en: Otherwise, they will teach you to follow all the detestable things they do in worshiping their gods, and you will sin against the Lord your God.

20.zh: 你若许久围困 、 攻打所要取的一座城，就不可举斧子砍坏树木；因为你可以吃那树上的果子，不可砍伐。田间的树木岂是人，叫你糟蹋么？
20.en: When you lay siege to a city for a long time, fighting against it to capture it, do not destroy its trees by putting an ax to them, because you can eat their fruit. Do not cut them down. Are the trees of the field people, that you should besiege them?

20.zh: 惟独你所知道不是结果毁坏 、 砍伐，用以修筑营垒，攻击那与你打仗的城，直到攻塌了。
20.en: However, you may cut down trees that you know are not fruit trees and use them to build siege works until the city at war with you falls.

21.zh: 在耶和华 ─ 你神所赐你为业的地上，若遇见被杀的人倒在田野，不知道是谁杀的，
21.en: If a man is found slain, lying in a field in the land the Lord your God is giving you to possess, and it is not known who killed him,

21.zh: 长老和审判官就要出去，从被杀的人那里量起，直量到四围的城邑，
21.en: your elders and judges shall go out and measure the distance from the body to the neighboring towns.

21.zh: 看哪城离被杀的人最近，那城的长老就要从牛群中取一只未曾耕地 、 未曾负轭的母牛犊，
21.en: Then the elders of the town nearest the body shall take a heifer that has never been worked and has never worn a yoke

21.zh: 把母牛犊牵到流水 、 未曾耕种的山谷去，在谷中打折母牛犊的颈项。
21.en: and lead her down to a valley that has not been plowed or planted and where there is a flowing stream. There in the valley they are to break the heifer's neck.

21.zh: 祭司利未的子孙要近前来；因为耶和华 ─ 你的神拣选了他们事奉他，奉耶和华的名祝福，所有争讼殴打的事都要凭他们判断。
21.en: The priests, the sons of Levi, shall step forward, for the Lord your God has chosen them to minister and to pronounce blessings in the name of the Lord and to decide all cases of dispute and assault.

21.zh: 那城的众长老，就是离被杀的人最近的，要在那山谷中，在所打折颈项的母牛犊以上洗手，
21.en: Then all the elders of the town nearest the body shall wash their hands over the heifer whose neck was broken in the valley,

21.zh: 祷告（原文作回答）说：我们的手未曾流这人的血；我们的眼也未曾看见这事。
21.en: and they shall declare: "Our hands did not shed this blood, nor did our eyes see it done.

21.zh: 耶和华阿，求你赦免你所救赎的以色列民，不要使流无辜血的罪归在你的百姓以色列中间。这样，流血的罪必得赦免。
21.en: Accept this atonement for your people Israel, whom you have redeemed, O Lord , and do not hold your people guilty of the blood of an innocent man." And the bloodshed will be atoned for.

21.zh: 你行耶和华眼中看为正的事，就可以从你们中间除掉流无辜血的罪。
21.en: So you will purge from yourselves the guilt of shedding innocent blood, since you have done what is right in the eyes of the Lord .

21.zh: 你出去与仇敌争战的时候，耶和华 ─ 你的神将他们交在你手中，你就掳了他们去。
21.en: When you go to war against your enemies and the Lord your God delivers them into your hands and you take captives,

21.zh: 若在被掳的人中见有美貌的女子，恋慕他，要娶他为妻，
21.en: if you notice among the captives a beautiful woman and are attracted to her, you may take her as your wife.

21.zh: 就可以领他到你家里去；他便要剃头发，修指甲，
21.en: Bring her into your home and have her shave her head, trim her nails

21.zh: 脱去被掳时所穿的衣服，住在你家里哀哭父母一个整月，然后可以与他同房。你作他的丈夫，他作你的妻子。
21.en: and put aside the clothes she was wearing when captured. After she has lived in your house and mourned her father and mother for a full month, then you may go to her and be her husband and she shall be your wife.

21.zh: 后来你若不喜悦他，就要由他随意出去，决不可为钱卖他，也不可当婢女待他，因为你玷污了他。
21.en: If you are not pleased with her, let her go wherever she wishes. You must not sell her or treat her as a slave, since you have dishonored her.

21.zh: 人若有二妻，一为所爱，一为所恶，所爱的 、 所恶的都给他生了儿子，但长子是所恶之妻生的。
21.en: If a man has two wives, and he loves one but not the other, and both bear him sons but the firstborn is the son of the wife he does not love,

21.zh: 到了把产业分给儿子承受的时候，不可将所爱之妻生的儿子立为长子，在所恶之妻生的儿子以上，
21.en: when he wills his property to his sons, he must not give the rights of the firstborn to the son of the wife he loves in preference to his actual firstborn, the son of the wife he does not love.

21.zh: 却要认所恶之妻生的儿子为长子，将产业多加一分给他；因这儿子是他力量强壮的时候生的，长子的名分本当归他。
21.en: He must acknowledge the son of his unloved wife as the firstborn by giving him a double share of all he has. That son is the first sign of his father's strength. The right of the firstborn belongs to him.

21.zh: 人若有顽梗悖逆的儿子，不听从父母的话，他们虽惩治他，他仍不听从，
21.en: If a man has a stubborn and rebellious son who does not obey his father and mother and will not listen to them when they discipline him,

21.zh: 父母就要抓住他，将他带到本地的城门 、 本城的长老那里，
21.en: his father and mother shall take hold of him and bring him to the elders at the gate of his town.

21.zh: 对长老说：我们这儿子顽梗悖逆，不听从我们的话，是贪食好酒的人。
21.en: They shall say to the elders, "This son of ours is stubborn and rebellious. He will not obey us. He is a profligate and a drunkard."

21.zh: 本城的众人就要用石头将他打死。这样，就把那恶从你们中间除掉，以色列众人都要听见害怕。
21.en: Then all the men of his town shall stone him to death. You must purge the evil from among you. All Israel will hear of it and be afraid.

21.zh: 人若犯该死的罪，被治死了，你将他挂在木头上，
21.en: If a man guilty of a capital offense is put to death and his body is hung on a tree,

21.zh: 他的尸首不可留在木头上过夜，必要当日将他葬埋，免得玷污了耶和华 ─ 你神所赐你为业之地。因为被挂的人是在神面前受咒诅的。
21.en: you must not leave his body on the tree overnight. Be sure to bury him that same day, because anyone who is hung on a tree is under God's curse. You must not desecrate the land the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance.

22.zh: 你若看见弟兄的牛或羊失迷了路，不可佯为不见，总要把他牵回来交给你的弟兄。
22.en: If you see your brother's ox or sheep straying, do not ignore it but be sure to take it back to him.

22.zh: 你弟兄若离你远，或是你不认识他，就要牵到你家去，留在你那里，等你弟兄来寻找就还给他。
22.en: If the brother does not live near you or if you do not know who he is, take it home with you and keep it until he comes looking for it. Then give it back to him.

22.zh: 你的弟兄无论失落甚么，或是驴，或是衣服，你若遇见，都要这样行，不可佯为不见。
22.en: Do the same if you find your brother's donkey or his cloak or anything he loses. Do not ignore it.

22.zh: 你若看见弟兄的牛或驴跌倒在路上，不可佯为不见，总要帮助他拉起来。
22.en: If you see your brother's donkey or his ox fallen on the road, do not ignore it. Help him get it to its feet.

22.zh: 妇女不可穿戴男子所穿戴的，男子也不可穿妇女的衣服，因为这样行都是耶和华 ─ 你神所憎恶的。
22.en: A woman must not wear men's clothing, nor a man wear women's clothing, for the Lord your God detests anyone who does this.

22.zh: 你若路上遇见鸟窝，或在树上或在地上，里头有雏或有蛋，母鸟伏在雏上或在蛋上，你不可连母带雏一并取去。
22.en: If you come across a bird's nest beside the road, either in a tree or on the ground, and the mother is sitting on the young or on the eggs, do not take the mother with the young.

22.zh: 总要放母，只可取雏，这样你就可以享福，日子得以长久。
22.en: You may take the young, but be sure to let the mother go, so that it may go well with you and you may have a long life.

22.zh: 你若建造房屋，要在房上的四围安栏杆，免得有人从房上掉下来，流血的罪就归于你家。
22.en: When you build a new house, make a parapet around your roof so that you may not bring the guilt of bloodshed on your house if someone falls from the roof.

22.zh: 不可把两样种子种在你的葡萄园里，免得你撒种所结的和葡萄园的果子都要充公。
22.en: Do not plant two kinds of seed in your vineyard; if you do, not only the crops you plant but also the fruit of the vineyard will be defiled.

22.zh: 不可并用牛 、 驴耕地。
22.en: Do not plow with an ox and a donkey yoked together.

22.zh: 不可穿羊毛 、 细麻两样搀杂料做的衣服。
22.en: Do not wear clothes of wool and linen woven together.

22.zh: 你要在所披的外衣上四围做 䍁 子。
22.en: Make tassels on the four corners of the cloak you wear.

22.zh: 人若娶妻，与他同房之后恨恶他，
22.en: If a man takes a wife and, after lying with her, dislikes her

22.zh: 信口说他，将丑名加在他身上，说：我娶了这女子，与他同房，见他没有贞洁的凭据；
22.en: and slanders her and gives her a bad name, saying, "I married this woman, but when I approached her, I did not find proof of her virginity,"

22.zh: 女子的父母就要把女子贞洁的凭据拿出来，带到本城门长老那里。
22.en: then the girl's father and mother shall bring proof that she was a virgin to the town elders at the gate.

22.zh: 女子的父亲要对长老说：我将我的女儿给这人为妻，他恨恶他，
22.en: The girl's father will say to the elders, "I gave my daughter in marriage to this man, but he dislikes her.

22.zh: 信口说他，说：我见你的女儿没有贞洁的凭据；其实这就是我女儿贞洁的凭据。父母就把那布铺在本城的长老面前。
22.en: Now he has slandered her and said, 'I did not find your daughter to be a virgin.' But here is the proof of my daughter's virginity." Then her parents shall display the cloth before the elders of the town,

22.zh: 本城的长老要拿住那人，惩治他，
22.en: and the elders shall take the man and punish him.

22.zh: 并要罚他一百舍客勒银子，给女子的父亲，因为他将丑名加在以色列的一个处女身上。女子仍作他的妻，终身不可休他。
22.en: They shall fine him a hundred shekels of silver and give them to the girl's father, because this man has given an Israelite virgin a bad name. She shall continue to be his wife; he must not divorce her as long as he lives.

22.zh: 但这事若是真的，女子没有贞洁的凭据，
22.en: If, however, the charge is true and no proof of the girl's virginity can be found,

22.zh: 就要将女子带到他父家的门口，本城的人要用石头将他打死；因为他在父家行了淫乱，在以色列中做了丑事。这样，就把那恶从你们中间除掉。
22.en: she shall be brought to the door of her father's house and there the men of her town shall stone her to death. She has done a disgraceful thing in Israel by being promiscuous while still in her father's house. You must purge the evil from among you.

22.zh: 若遇见人与有丈夫的妇人行淫，就要将奸夫淫妇一并治死。这样，就把那恶从以色列中除掉。
22.en: If a man is found sleeping with another man's wife, both the man who slept with her and the woman must die. You must purge the evil from Israel.

22.zh: 若有处女已经许配丈夫，有人在城里遇见他，与他行淫，
22.en: If a man happens to meet in a town a virgin pledged to be married and he sleeps with her,

22.zh: 你们就要把这二人带到本城门，用石头打死 ─ 女子是因为虽在城里却没有喊叫；男子是因为玷污别人的妻。这样，就把那恶从你们中间除掉。
22.en: you shall take both of them to the gate of that town and stone them to death -the girl because she was in a town and did not scream for help, and the man because he violated another man's wife. You must purge the evil from among you.

22.zh: 若有男子在田野遇见已经许配人的女子，强与他行淫，只要将那男子治死。
22.en: But if out in the country a man happens to meet a girl pledged to be married and rapes her, only the man who has done this shall die.

22.zh: 但不可办女子；他本没有该死的罪，这事就类乎人起来攻击邻舍，将他杀了一样。
22.en: Do nothing to the girl; she has committed no sin deserving death. This case is like that of someone who attacks and murders his neighbor,

22.zh: 因为男子是在田野遇见那已经许配人的女子，女子喊叫，并无人救他。
22.en: for the man found the girl out in the country, and though the betrothed girl screamed, there was no one to rescue her.

22.zh: 若有男子遇见没有许配人的处女，抓住他，与他行淫，被人看见，
22.en: If a man happens to meet a virgin who is not pledged to be married and rapes her and they are discovered,

22.zh: 这男子就要拿五十舍客勒银子给女子的父亲；因他玷污了这女子，就要娶他为妻，终身不可休他。
22.en: he shall pay the girl's father fifty shekels of silver. He must marry the girl, for he has violated her. He can never divorce her as long as he lives.

22.zh: 人不可娶继母为妻；不可掀开他父亲的衣襟。
22.en: A man is not to marry his father's wife; he must not dishonor his father's bed.

23.zh: 凡外肾受伤的，或被阉割的，不可入耶和华的会。
23.en: No one who has been emasculated by crushing or cutting may enter the assembly of the Lord .

23.zh: 私生子不可入耶和华的会；他的子孙，直到十代，也不可入耶和华的会。
23.en: No one born of a forbidden marriage nor any of his descendants may enter the assembly of the Lord , even down to the tenth generation.

23.zh: 亚扪人或是摩押人不可入耶和华的会；他们的子孙，虽过十代，也永不可入耶和华的会。
23.en: No Ammonite or Moabite or any of his descendants may enter the assembly of the Lord , even down to the tenth generation.

23.zh: 因为你们出埃及的时候，他们没有拿食物和水在路上迎接你们，又因他们雇了米所波大米的毘夺人比珥的儿子巴兰来咒诅你们。
23.en: For they did not come to meet you with bread and water on your way when you came out of Egypt, and they hired Balaam son of Beor from Pethor in Aram Naharaim to pronounce a curse on you.

23.zh: 然而耶和华 ─ 你的神不肯听从巴兰，咒诅的言语变为祝福的话，因为耶和华 ─ 你的神爱你。
23.en: However, the Lord your God would not listen to Balaam but turned the curse into a blessing for you, because the Lord your God loves you.

23.zh: 你一生一世永不可求他们的平安和他们的利益。
23.en: Do not seek a treaty of friendship with them as long as you live.

23.zh: 不可憎恶以东人，因为他是你的弟兄。不可憎恶埃及人，因为你在他的地上作过寄居的。
23.en: Do not abhor an Edomite, for he is your brother. Do not abhor an Egyptian, because you lived as an alien in his country.

23.zh: 他们第三代子孙入耶和华的会。
23.en: The third generation of children born to them may enter the assembly of the Lord .

23.zh: 你出兵攻打仇敌，就要远避诸恶。
23.en: When you are encamped against your enemies, keep away from everything impure.

23.zh: 你们中间，若有人夜间偶然梦遗，不洁净，就要出到营外，不可入营；
23.en: If one of your men is unclean because of a nocturnal emission, he is to go outside the camp and stay there.

23.zh: 到傍晚的时候，他要用水洗澡，及至日落了才可以入营。
23.en: But as evening approaches he is to wash himself, and at sunset he may return to the camp.

23.zh: 你在营外也该定出一个地方作为便所。
23.en: Designate a place outside the camp where you can go to relieve yourself.

23.zh: 在你器械之中当预备一把锹，你出营外便溺以后，用以铲土，转身掩盖。
23.en: As part of your equipment have something to dig with, and when you relieve yourself, dig a hole and cover up your excrement.

23.zh: 因为耶和华 ─ 你的神常在你营中行走，要救护你，将仇敌交给你，所以你的营理当圣洁，免得他见你那里有污秽，就离开你。
23.en: For the Lord your God moves about in your camp to protect you and to deliver your enemies to you. Your camp must be holy, so that he will not see among you anything indecent and turn away from you.

23.zh: 若有奴仆脱了主人的手，逃到你那里，你不可将他交付他的主人。
23.en: If a slave has taken refuge with you, do not hand him over to his master.

23.zh: 他必在你那里与你同住，在你的城邑中，要由他选择一个所喜悦的地方居住；你不可欺负他。
23.en: Let him live among you wherever he likes and in whatever town he chooses. Do not oppress him.

23.zh: 以色列的女子中不可有妓女；以色列的男子中不可有娈童。
23.en: No Israelite man or woman is to become a shrine prostitute.

23.zh: 娼妓所得的钱，或娈童（原文作狗）所得的价，你不可带入耶和华 ─ 你神的殿还愿，因为这两样都是耶和华 ─ 你神所憎恶的。
23.en: You must not bring the earnings of a female prostitute or of a male prostitute into the house of the Lord your God to pay any vow, because the Lord your God detests them both.

23.zh: 你借给你弟兄的，或是钱财或是粮食，无论甚么可生利的物，都不可取利。
23.en: Do not charge your brother interest, whether on money or food or anything else that may earn interest.

23.zh: 借给外邦人可以取利，只是借给你弟兄不可取利。这样，耶和华 ─ 你神必在你所去得为业的地上和你手里所办的一切事上赐福与你。
23.en: You may charge a foreigner interest, but not a brother Israelite, so that the Lord your God may bless you in everything you put your hand to in the land you are entering to possess.

23.zh: 你向耶和华 ─ 你的神许愿，偿还不可迟延；因为耶和华 ─ 你的神必定向你追讨，你不偿还就有罪。
23.en: If you make a vow to the Lord your God, do not be slow to pay it, for the Lord your God will certainly demand it of you and you will be guilty of sin.

23.zh: 你若不许愿，倒无罪。
23.en: But if you refrain from making a vow, you will not be guilty.

23.zh: 你嘴里所出的，就是你口中应许甘心所献的，要照你向耶和华 ─ 你神所许的愿谨守遵行。
23.en: Whatever your lips utter you must be sure to do, because you made your vow freely to the Lord your God with your own mouth.

23.zh: 你进了邻舍的葡萄园，可以随意吃饱了葡萄，只是不可装在器皿中。
23.en: If you enter your neighbor's vineyard, you may eat all the grapes you want, but do not put any in your basket.

23.zh: 你进了邻舍站著的禾稼，可以用手摘穗子，只是不可用镰刀割取禾稼。
23.en: If you enter your neighbor's grainfield, you may pick kernels with your hands, but you must not put a sickle to his standing grain.

24.zh: 人若娶妻以后，见他有甚么不合理的事，不喜悦他，就可以写休书交在他手中，打发他离开夫家。
24.en: If a man marries a woman who becomes displeasing to him because he finds something indecent about her, and he writes her a certificate of divorce, gives it to her and sends her from his house,

24.zh: 妇人离开夫家以后，可以去嫁别人。
24.en: and if after she leaves his house she becomes the wife of another man,

24.zh: 后夫若恨恶他，写休书交在他手中，打发他离开夫家，或是娶他为妻的后夫死了，
24.en: and her second husband dislikes her and writes her a certificate of divorce, gives it to her and sends her from his house, or if he dies,

24.zh: 打发他去的前夫不可在妇人玷污之后再娶他为妻，因为这是耶和华所憎恶的；不可使耶和华 ─ 你神所赐为业之地被玷污了。
24.en: then her first husband, who divorced her, is not allowed to marry her again after she has been defiled. That would be detestable in the eyes of the Lord . Do not bring sin upon the land the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance.

24.zh: 新娶妻之人不可从军出征，也不可托他办理甚么公事，可以在家清闲一年，使他所娶的妻快活。
24.en: If a man has recently married, he must not be sent to war or have any other duty laid on him. For one year he is to be free to stay at home and bring happiness to the wife he has married.

24.zh: 不可拿人的全盘磨石或是上磨石作当头，因为这是拿人的命作当头。
24.en: Do not take a pair of millstones-not even the upper one-as security for a debt, because that would be taking a man's livelihood as security.

24.zh: 若遇见人拐带以色列中的一个弟兄，当奴才待他，或是卖了他，那拐带人的就必治死。这样，便将那恶从你们中间除掉。
24.en: If a man is caught kidnapping one of his brother Israelites and treats him as a slave or sells him, the kidnapper must die. You must purge the evil from among you.

24.zh: 在大痳疯的灾病上，你们要谨慎，照祭司利未人一切所指教你们的留意遵行。我怎样吩咐他们，你们要怎样遵行。
24.en: In cases of leprous diseases be very careful to do exactly as the priests, who are Levites, instruct you. You must follow carefully what I have commanded them.

24.zh: 当记念出埃及后，在路上，耶和华 ─ 你神向米利暗所行的事。
24.en: Remember what the Lord your God did to Miriam along the way after you came out of Egypt.

24.zh: 你借给邻舍，不拘是甚么，不可进他家拿他的当头。
24.en: When you make a loan of any kind to your neighbor, do not go into his house to get what he is offering as a pledge.

24.zh: 要站在外面，等那向你借贷的人把当头拿出来交给你。
24.en: Stay outside and let the man to whom you are making the loan bring the pledge out to you.

24.zh: 他若是穷人，你不可留他的当头过夜。
24.en: If the man is poor, do not go to sleep with his pledge in your possession.

24.zh: 日落的时候，总要把当头还他，使他用那件衣服盖著睡觉，他就为你祝福；这在耶和华 ─ 你神面前就是你的义了。
24.en: Return his cloak to him by sunset so that he may sleep in it. Then he will thank you, and it will be regarded as a righteous act in the sight of the Lord your God.

24.zh: 困苦穷乏的雇工，无论是你的弟兄或是在你城里寄居的，你不可欺负他。
24.en: Do not take advantage of a hired man who is poor and needy, whether he is a brother Israelite or an alien living in one of your towns.

24.zh: 要当日给他工价，不可等到日落 ─ 因为他穷苦，把心放在工价上 ─ 恐怕他因你求告耶和华，罪便归你了。
24.en: Pay him his wages each day before sunset, because he is poor and is counting on it. Otherwise he may cry to the Lord against you, and you will be guilty of sin.

24.zh: 不可因子杀父，也不可因父杀子；凡被杀的都为本身的罪。
24.en: Fathers shall not be put to death for their children, nor children put to death for their fathers; each is to die for his own sin.

24.zh: 你不可向寄居的和孤儿屈枉正直，也不可拿寡妇的衣裳作当头。
24.en: Do not deprive the alien or the fatherless of justice, or take the cloak of the widow as a pledge.

24.zh: 要记念你在埃及作过奴仆。耶和华 ─ 你的神从那里将你救赎，所以我吩咐你这样行。
24.en: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt and the Lord your God redeemed you from there. That is why I command you to do this.

24.zh: 你在田间收割庄稼，若忘下一捆，不可回去再取，要留给寄居的与孤儿寡妇。这样，耶和华 ─ 你神必在你手里所办的一切事上赐福与你。
24.en: When you are harvesting in your field and you overlook a sheaf, do not go back to get it. Leave it for the alien, the fatherless and the widow, so that the Lord your God may bless you in all the work of your hands.

24.zh: 你打橄榄树，枝上剩下的，不可再打；要留给寄居的与孤儿寡妇。
24.en: When you beat the olives from your trees, do not go over the branches a second time. Leave what remains for the alien, the fatherless and the widow.

24.zh: 你摘葡萄园的葡萄，所剩下的，不可再摘；要留给寄居的与孤儿寡妇。
24.en: When you harvest the grapes in your vineyard, do not go over the vines again. Leave what remains for the alien, the fatherless and the widow.

24.zh: 你也要记念你在埃及地作过奴仆，所以我吩咐你这样行。
24.en: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt. That is why I command you to do this.

25.zh: 人若有争讼，来听审判，审判官就要定义人有理，定恶人有罪。
25.en: When men have a dispute, they are to take it to court and the judges will decide the case, acquitting the innocent and condemning the guilty.

25.zh: 恶人若该受责打，审判官就要叫他当面伏在地上，按著他的罪照数责打。
25.en: If the guilty man deserves to be beaten, the judge shall make him lie down and have him flogged in his presence with the number of lashes his crime deserves,

25.zh: 只可打他四十下，不可过数；若过数，便是轻贱你的弟兄了。
25.en: but he must not give him more than forty lashes. If he is flogged more than that, your brother will be degraded in your eyes.

25.zh: 牛在场上踹谷的时候，不可笼住他的嘴。
25.en: Do not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain.

25.zh: 弟兄同居，若死了一个，没有儿子，死人的妻不可出嫁外人，他丈夫的兄弟当尽弟兄的本分，娶他为妻，与他同房。
25.en: If brothers are living together and one of them dies without a son, his widow must not marry outside the family. Her husband's brother shall take her and marry her and fulfill the duty of a brother-in-law to her.

25.zh: 妇人生的长子必归死兄的名下，免得他的名在以色列中涂抹了。
25.en: The first son she bears shall carry on the name of the dead brother so that his name will not be blotted out from Israel.

25.zh: 那人若不愿意娶他哥哥的妻，他哥哥的妻就要到城门长老那里，说：我丈夫的兄弟不肯在以色列中兴起他哥哥的名字，不给我尽弟兄的本分。
25.en: However, if a man does not want to marry his brother's wife, she shall go to the elders at the town gate and say, "My husband's brother refuses to carry on his brother's name in Israel. He will not fulfill the duty of a brother-in-law to me."

25.zh: 本城的长老就要召那人来问他，他若执意说：我不愿意娶他，
25.en: Then the elders of his town shall summon him and talk to him. If he persists in saying, "I do not want to marry her,"

25.zh: 他哥哥的妻就要当著长老到那人的跟前，脱了他的鞋，吐唾沫在他脸上，说：凡不为哥哥建立家室的都要这样待他。
25.en: his brother's widow shall go up to him in the presence of the elders, take off one of his sandals, spit in his face and say, "This is what is done to the man who will not build up his brother's family line."

25.zh: 在以色列中，他的名必称为脱鞋之家。
25.en: That man's line shall be known in Israel as The Family of the Unsandaled.

25.zh: 若有二人争斗，这人的妻近前来，要救他丈夫脱离那打他丈夫之人的手，抓住那人的下体，
25.en: If two men are fighting and the wife of one of them comes to rescue her husband from his assailant, and she reaches out and seizes him by his private parts,

25.zh: 就要砍断妇人的手，眼不可顾惜他。
25.en: you shall cut off her hand. Show her no pity.

25.zh: 你囊中不可有一大一小两样的法码。
25.en: Do not have two differing weights in your bag-one heavy, one light.

25.zh: 你家里不可有一大一小两样的升斗。
25.en: Do not have two differing measures in your house-one large, one small.

25.zh: 当用对准公平的法码，公平的升斗。这样，在耶和华 ─ 你神所赐你的地上，你的日子就可以长久。
25.en: You must have accurate and honest weights and measures, so that you may live long in the land the Lord your God is giving you.

25.zh: 因为行非义之事的人都是耶和华 ─ 你神所憎恶的。
25.en: For the Lord your God detests anyone who does these things, anyone who deals dishonestly.

25.zh: 你要记念你们出埃及的时候，亚玛力人在路上怎样待你。
25.en: Remember what the Amalekites did to you along the way when you came out of Egypt.

25.zh: 他们在路上遇见你，趁你疲乏困倦击杀你尽后边软弱的人，并不敬畏神。
25.en: When you were weary and worn out, they met you on your journey and cut off all who were lagging behind; they had no fear of God.

25.zh: 所以耶和华 ─ 你神使你不被四围一切的仇敌扰乱，在耶和华 ─ 你神赐你为业的地上得享平安。那时，你要将亚玛力的名号从天下涂抹了，不可忘记。
25.en: When the Lord your God gives you rest from all the enemies around you in the land he is giving you to possess as an inheritance, you shall blot out the memory of Amalek from under heaven. Do not forget!

26.zh: 你进去得了耶和华 ─ 你神所赐你为业之地居住，
26.en: When you have entered the land the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance and have taken possession of it and settled in it,

26.zh: 就要从耶和华 ─ 你神赐你的地上将所收的各种初熟的土产取些来，盛在筐子里，往耶和华 ─ 你神所选择要立为他名的居所去，
26.en: take some of the firstfruits of all that you produce from the soil of the land the Lord your God is giving you and put them in a basket. Then go to the place the Lord your God will choose as a dwelling for his Name

26.zh: 见当时作祭司的，对他说：我今日向耶和华 ─ 你神明认，我已来到耶和华向我们列祖起誓应许赐给我们的地。
26.en: and say to the priest in office at the time, "I declare today to the Lord your God that I have come to the land the Lord swore to our forefathers to give us."

26.zh: 祭司就从你手里取过筐子来，放在耶和华 ─ 你神的坛前。
26.en: The priest shall take the basket from your hands and set it down in front of the altar of the Lord your God.

26.zh: 你要在耶和华 ─ 你神面前说：我祖原是一个将亡的亚兰人，下到埃及寄居。他人口稀少，在那里却成了又大又强 、 人数很多的国民。
26.en: Then you shall declare before the Lord your God: "My father was a wandering Aramean, and he went down into Egypt with a few people and lived there and became a great nation, powerful and numerous.

26.zh: 埃及人恶待我们，苦害我们，将苦工加在我们身上。
26.en: But the Egyptians mistreated us and made us suffer, putting us to hard labor.

26.zh: 于是我们哀求耶和华 ─ 我们列祖的神，耶和华听见我们的声音，看见我们所受的困苦 、 劳碌 、 欺压，
26.en: Then we cried out to the Lord , the God of our fathers, and the Lord heard our voice and saw our misery, toil and oppression.

26.zh: 他就用大能的手和伸出来的膀臂，并大可畏的事与神迹奇事，领我们出了埃及，
26.en: So the Lord brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm, with great terror and with miraculous signs and wonders.

26.zh: 将我们领进这地方，把这流奶与蜜之地赐给我们。
26.en: He brought us to this place and gave us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey;

26.zh: 耶和华阿，现在我把你所赐给我地上初熟的土产奉了来。随后你要把筐子放在耶和华 ─ 你神面前，向耶和华 ─ 你的神下拜。
26.en: and now I bring the firstfruits of the soil that you, O Lord , have given me." Place the basket before the Lord your God and bow down before him.

26.zh: 你和利未人，并在你们中间寄居的，要因耶和华 ─ 你神所赐你和你家的一切福分欢乐。
26.en: And you and the Levites and the aliens among you shall rejoice in all the good things the Lord your God has given to you and your household.

26.zh: 每逢三年，就是十分取一之年，你取完了一切土产的十分之一，要分给利未人和寄居的，与孤儿寡妇，使他们在你城中可以吃得饱足。
26.en: When you have finished setting aside a tenth of all your produce in the third year, the year of the tithe, you shall give it to the Levite, the alien, the fatherless and the widow, so that they may eat in your towns and be satisfied.

26.zh: 你又要在耶和华 ─ 你神面前说：我已将圣物从我家里拿出来，给了利未人和寄居的，与孤儿寡妇，是照你所吩咐我的一切命令。你的命令我都没有违背，也没有忘记。
26.en: Then say to the Lord your God: "I have removed from my house the sacred portion and have given it to the Levite, the alien, the fatherless and the widow, according to all you commanded. I have not turned aside from your commands nor have I forgotten any of them.

26.zh: 我守丧的时候，没有吃这圣物；不洁净的时候，也没有拿出来，又没有为死人送去。我听从了耶和华 ─ 我神的话，都照你所吩咐的行了。
26.en: I have not eaten any of the sacred portion while I was in mourning, nor have I removed any of it while I was unclean, nor have I offered any of it to the dead. I have obeyed the Lord my God; I have done everything you commanded me.

26.zh: 求你从天上 、 你的圣所垂看，赐福给你的百姓以色列与你所赐给我们的地，就是你向我们列祖起誓赐我们流奶与蜜之地。
26.en: Look down from heaven, your holy dwelling place, and bless your people Israel and the land you have given us as you promised on oath to our forefathers, a land flowing with milk and honey."

26.zh: 耶和华 ─ 你的神今日吩咐你行这些律例典章，所以你要尽心尽性谨守遵行。
26.en: The Lord your God commands you this day to follow these decrees and laws; carefully observe them with all your heart and with all your soul.

26.zh: 你今日认耶和华为你的神，应许遵行他的道，谨守他的律例 、 诫命 、 典章，听从他的话。
26.en: You have declared this day that the Lord is your God and that you will walk in his ways, that you will keep his decrees, commands and laws, and that you will obey him.

26.zh: 耶和华今日照他所应许你的，也认你为他的子民，使你谨守他的一切诫命，
26.en: And the Lord has declared this day that you are his people, his treasured possession as he promised, and that you are to keep all his commands.

26.zh: 又使你得称赞 、 美名 、 尊荣，超乎他所造的万民之上，并照他所应许的使你归耶和华 ─ 你神为圣洁的民。
26.en: He has declared that he will set you in praise, fame and honor high above all the nations he has made and that you will be a people holy to the Lord your God, as he promised.

27.zh: 摩西和以色列的众长老吩咐百姓说：你们要遵守我今日所吩咐的一切诫命。
27.en: Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people: "Keep all these commands that I give you today.

27.zh: 你们过约但河，到了耶和华 ─ 你神所赐给你的地，当天要立起几块大石头，墁上石灰，
27.en: When you have crossed the Jordan into the land the Lord your God is giving you, set up some large stones and coat them with plaster.

27.zh: 把这律法的一切话写在石头上。你过了河，可以进入耶和华 ─ 你神所赐你流奶与蜜之地，正如耶和华 ─ 你列祖之神所应许你的。
27.en: Write on them all the words of this law when you have crossed over to enter the land the Lord your God is giving you, a land flowing with milk and honey, just as the Lord , the God of your fathers, promised you.

27.zh: 你们过了约但河，就要在以巴路山上照我今日所吩咐的，将这些石头立起来，墁上石灰。
27.en: And when you have crossed the Jordan, set up these stones on Mount Ebal, as I command you today, and coat them with plaster.

27.zh: 在那里要为耶和华 ─ 你的神筑一座石坛；在石头上不可动铁器。
27.en: Build there an altar to the Lord your God, an altar of stones. Do not use any iron tool upon them.

27.zh: 要用没有凿过的石头筑耶和华 ─ 你神的坛，在坛上要将燔祭献给耶和华 ─ 你的神。
27.en: Build the altar of the Lord your God with fieldstones and offer burnt offerings on it to the Lord your God.

27.zh: 又要献平安祭，且在那里吃，在耶和华 ─ 你的神面前欢乐。
27.en: Sacrifice fellowship offerings there, eating them and rejoicing in the presence of the Lord your God.

27.zh: 你要将这律法的一切话明明的写在石头上。
27.en: And you shall write very clearly all the words of this law on these stones you have set up."

27.zh: 摩西和祭司利未人晓谕以色列众人说：以色列阿，要默默静听。你今日成为耶和华 ─ 你神的百姓了。
27.en: Then Moses and the priests, who are Levites, said to all Israel, "Be silent, O Israel, and listen! You have now become the people of the Lord your God.

27.zh: 所以要听从耶和华 ─ 你神的话，遵行他的诫命律例，就是我今日所吩咐你的。
27.en: Obey the Lord your God and follow his commands and decrees that I give you today."

27.zh: 当日，摩西嘱咐百姓说：
27.en: On the same day Moses commanded the people:

27.zh: 你们过了约但河，西缅 、 利未 、 犹大 、 以萨迦 、 约瑟 、 便雅悯六个支派的人都要站在基利心山上为百姓祝福。
27.en: When you have crossed the Jordan, these tribes shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph and Benjamin.

27.zh: 流便 、 迦得 、 亚设 、 西布伦 、 但 、 拿弗他利六个支派的人都要站在以巴路山上宣布咒诅。
27.en: And these tribes shall stand on Mount Ebal to pronounce curses: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan and Naphtali.

27.zh: 利未人要向以色列众人高声说：
27.en: The Levites shall recite to all the people of Israel in a loud voice:

27.zh: 有人制造耶和华所憎恶的偶像，或雕刻，或铸造，就是工匠手所做的，在暗中设立，那人必受咒诅！百姓都要答应说：阿们！
27.en: "Cursed is the man who carves an image or casts an idol -a thing detestable to the Lord , the work of the craftsman's hands-and sets it up in secret." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

27.zh: 轻慢父母的，必受咒诅！百姓都要说：阿们！
27.en: "Cursed is the man who dishonors his father or his mother." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

27.zh: 挪移邻舍地界的，必受咒诅！百姓都要说：阿们！
27.en: "Cursed is the man who moves his neighbor's boundary stone." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

27.zh: 使瞎子走差路的，必受咒诅！百姓都要说：阿们！
27.en: "Cursed is the man who leads the blind astray on the road." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

27.zh: 向寄居的和孤儿寡妇屈枉正直的，必受咒诅！百姓都要说：阿们！
27.en: "Cursed is the man who withholds justice from the alien, the fatherless or the widow." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

27.zh: 与继母行淫的，必受咒诅！因为掀开他父亲的衣襟。百姓都要说：阿们！
27.en: "Cursed is the man who sleeps with his father's wife, for he dishonors his father's bed." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

27.zh: 与兽淫合的，必受咒诅！百姓都要说：阿们！
27.en: "Cursed is the man who has sexual relations with any animal." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

27.zh: 与异母同父，或异父同母的姊妹行淫的，必受咒诅！百姓都要说：阿们！
27.en: "Cursed is the man who sleeps with his sister, the daughter of his father or the daughter of his mother." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

27.zh: 与岳母行淫的，必受咒诅！百姓都要说：阿们！
27.en: "Cursed is the man who sleeps with his mother-in-law." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

27.zh: 暗中杀人的，必受咒诅！百姓都要说：阿们！
27.en: "Cursed is the man who kills his neighbor secretly." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

27.zh: 受贿赂害死无辜之人的，必受咒诅！百姓都要说：阿们！
27.en: "Cursed is the man who accepts a bribe to kill an innocent person." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

27.zh: 不坚守遵行这律法言语的，必受咒诅！百姓都要说：阿们！
27.en: "Cursed is the man who does not uphold the words of this law by carrying them out." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

28.zh: 你若留意听从耶和华 ─ 你神的话，谨守遵行他的一切诫命，就是我今日所吩咐你的，他必使你超乎天下万民之上。
28.en: If you fully obey the Lord your God and carefully follow all his commands I give you today, the Lord your God will set you high above all the nations on earth.

28.zh: 你若听从耶和华 ─ 你神的话，这以下的福必追随你，临到你身上：
28.en: All these blessings will come upon you and accompany you if you obey the Lord your God:

28.zh: 你在城里必蒙福，在田间也必蒙福。
28.en: You will be blessed in the city and blessed in the country.

28.zh: 你身所生的，地所产的，牲畜所下的，以及牛犊 、 羊羔，都必蒙福。
28.en: The fruit of your womb will be blessed, and the crops of your land and the young of your livestock-the calves of your herds and the lambs of your flocks.

28.zh: 你的筐子和你的抟面盆都必蒙福。
28.en: Your basket and your kneading trough will be blessed.

28.zh: 你出也蒙福，入也蒙福。
28.en: You will be blessed when you come in and blessed when you go out.

28.zh: 仇敌起来攻击你，耶和华必使他们在你面前被你杀败；他们从一条路来攻击你，必从七条路逃跑。
28.en: The Lord will grant that the enemies who rise up against you will be defeated before you. They will come at you from one direction but flee from you in seven.

28.zh: 在你仓房里，并你手所办的一切事上，耶和华所命的福必临到你。耶和华 ─ 你神也要在所给你的地上赐福与你。
28.en: The Lord will send a blessing on your barns and on everything you put your hand to. The Lord your God will bless you in the land he is giving you.

28.zh: 你若谨守耶和华 ─ 你神的诫命，遵行他的道，他必照著向你所起的誓立你作为自己的圣民。
28.en: The Lord will establish you as his holy people, as he promised you on oath, if you keep the commands of the Lord your God and walk in his ways.

28.zh: 天下万民见你归在耶和华的名下，就要惧怕你。
28.en: Then all the peoples on earth will see that you are called by the name of the Lord , and they will fear you.

28.zh: 你在耶和华向你列祖起誓应许赐你的地上，他必使你身所生的，牲畜所下的，地所产的，都绰绰有余。
28.en: The Lord will grant you abundant prosperity-in the fruit of your womb, the young of your livestock and the crops of your ground-in the land he swore to your forefathers to give you.

28.zh: 耶和华必为你开天上的府库，按时降雨在你的地上。在你手里所办的一切事上赐福与你。你必借给许多国民，却不至向他们借贷。
28.en: The Lord will open the heavens, the storehouse of his bounty, to send rain on your land in season and to bless all the work of your hands. You will lend to many nations but will borrow from none.

28.zh: 你若听从耶和华 ─ 你神的诫命，就是我今日所吩咐你的，谨守遵行，不偏左右，也不随从事奉别神，耶和华就必使你作首不作尾，但居上不居下。
28.en: The Lord will make you the head, not the tail. If you pay attention to the commands of the Lord your God that I give you this day and carefully follow them, you will always be at the top, never at the bottom.

28.zh: a
28.en: Do not turn aside from any of the commands I give you today, to the right or to the left, following other gods and serving them.

28.zh: 你若不听从耶和华 ─ 你神的话，不谨守遵行他的一切诫命律例，就是我今日所吩咐你的，这以下的咒诅都必追随你，临到你身上：
28.en: However, if you do not obey the Lord your God and do not carefully follow all his commands and decrees I am giving you today, all these curses will come upon you and overtake you:

28.zh: 你在城里必受咒诅，在田间也必受咒诅。
28.en: You will be cursed in the city and cursed in the country.

28.zh: 你的筐子和你的抟面盆都必受咒诅。
28.en: Your basket and your kneading trough will be cursed.

28.zh: 你身所生的，地所产的，以及牛犊 、 羊羔，都必受咒诅。
28.en: The fruit of your womb will be cursed, and the crops of your land, and the calves of your herds and the lambs of your flocks.

28.zh: 你出也受咒诅，入也受咒诅。
28.en: You will be cursed when you come in and cursed when you go out.

28.zh: 耶和华因你行恶离弃他，必在你手里所办的一切事上，使咒诅 、 扰乱 、 责罚临到你，直到你被毁灭，速速的灭亡。
28.en: The Lord will send on you curses, confusion and rebuke in everything you put your hand to, until you are destroyed and come to sudden ruin because of the evil you have done in forsaking him.

28.zh: 耶和华必使瘟疫贴在你身上，直到他将你从所进去得为业的地上灭绝。
28.en: The Lord will plague you with diseases until he has destroyed you from the land you are entering to possess.

28.zh: 耶和华要用痨病 、 热病 、 火症 、 疟疾 、 刀剑 、 旱风（或作：干旱） 、 霉烂攻击你。这都要追赶你，直到你灭亡。
28.en: The Lord will strike you with wasting disease, with fever and inflammation, with scorching heat and drought, with blight and mildew, which will plague you until you perish.

28.zh: 你头上的天要变为铜，脚下的地要变为铁。
28.en: The sky over your head will be bronze, the ground beneath you iron.

28.zh: 耶和华要使那降在你地上的雨变为尘沙，从天临在你身上，直到你灭亡
28.en: The Lord will turn the rain of your country into dust and powder; it will come down from the skies until you are destroyed.

28.zh: 耶和华必使你败在仇敌面前，你从一条路去攻击他们，必从七条路逃跑。你必在天下万国中抛来抛去。
28.en: The Lord will cause you to be defeated before your enemies. You will come at them from one direction but flee from them in seven, and you will become a thing of horror to all the kingdoms on earth.

28.zh: 你的尸首必给空中的飞鸟和地上的走兽作食物，并无人哄赶。
28.en: Your carcasses will be food for all the birds of the air and the beasts of the earth, and there will be no one to frighten them away.

28.zh: 耶和华必用埃及人的疮并痔疮 、 牛皮癣与疥攻击你，使你不能医治。
28.en: The Lord will afflict you with the boils of Egypt and with tumors, festering sores and the itch, from which you cannot be cured.

28.zh: 耶和华必用癫狂 、 眼瞎 、 心惊攻击你。
28.en: The Lord will afflict you with madness, blindness and confusion of mind.

28.zh: 你必在午间摸索，好像瞎子在暗中摸索一样。你所行的必不亨通，时常遭遇欺压 、 抢夺，无人搭救。
28.en: At midday you will grope about like a blind man in the dark. You will be unsuccessful in everything you do; day after day you will be oppressed and robbed, with no one to rescue you.

28.zh: 你聘定了妻，别人必与他同房；你建造房屋，不得住在其内；你栽种葡萄园，也不得用其中的果子。
28.en: You will be pledged to be married to a woman, but another will take her and ravish her. You will build a house, but you will not live in it. You will plant a vineyard, but you will not even begin to enjoy its fruit.

28.zh: 你的牛在你眼前宰了，你必不得吃他的肉；你的驴在你眼前被抢夺，不得归还；你的羊归了仇敌，无人搭救。
28.en: Your ox will be slaughtered before your eyes, but you will eat none of it. Your donkey will be forcibly taken from you and will not be returned. Your sheep will be given to your enemies, and no one will rescue them.

28.zh: 你的儿女必归与别国的民；你的眼目终日切望，甚至失明，你手中无力拯救。
28.en: Your sons and daughters will be given to another nation, and you will wear out your eyes watching for them day after day, powerless to lift a hand.

28.zh: 你的土产和你劳碌得来的，必被你所不认识的国民吃尽。你时常被欺负，受压制，
28.en: A people that you do not know will eat what your land and labor produce, and you will have nothing but cruel oppression all your days.

28.zh: 甚至你因眼中所看见的，必致疯狂。
28.en: The sights you see will drive you mad.

28.zh: 耶和华必攻击你，使你膝上腿上，从脚掌到头顶，长毒疮无法医治。
28.en: The Lord will afflict your knees and legs with painful boils that cannot be cured, spreading from the soles of your feet to the top of your head.

28.zh: 耶和华必将你和你所立的王领到你和你列祖素不认识的国去；在那里你必事奉木头石头的神。
28.en: The Lord will drive you and the king you set over you to a nation unknown to you or your fathers. There you will worship other gods, gods of wood and stone.

28.zh: 你在耶和华领你到的各国中，要令人惊骇 、 笑谈 、 讥诮。
28.en: You will become a thing of horror and an object of scorn and ridicule to all the nations where the Lord will drive you.

28.zh: 你带到田间的种子虽多，收进来的却少，因为被蝗虫吃了。
28.en: You will sow much seed in the field but you will harvest little, because locusts will devour it.

28.zh: 你栽种 、 修理葡萄园，却不得收葡萄，也不得喝葡萄酒，因为被虫子吃了。
28.en: You will plant vineyards and cultivate them but you will not drink the wine or gather the grapes, because worms will eat them.

28.zh: 你全境有橄榄树，却不得其油抹身，因为树上的橄榄不熟自落了。
28.en: You will have olive trees throughout your country but you will not use the oil, because the olives will drop off.

28.zh: 你生儿养女，却不算是你的，因为必被掳去。
28.en: You will have sons and daughters but you will not keep them, because they will go into captivity.

28.zh: 你所有的树木和你地里的出产必被蝗虫所吃。
28.en: Swarms of locusts will take over all your trees and the crops of your land.

28.zh: 在你中间寄居的，必渐渐上升，比你高而又高；你必渐渐下降，低而又低。
28.en: The alien who lives among you will rise above you higher and higher, but you will sink lower and lower.

28.zh: 他必借给你，你却不能借给他；他必作首，你必作尾。
28.en: He will lend to you, but you will not lend to him. He will be the head, but you will be the tail.

28.zh: 这一切咒诅必追随你，赶上你，直到你灭亡；因为你不听从耶和华 ─ 你神的话，不遵守他所吩咐的诫命律例。
28.en: All these curses will come upon you. They will pursue you and overtake you until you are destroyed, because you did not obey the Lord your God and observe the commands and decrees he gave you.

28.zh: 这些咒诅必在你和你后裔的身上成为异迹奇事，直到永远！
28.en: They will be a sign and a wonder to you and your descendants forever.

28.zh: 因为你富有的时候，不欢心乐意的事奉耶和华 ─ 你的神，
28.en: Because you did not serve the Lord your God joyfully and gladly in the time of prosperity,

28.zh: 所以你必在饥饿 、 干渴 、 赤露 、 缺乏之中事奉耶和华所打发来攻击你的仇敌。他必把铁轭加在你的颈项上，直到将你灭绝。
28.en: therefore in hunger and thirst, in nakedness and dire poverty, you will serve the enemies the Lord sends against you. He will put an iron yoke on your neck until he has destroyed you.

28.zh: 耶和华要从远方 、 地极带一国的民，如鹰飞来攻击你。这民的言语，你不懂得。
28.en: The Lord will bring a nation against you from far away, from the ends of the earth, like an eagle swooping down, a nation whose language you will not understand,

28.zh: 这民的面貌凶恶，不顾恤年老的，也不恩待年少的。
28.en: a fierce-looking nation without respect for the old or pity for the young.

28.zh: 他们必吃你牲畜所下的和你地土所产的，直到你灭亡。你的五谷 、 新酒，和油，以及牛犊 、 羊羔，都不给你留下，直到将你灭绝。
28.en: They will devour the young of your livestock and the crops of your land until you are destroyed. They will leave you no grain, new wine or oil, nor any calves of your herds or lambs of your flocks until you are ruined.

28.zh: 他们必将你困在你各 } 城里，直到你所倚靠 、 高大坚固的城墙都被攻塌。他们必将你困在耶和华 ─ 你神所赐你遍地的各城里。
28.en: They will lay siege to all the cities throughout your land until the high fortified walls in which you trust fall down. They will besiege all the cities throughout the land the Lord your God is giving you.

28.zh: 你在仇敌围困窘迫之中，必吃你本身所生的，就是耶和华 ─ 你神所赐给你的儿女之肉。
28.en: Because of the suffering that your enemy will inflict on you during the siege, you will eat the fruit of the womb, the flesh of the sons and daughters the Lord your God has given you.

28.zh: 你们中间，柔弱娇嫩的人必恶眼看他弟兄和他怀中的妻，并他余剩的儿女；
28.en: Even the most gentle and sensitive man among you will have no compassion on his own brother or the wife he loves or his surviving children,

28.zh: 甚至在你受仇敌围困窘迫的城中，他要吃儿女的肉，不肯分一点给他的亲人，因为他一无所剩。
28.en: and he will not give to one of them any of the flesh of his children that he is eating. It will be all he has left because of the suffering your enemy will inflict on you during the siege of all your cities.

28.zh: 你们中间，柔弱娇嫩的妇人，是因娇嫩柔弱不肯把脚踏地的，必恶眼看他怀中的丈夫和他的儿女。
28.en: The most gentle and sensitive woman among you-so sensitive and gentle that she would not venture to touch the ground with the sole of her foot-will begrudge the husband she loves and her own son or daughter

28.zh: 他两腿中间出来的婴孩与他所要生的儿女，他因缺乏一切就要在你受仇敌围困窘迫的城中将他们暗暗地吃了。
28.en: the afterbirth from her womb and the children she bears. For she intends to eat them secretly during the siege and in the distress that your enemy will inflict on you in your cities.

28.zh: 这书上所写律法的一切话是叫你敬畏耶和华 ─ 你神可荣可畏的名。你若不谨守遵行，耶和华就必将奇灾，就是至大至长的灾，至重至久的病，加在你和你后裔的身上，
28.en: If you do not carefully follow all the words of this law, which are written in this book, and do not revere this glorious and awesome name-the Lord your God-

28.zh: a
28.en: the Lord will send fearful plagues on you and your descendants, harsh and prolonged disasters, and severe and lingering illnesses.

28.zh: 也必使你所惧怕 、 埃及人的病都临到你，贴在你身上，
28.en: He will bring upon you all the diseases of Egypt that you dreaded, and they will cling to you.

28.zh: 又必将没有写在这律法书上的各样疾病 、 灾殃降在你身上，直到你灭亡。
28.en: The Lord will also bring on you every kind of sickness and disaster not recorded in this Book of the Law, until you are destroyed.

28.zh: 你们先前虽然像天上的星那样多，却因不听从耶和华 ─ 你神的话，所剩的人数就稀少了。
28.en: You who were as numerous as the stars in the sky will be left but few in number, because you did not obey the Lord your God.

28.zh: 先前耶和华怎样喜悦善待你们，使你们众多，也要照样喜悦毁灭你们，使你们灭亡；并且你们从所要进去得的地上必被拔除。
28.en: Just as it pleased the Lord to make you prosper and increase in number, so it will please him to ruin and destroy you. You will be uprooted from the land you are entering to possess.

28.zh: 耶和华必使你们分散在万民中，从地这边到地那边，你必在那里事奉你和你列祖素不认识 、 木头石头的神。
28.en: Then the Lord will scatter you among all nations, from one end of the earth to the other. There you will worship other gods-gods of wood and stone, which neither you nor your fathers have known.

28.zh: 在那些国中，你必不得安逸，也不得落脚之地；耶和华却使你在那里心中跳动，眼目失明，精神消耗。
28.en: Among those nations you will find no repose, no resting place for the sole of your foot. There the Lord will give you an anxious mind, eyes weary with longing, and a despairing heart.

28.zh: 你的性命必悬悬无定；你昼夜恐惧，自料性命难保。
28.en: You will live in constant suspense, filled with dread both night and day, never sure of your life.

28.zh: 你因心里所恐惧的，眼中所看见的，早晨必说，巴不得到晚上才好；晚上必说，巴不得到早晨才好。
28.en: In the morning you will say, "If only it were evening!" and in the evening, "If only it were morning!"-because of the terror that will fill your hearts and the sights that your eyes will see.

28.zh: 耶和华必使你坐船回埃及去，走我曾告诉你不得再见的路；在那里你必卖己身与仇敌作奴婢，却无人买。
28.en: The Lord will send you back in ships to Egypt on a journey I said you should never make again. There you will offer yourselves for sale to your enemies as male and female slaves, but no one will buy you.

29.zh: 这是耶和华在摩押地吩咐摩西与以色列人立约的话，是在他和他们于何烈山所立的约之外。
29.en: These are the terms of the covenant the Lord commanded Moses to make with the Israelites in Moab, in addition to the covenant he had made with them at Horeb.

29.zh: 摩西召了以色列众人来，对他们说：耶和华在埃及地，在你们眼前向法老和他众臣仆，并他全地所行的一切事，你们都看见了，
29.en: Moses summoned all the Israelites and said to them: Your eyes have seen all that the Lord did in Egypt to Pharaoh, to all his officials and to all his land.

29.zh: 就是你亲眼看见的大试验和神迹，并那些大奇事。
29.en: With your own eyes you saw those great trials, those miraculous signs and great wonders.

29.zh: 但耶和华到今日没有使你们心能明白，眼能看见，耳能听见。
29.en: But to this day the Lord has not given you a mind that understands or eyes that see or ears that hear.

29.zh: 我领你们在旷野四十年，你们身上的衣服并没有穿破，脚上的鞋也没有穿坏。
29.en: During the forty years that I led you through the desert, your clothes did not wear out, nor did the sandals on your feet.

29.zh: 你们没有吃饼，也没有喝清酒浓酒。这要使你们知道，耶和华是你们的神。
29.en: You ate no bread and drank no wine or other fermented drink. I did this so that you might know that I am the Lord your God.

29.zh: 你们来到这地方，希实本王西宏 、 巴珊王噩都出来与我们交战，我们就击杀了他们，
29.en: When you reached this place, Sihon king of Heshbon and Og king of Bashan came out to fight against us, but we defeated them.

29.zh: 取了他们的地给流便支派 、 迦得支派，和玛拿西半支派为业。
29.en: We took their land and gave it as an inheritance to the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

29.zh: 所以你们要谨守遵行这约的话，好叫你们在一切所行的事上亨通。
29.en: Carefully follow the terms of this covenant, so that you may prosper in everything you do.

29.zh: 今日，你们的首领 、 族长（原文作支派） 、 长老 、 官长 、 以色列的男丁，你们的妻子儿女，和营中寄居的，以及为你们劈柴挑水的人，都站在耶和华 ─ 你们的神面前，
29.en: All of you are standing today in the presence of the Lord your God- your leaders and chief men, your elders and officials, and all the other men of Israel,

29.zh: a
29.en: together with your children and your wives, and the aliens living in your camps who chop your wood and carry your water.

29.zh: 为要你顺从耶和华 ─ 你神今日与你所立的约，向你所起的誓。
29.en: You are standing here in order to enter into a covenant with the Lord your God, a covenant the Lord is making with you this day and sealing with an oath,

29.zh: 这样，他要照他向你所应许的话，又向你列祖亚伯拉罕 、 以撒 、 雅各所起的誓，今日立你作他的子民，他作你的神。这样，他要照他向你所应许的话，又向你列祖亚伯拉罕 、 以撒 、 雅各所起的誓，今日立你作他的子民，他作你的神。
29.en: to confirm you this day as his people, that he may be your God as he promised you and as he swore to your fathers, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.

29.zh: 我不但与你们立这约，起这誓，
29.en: I am making this covenant, with its oath, not only with you

29.zh: 凡与我们一同站在耶和华 ─ 我们神面前的，并今日不在我们这里的人，我也与他们立这约，起这誓。
29.en: who are standing here with us today in the presence of the Lord our God but also with those who are not here today.

29.zh: 我们曾住过埃及地，也从列国经过；这是你们知道的。
29.en: You yourselves know how we lived in Egypt and how we passed through the countries on the way here.

29.zh: 你们也看见他们中间可憎之物，并他们木 、 石 、 金 、 银的偶像。
29.en: You saw among them their detestable images and idols of wood and stone, of silver and gold.

29.zh: 惟恐你们中间，或男或女，或族长或支派长，今日心里偏离耶和华 ─ 我们的神，去事奉那些国的神；又怕你们中间有恶根生出苦菜和茵 𫈟 来，
29.en: Make sure there is no man or woman, clan or tribe among you today whose heart turns away from the Lord our God to go and worship the gods of those nations; make sure there is no root among you that produces such bitter poison.

29.zh: 听见这咒诅的话，心里仍是自夸说：我虽然行事心里顽梗，连累众人，却还是平安。
29.en: When such a person hears the words of this oath, he invokes a blessing on himself and therefore thinks, "I will be safe, even though I persist in going my own way." This will bring disaster on the watered land as well as the dry.

29.zh: 耶和华必不饶恕他；耶和华的怒气与愤恨要向他发作，如烟冒出，将这书上所写的一切咒诅都加在他身上。耶和华又要从天下涂抹他的名，
29.en: The Lord will never be willing to forgive him; his wrath and zeal will burn against that man. All the curses written in this book will fall upon him, and the Lord will blot out his name from under heaven.

29.zh: 也必照著写在律法书上 、 约中的一切咒诅将他从以色列众支派中分别出来，使他受祸。
29.en: The Lord will single him out from all the tribes of Israel for disaster, according to all the curses of the covenant written in this Book of the Law.

29.zh: 你们的后代，就是以后兴起来的子孙，和远方来的外人，看见这地的灾殃，并耶和华所降与这地的疾病，
29.en: Your children who follow you in later generations and foreigners who come from distant lands will see the calamities that have fallen on the land and the diseases with which the Lord has afflicted it.

29.zh: 又看见遍地有硫磺，有盐卤，有火迹，没有耕种，没有出产，连草都不生长 ─ 好像耶和华在忿怒中所倾覆的所多玛 、 蛾摩拉 、 押玛 、 洗扁一样 ─
29.en: The whole land will be a burning waste of salt and sulfur-nothing planted, nothing sprouting, no vegetation growing on it. It will be like the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboiim, which the Lord overthrew in fierce anger.

29.zh: 所看见的人，连万国人，都必问说：耶和华为何向此地这样行呢？这样大发烈怒是甚么意思呢？
29.en: All the nations will ask: "Why has the Lord done this to this land? Why this fierce, burning anger?"

29.zh: 人必回答说：是因这地的人离弃了耶和华 ─ 他们列祖的神，领他们出埃及地的时候与他们所立的约，
29.en: And the answer will be: "It is because this people abandoned the covenant of the Lord , the God of their fathers, the covenant he made with them when he brought them out of Egypt.

29.zh: 去事奉敬拜素不认识的别神，是耶和华所未曾给他们安排的。
29.en: They went off and worshiped other gods and bowed down to them, gods they did not know, gods he had not given them.

29.zh: 所以耶和华的怒气向这地发作，将这书上所写的一切咒诅都降在这地上。
29.en: Therefore the Lord 's anger burned against this land, so that he brought on it all the curses written in this book.

29.zh: 耶和华在怒气 、 忿怒 、 大恼恨中将他们从本地拔出来，扔在别的地上，像今日一样。
29.en: In furious anger and in great wrath the Lord uprooted them from their land and thrust them into another land, as it is now."

29.zh: 隐秘的事是属耶和华 ─ 我们神的；惟有明显的事是永远属我们和我们子孙的，好叫我们遵行这律法上的一切话。
29.en: The secret things belong to the Lord our God, but the things revealed belong to us and to our children forever, that we may follow all the words of this law.

30.zh: 我所陈明在你面前的这一切咒诅都临到你身上；你在耶和华 ─ 你神追赶你到的万国中必心里追念祝福的话；
30.en: When all these blessings and curses I have set before you come upon you and you take them to heart wherever the Lord your God disperses you among the nations,

30.zh: 你和你的子孙若尽心尽性归向耶和华 ─ 你的神，照著我今日一切所吩咐的听从他的话；
30.en: and when you and your children return to the Lord your God and obey him with all your heart and with all your soul according to everything I command you today,

30.zh: 那时，耶和华 ─ 你的神必怜恤你，救回你这被掳的子民；耶和华 ─ 你的神要回转过来，从分散你到的万民中将你招聚回来。
30.en: then the Lord your God will restore your fortunes and have compassion on you and gather you again from all the nations where he scattered you.

30.zh: 你被赶散的人，就是在天涯的，耶和华 ─ 你的神也必从那里将你招聚回来。
30.en: Even if you have been banished to the most distant land under the heavens, from there the Lord your God will gather you and bring you back.

30.zh: 耶和华 ─ 你的神必领你进入你列祖所得的地，使你可以得著；又必善待你，使你的人数比你列祖众多。
30.en: He will bring you to the land that belonged to your fathers, and you will take possession of it. He will make you more prosperous and numerous than your fathers.

30.zh: 耶和华 ─ 你神必将你心里和你后裔心里的污秽除掉，好叫你尽心尽性爱耶和华 ─ 你的神，使你可以存活。
30.en: The Lord your God will circumcise your hearts and the hearts of your descendants, so that you may love him with all your heart and with all your soul, and live.

30.zh: 耶和华 ─ 你的神必将这一切咒诅加在你仇敌和恨恶你 、 逼迫你的人身上。
30.en: The Lord your God will put all these curses on your enemies who hate and persecute you.

30.zh: 你必归回，听从耶和华的话，遵行他的一切诫命，就是我今日所吩咐你的。
30.en: You will again obey the Lord and follow all his commands I am giving you today.

30.zh: 你若听从耶和华 ─ 你神的话，谨守这律法书上所写的诫命律例，又尽心尽性归向耶和华 ─ 你的神，他必使你手里所办的一切事，并你身所生的，牲畜所下的，地土所产的，都绰绰有余；因为耶和华必再喜悦你，降福与你，像从前喜悦你列祖一样。
30.en: Then the Lord your God will make you most prosperous in all the work of your hands and in the fruit of your womb, the young of your livestock and the crops of your land. The Lord will again delight in you and make you prosperous, just as he delighted in your fathers,

30.zh: a
30.en: if you obey the Lord your God and keep his commands and decrees that are written in this Book of the Law and turn to the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul. The Offer of Life or Death

30.zh: 我今日所吩咐你的诫命不是你难行的，也不是离你远的；
30.en: Now what I am commanding you today is not too difficult for you or beyond your reach.

30.zh: 不是在天上，使你说：谁替我们上天取下来，使我们听见可以遵行呢？
30.en: It is not up in heaven, so that you have to ask, "Who will ascend into heaven to get it and proclaim it to us so we may obey it?"

30.zh: 也不是在海外，使你说：谁替我们过海取了来，使我们听见可以遵行呢？
30.en: Nor is it beyond the sea, so that you have to ask, "Who will cross the sea to get it and proclaim it to us so we may obey it?"

30.zh: 这话却离你甚近，就在你口中，在你心里，使你可以遵行。
30.en: No, the word is very near you; it is in your mouth and in your heart so you may obey it.

30.zh: 看哪，我今日将生与福，死与祸，陈明在你面前。
30.en: See, I set before you today life and prosperity, death and destruction.

30.zh: 吩咐你爱耶和华 ─ 你的神，遵行他的道，谨守他的诫命 、 律例 、 典章，使你可以存活，人数增多，耶和华 ─ 你神就必在你所要进去得为业的地上赐福与你。
30.en: For I command you today to love the Lord your God, to walk in his ways, and to keep his commands, decrees and laws; then you will live and increase, and the Lord your God will bless you in the land you are entering to possess.

30.zh: 倘若你心里偏离，不肯听从，却被勾引去敬拜事奉别神，
30.en: But if your heart turns away and you are not obedient, and if you are drawn away to bow down to other gods and worship them,

30.zh: 我今日明明告诉你们，你们必要灭亡；在你过约但河 、 进去得为业的地上，你的日子必不长久。
30.en: I declare to you this day that you will certainly be destroyed. You will not live long in the land you are crossing the Jordan to enter and possess.

30.zh: 我今日呼天唤地向你作见证；我将生死祸福陈明在你面前，所以你要拣选生命，使你和你的后裔都得存活；
30.en: This day I call heaven and earth as witnesses against you that I have set before you life and death, blessings and curses. Now choose life, so that you and your children may live

30.zh: 且且爱耶和华 ─ 你的神，听从他的话，专靠他；因为他是你的生命，你的日子长久也在乎他。这样，你就可以在耶和华向你列祖亚伯拉罕 、 以撒 、 雅各起誓应许所赐的地上居住。
30.en: and that you may love the Lord your God, listen to his voice, and hold fast to him. For the Lord is your life, and he will give you many years in the land he swore to give to your fathers, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.

31.zh: 摩西去告诉以色列众人
31.en: Then Moses went out and spokethese words to all Israel:

31.zh: 说：我现在一百二十岁了，不能照常出入；耶和华也曾对我说：你必不得过这约但河。
31.en: "I am now a hundred and twenty years old and I am no longer able to lead you. The Lord has said to me, 'You shall not cross the Jordan.'

31.zh: 耶和华 ─ 你们的神必引导你们过去，将这些国民在你们面前灭绝，你们就得他们的地。约书亚必引导你们过去，正如耶和华所说的。
31.en: The Lord your God himself will cross over ahead of you. He will destroy these nations before you, and you will take possession of their land. Joshua also will cross over ahead of you, as the Lord said.

31.zh: 耶和华必待他们，如同从前待他所灭绝的亚摩利二王西宏与噩以及他们的国一样。
31.en: And the Lord will do to them what he did to Sihon and Og, the kings of the Amorites, whom he destroyed along with their land.

31.zh: 耶和华必将他们交给你们；你们要照我所吩咐的一切命令待他们。
