31.en: The Lord will deliver them to you, and you must do to them all that I have commanded you.

31.zh: 你们当刚强壮胆，不要害怕，也不要畏惧他们，因为耶和华 ─ 你的神和你同去。他必不撇下你，也不丢弃你。
31.en: Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid or terrified because of them, for the Lord your God goes with you; he will never leave you nor forsake you."

31.zh: 摩西召了约书亚来，在以色列众人眼前对他说：你当刚强壮胆！因为，你要和这百姓一同进入耶和华向他们列祖起誓应许所赐之地；你也要使他们承受那地为业。
31.en: Then Moses summoned Joshua and said to him in the presence of all Israel, "Be strong and courageous, for you must go with this people into the land that the Lord swore to their forefathers to give them, and you must divide it among them as their inheritance.

31.zh: 耶和华必在你前面行；他必与你同在，必不撇下你，也不丢弃你。不要惧怕，也不要惊惶。
31.en: The Lord himself goes before you and will be with you; he will never leave you nor forsake you. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged."

31.zh: 摩西将这律法写出来，交给抬耶和华约柜的祭司利未子孙和以色列的众长老。
31.en: So Moses wrote down this law and gave it to the priests, the sons of Levi, who carried the ark of the covenant of the Lord , and to all the elders of Israel.

31.zh: 摩西吩咐他们说：每逢七年的末一年，就在豁免年的定期住棚节的时候，
31.en: Then Moses commanded them: "At the end of every seven years, in the year for canceling debts, during the Feast of Tabernacles,

31.zh: 以色列众人来到耶和华 ─ 你神所选择的地方朝见他。那时，你要在以色列众人面前将这律法念给他们听。
31.en: when all Israel comes to appear before the Lord your God at the place he will choose, you shall read this law before them in their hearing.

31.zh: 要招聚他们男 、 女 、 孩子，并城里寄居的，使他们听，使他们学习，好敬畏耶和华 ─ 你们的神，谨守 、 遵行这律法的一切话，
31.en: Assemble the people-men, women and children, and the aliens living in your towns-so they can listen and learn to fear the Lord your God and follow carefully all the words of this law.

31.zh: 也使他们未曾晓得这律法的儿女得以听见，学习敬畏耶和华 ─ 你们的神，在你们过约但河要得为业之地，存活的日子，常常这样行。
31.en: Their children, who do not know this law, must hear it and learn to fear the Lord your God as long as you live in the land you are crossing the Jordan to possess."

31.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：你的死期临近了；要召约书亚来，你们二人站在会幕里，我好嘱咐他。于是摩西和约书亚去站在会幕里。
31.en: The Lord said to Moses, "Now the day of your death is near. Call Joshua and present yourselves at the Tent of Meeting, where I will commission him." So Moses and Joshua came and presented themselves at the Tent of Meeting.

31.zh: 耶和华在会幕里云柱中显现，云柱停在会幕门以上。
31.en: Then the Lord appeared at the Tent in a pillar of cloud, and the cloud stood over the entrance to the Tent.

31.zh: 耶和华又对摩西说：你必和你列祖同睡。这百姓要起来，在他们所要去的地上，在那地的人中，随从外邦神行邪淫，离弃我，违背我与他们所立的约。
31.en: And the Lord said to Moses: "You are going to rest with your fathers, and these people will soon prostitute themselves to the foreign gods of the land they are entering. They will forsake me and break the covenant I made with them.

31.zh: 那时，我的怒气必向他们发作；我也必离弃他们，掩面不顾他们，以致他们被吞灭，并有许多的祸患灾难临到他们。那日他们必说：这些祸患临到我们，岂不是因我们的神不在我们中间么？
31.en: On that day I will become angry with them and forsake them; I will hide my face from them, and they will be destroyed. Many disasters and difficulties will come upon them, and on that day they will ask, 'Have not these disasters come upon us because our God is not with us?'

31.zh: 那时，因他们偏向别神所行的一切恶，我必定掩面不顾他们。
31.en: And I will certainly hide my face on that day because of all their wickedness in turning to other gods.

31.zh: 现在你要写一篇歌，教导以色列人，传给他们，使这歌见证他们的不是；
31.en: "Now write down for yourselves this song and teach it to the Israelites and have them sing it, so that it may be a witness for me against them.

31.zh: 因为我将他们领进我向他们列祖起誓应许那流奶与蜜之地，他们在那里吃得饱足，身体肥胖，就必偏向别神，事奉他们，藐视我，背弃我的约。
31.en: When I have brought them into the land flowing with milk and honey, the land I promised on oath to their forefathers, and when they eat their fill and thrive, they will turn to other gods and worship them, rejecting me and breaking my covenant.

31.zh: 那时，有许多祸患灾难临到他们，这歌必在他们面前作见证，他们后裔的口中必念诵不忘。我未领他们到我所起誓应许之地以先，他们所怀的意念我都知道了。
31.en: And when many disasters and difficulties come upon them, this song will testify against them, because it will not be forgotten by their descendants. I know what they are disposed to do, even before I bring them into the land I promised them on oath."

31.zh: 当日摩西就写了一篇歌，教导以色列人。
31.en: So Moses wrote down this song that day and taught it to the Israelites.

31.zh: 耶和华嘱咐嫩的儿子约书亚说：你当刚强壮胆，因为你必领以色列人进我所起誓应许他们的地；我必与你同在。
31.en: The Lord gave this command to Joshua son of Nun: "Be strong and courageous, for you will bring the Israelites into the land I promised them on oath, and I myself will be with you."

31.zh: 摩西将这律法的话写在书上，及至写完了，
31.en: After Moses finished writing in a book the words of this law from beginning to end,

31.zh: 就吩咐抬耶和华约柜的利未人说：
31.en: he gave this command to the Levites who carried the ark of the covenant of the Lord :

31.zh: 将这律法书放在耶和华 ─ 你们神的约柜旁，可以在那里见证以色列人的不是；
31.en: "Take this Book of the Law and place it beside the ark of the covenant of the Lord your God. There it will remain as a witness against you.

31.zh: 因为我知道你们是悖逆的，是硬著颈项的。我今日还活著与你们同在，你们尚且悖逆耶和华，何况我死后呢？
31.en: For I know how rebellious and stiff-necked you are. If you have been rebellious against the Lord while I am still alive and with you, how much more will you rebel after I die!

31.zh: 你们要将你们支派的众长老和官长都招聚了来，我好将这些话说与他们听，并呼天唤地见证他们的不是。
31.en: Assemble before me all the elders of your tribes and all your officials, so that I can speak these words in their hearing and call heaven and earth to testify against them.

31.zh: 我知道我死后，你们必全然败坏，偏离我所吩咐你们的道，行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，以手所做的惹他发怒；日后必有祸患临到你们。
31.en: For I know that after my death you are sure to become utterly corrupt and to turn from the way I have commanded you. In days to come, disaster will fall upon you because you will do evil in the sight of the Lord and provoke him to anger by what your hands have made."

31.zh: 摩西将这一篇歌的话都说与以色列全会众听。
31.en: And Moses recited the words of this song from beginning to end in the hearing of the whole assembly of Israel:

32.zh: 诸天哪，侧耳，我要说话；愿地也听我口中的言语。
32.en: Listen, O heavens, and I will speak; hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.

32.zh: 我的教训要淋漓如雨；我的言语要滴落如露，如细雨降在嫩草上，如甘霖降在菜蔬中。
32.en: Let my teaching fall like rain and my words descend like dew, like showers on new grass, like abundant rain on tender plants.

32.zh: 我要宣告耶和华的名；你们要将大德归与我们的神。
32.en: I will proclaim the name of the Lord . Oh, praise the greatness of our God!

32.zh: 他是磐石，他的作为完全；他所行的无不公平，是诚实无伪的神，又公义，又正直。
32.en: He is the Rock, his works are perfect, and all his ways are just. A faithful God who does no wrong, upright and just is he.

32.zh: 这乖僻弯曲的世代向他行事邪僻；有这弊病就不是他的儿女。
32.en: They have acted corruptly toward him; to their shame they are no longer his children, but a warped and crooked generation.

32.zh: 愚昧无知的民哪，你们这样报答耶和华么？他岂不是你的父 、 将你买来的么？他是制造你 、 建立你的。
32.en: Is this the way you repay the Lord , O foolish and unwise people? Is he not your Father, your Creator, who made you and formed you?

32.zh: 你当追想上古之日，思念历代之年；问你的父亲，他必指示你；问你的长者，他必告诉你。
32.en: Remember the days of old; consider the generations long past. Ask your father and he will tell you, your elders, and they will explain to you.

32.zh: 至高者将地业赐给列邦，将世人分开，就照以色列人的数目立定万民的疆界。
32.en: When the Most High gave the nations their inheritance, when he divided all mankind, he set up boundaries for the peoples according to the number of the sons of Israel.

32.zh: 耶和华的分本是他的百姓；他的产业本是雅各。
32.en: For the Lord 's portion is his people, Jacob his allotted inheritance.

32.zh: 耶和华遇见他在旷野 ─ 荒凉野兽吼叫之地，就环绕他，看顾他，保护他，如同保护眼中的瞳人。
32.en: In a desert land he found him, in a barren and howling waste. He shielded him and cared for him; he guarded him as the apple of his eye,

32.zh: 又如鹰搅动巢窝，在雏鹰以上两翅搧展，接取雏鹰，背在两翼之上。
32.en: like an eagle that stirs up its nest and hovers over its young, that spreads its wings to catch them and carries them on its pinions.

32.zh: 这样，耶和华独自引导他，并无外邦神与他同在。
32.en: The Lord alone led him; no foreign god was with him.

32.zh: 耶和华使他乘驾地的高处，得吃田间的土产；又使他从磐石中咂蜜，从坚石中吸油；
32.en: He made him ride on the heights of the land and fed him with the fruit of the fields. He nourished him with honey from the rock, and with oil from the flinty crag,

32.zh: 也吃牛的奶油，羊的奶，羊羔的脂油，巴珊所出的公绵羊和山羊，与上好的麦子，也喝葡萄汁酿的酒。
32.en: with curds and milk from herd and flock and with fattened lambs and goats, with choice rams of Bashan and the finest kernels of wheat. You drank the foaming blood of the grape.

32.zh: 但耶书仑渐渐肥胖，粗壮，光润，踢跳，奔跑，便离弃造他的神，轻看救他的磐石；
32.en: Jeshurun grew fat and kicked; filled with food, he became heavy and sleek. He abandoned the God who made him and rejected the Rock his Savior.

32.zh: 敬拜别神，触动神的愤恨，行可憎恶的事，惹了他的怒气。
32.en: They made him jealous with their foreign gods and angered him with their detestable idols.

32.zh: 所祭祀的鬼魔并非真神，乃是素不认识的神，是近来新兴的，是你列祖所不畏惧的。
32.en: They sacrificed to demons, which are not God- gods they had not known, gods that recently appeared, gods your fathers did not fear.

32.zh: 你轻忽生你的磐石，忘记产你的神。
32.en: You deserted the Rock, who fathered you; you forgot the God who gave you birth.

32.zh: 耶和华看见他的儿女惹动他，就厌恶他们，说：
32.en: The Lord saw this and rejected them because he was angered by his sons and daughters.

32.zh: 我要向他们掩面，看他们的结局如何。他们本是极乖僻的族类，心中无诚实的儿女。
32.en: "I will hide my face from them," he said, "and see what their end will be; for they are a perverse generation, children who are unfaithful.

32.zh: 他们以那不算为神的触动我的愤恨，以虚无的神惹了我的怒气。我也要以那不成子民的触动他们的愤恨，以愚昧的国民惹了他们的怒气。
32.en: They made me jealous by what is no god and angered me with their worthless idols. I will make them envious by those who are not a people; I will make them angry by a nation that has no understanding.

32.zh: 因为在我怒中有火烧起，直烧到极深的阴间，把地和地的出产尽都焚烧，山的根基也烧著了。
32.en: For a fire has been kindled by my wrath, one that burns to the realm of death below. It will devour the earth and its harvests and set afire the foundations of the mountains.

32.zh: 我要将祸患堆在他们身上，把我的箭向他们射尽。
32.en: "I will heap calamities upon them and spend my arrows against them.

32.zh: 他们必因饥饿消瘦，被炎热苦毒吞灭。我要打发野兽用牙齿咬他们，并土中腹行的，用毒气害他们。
32.en: I will send wasting famine against them, consuming pestilence and deadly plague; I will send against them the fangs of wild beasts, the venom of vipers that glide in the dust.

32.zh: 外头有刀剑，内室有惊恐，使人丧亡，使少男 、 童女 、 吃奶的 、 白发的，尽都灭绝。
32.en: In the street the sword will make them childless; in their homes terror will reign. Young men and young women will perish, infants and gray-haired men.

32.zh: 我说，我必将他们分散远方，使他们的名号从人间除灭。
32.en: I said I would scatter them and blot out their memory from mankind,

32.zh: 惟恐仇敌惹动我，只怕敌人错看，说：是我们手的能力，并非耶和华所行的。
32.en: but I dreaded the taunt of the enemy, lest the adversary misunderstand and say, 'Our hand has triumphed; the Lord has not done all this.' "

32.zh: 因为以色列民毫无计谋，心中没有聪明。
32.en: They are a nation without sense, there is no discernment in them.

32.zh: 惟愿他们有智慧，能明白这事，肯思念他们的结局。
32.en: If only they were wise and would understand this and discern what their end will be!

32.zh: 若不是他们的磐石卖了他们，若不是耶和华交出他们，一人焉能追赶他们千人？二人焉能使万人逃跑呢？
32.en: How could one man chase a thousand, or two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, unless the Lord had given them up?

32.zh: 据我们的仇敌自己断定，他们的磐石不如我们的磐石。
32.en: For their rock is not like our Rock, as even our enemies concede.

32.zh: 他们的葡萄树是所多玛的葡萄树，蛾摩拉田园所生的；他们的葡萄是毒葡萄，全挂都是苦的。
32.en: Their vine comes from the vine of Sodom and from the fields of Gomorrah. Their grapes are filled with poison, and their clusters with bitterness.

32.zh: 他们的酒是大蛇的毒气，是虺蛇残害的恶毒。
32.en: Their wine is the venom of serpents, the deadly poison of cobras.

32.zh: 这不都是积蓄在我这里，封锁在我府库中么？
32.en: "Have I not kept this in reserve and sealed it in my vaults?

32.zh: 他们失脚的时候，伸冤报应在我；因他们遭灾的日子近了；那要临在他们身上的必速速来到。
32.en: It is mine to avenge; I will repay. In due time their foot will slip; their day of disaster is near and their doom rushes upon them."

32.zh: 耶和华见他百姓毫无能力，无论困住的 、 自由的都没有剩下，就必为他们伸冤，为他的仆人后悔。
32.en: The Lord will judge his people and have compassion on his servants when he sees their strength is gone and no one is left, slave or free.

32.zh: 他必说：他们的神，他们所投靠的磐石，
32.en: He will say: "Now where are their gods, the rock they took refuge in,

32.zh: 就是向来吃他们祭牲的脂油，喝他们奠祭之酒的，在那里呢？他可以兴起帮助你们，护卫你们。
32.en: the gods who ate the fat of their sacrifices and drank the wine of their drink offerings? Let them rise up to help you! Let them give you shelter!

32.zh: 你们如今要知道：我，惟有我是神；在我以外并无别神。我使人死，我使人活；我损伤，我也医治，并无人能从我手中救出来。
32.en: "See now that I myself am He! There is no god besides me. I put to death and I bring to life, I have wounded and I will heal, and no one can deliver out of my hand.

32.zh: 我向天举手说：我凭我的永生起誓：
32.en: I lift my hand to heaven and declare: As surely as I live forever,

32.zh: 我若磨我闪亮的刀，手掌审判之权，就必报复我的敌人，报应恨我的人。
32.en: when I sharpen my flashing sword and my hand grasps it in judgment, I will take vengeance on my adversaries and repay those who hate me.

32.zh: 我要使我的箭饮血饮醉，就是被杀被掳之人的血。我的刀要吃肉，乃是仇敌中首领之头的肉。
32.en: I will make my arrows drunk with blood, while my sword devours flesh: the blood of the slain and the captives, the heads of the enemy leaders."

32.zh: 你们外邦人当与主的百姓一同欢呼；因他要伸他仆人流血的冤，报应他的敌人，洁净他的地，救赎他的百姓。
32.en: Rejoice, O nations, with his people, , for he will avenge the blood of his servants; he will take vengeance on his enemies and make atonement for his land and people.

32.zh: 摩西和嫩的儿子约书亚去将这歌的一切话说给百姓听。
32.en: Moses came with Joshua son of Nun and spoke all the words of this song in the hearing of the people.

32.zh: 摩西向以色列众人说完了这一切的话，
32.en: When Moses finished reciting all these words to all Israel,

32.zh: 又说：我今日所警教你们的，你们都要放在心上；要吩咐你们的子孙谨守遵行这律法上的话。
32.en: he said to them, "Take to heart all the words I have solemnly declared to you this day, so that you may command your children to obey carefully all the words of this law.

32.zh: 因为这不是虚空 、 与你们无关的事，乃是你们的生命；在你们过约但河要得为业的地上必因这事日子得以长久。
32.en: They are not just idle words for you-they are your life. By them you will live long in the land you are crossing the Jordan to possess."

32.zh: 当日，耶和华吩咐摩西说：
32.en: On that same day the Lord told Moses,

32.zh: 你上这亚巴琳山中的尼波山去，在摩押地与耶利哥相对，观看我所要赐给以色列人为业的迦南地。
32.en: "Go up into the Abarim Range to Mount Nebo in Moab, across from Jericho, and view Canaan, the land I am giving the Israelites as their own possession.

32.zh: 你必死在你所登的山上，归你列祖（原文作本民）去，像你哥哥亚伦死在何珥山上，归他的列祖一样。
32.en: There on the mountain that you have climbed you will die and be gathered to your people, just as your brother Aaron died on Mount Hor and was gathered to his people.

32.zh: 因为你们在寻的旷野，加低斯的米利巴水，在以色列人中没有尊我为圣，得罪了我。
32.en: This is because both of you broke faith with me in the presence of the Israelites at the waters of Meribah Kadesh in the Desert of Zin and because you did not uphold my holiness among the Israelites.

32.zh: 我所赐给以色列人的地，你可以远远地观看，却不得进去。
32.en: Therefore, you will see the land only from a distance; you will not enter the land I am giving to the people of Israel."

33.zh: 以下是神人摩西在未死之先为以色列人所祝的福：
33.en: This is the blessing that Moses the man of God pronounced on the Israelites before his death.

33.zh: 他说：耶和华从西乃而来，从西珥向他们显现，从巴兰山发出光辉，从万万圣者中来临，从他右手为百姓传出烈火的律法。
33.en: He said: "The Lord came from Sinai and dawned over them from Seir; he shone forth from Mount Paran. He came with myriads of holy ones from the south, from his mountain slopes.

33.zh: 他疼爱百姓；众圣徒都在他手中。他们坐在他的脚下，领受他的言语。
33.en: Surely it is you who love the people; all the holy ones are in your hand. At your feet they all bow down, and from you receive instruction,

33.zh: 摩西将律法传给我们，作为雅各会众的产业。
33.en: the law that Moses gave us, the possession of the assembly of Jacob.

33.zh: 百姓的众首领，以色列的各支派，一同聚会的时候，耶和华（原文作他）在耶书仑中为王。
33.en: He was king over Jeshurun when the leaders of the people assembled, along with the tribes of Israel.

33.zh: 愿流便存活，不至死亡；愿他人数不致稀少。
33.en: "Let Reuben live and not die, nor his men be few."

33.zh: 为犹大祝福说：求耶和华俯听犹大的声音，引导他归于本族；他曾用手为自己争战，你必帮助他攻击敌人。
33.en: And this he said about Judah: "Hear, O Lord , the cry of Judah; bring him to his people. With his own hands he defends his cause. Oh, be his help against his foes!"

33.zh: 论利未说：耶和华阿，你的土明和乌陵都在你的虔诚人那里。你在玛撒曾试验他，在米利巴水与他争论。
33.en: About Levi he said: "Your Thummim and Urim belong to the man you favored. You tested him at Massah; you contended with him at the waters of Meribah.

33.zh: 他论自己的父母说：我未曾看见；他也不承认弟兄，也不认识自己的儿女。这是因利未人遵行你的话，谨守你的约。
33.en: He said of his father and mother, 'I have no regard for them.' He did not recognize his brothers or acknowledge his own children, but he watched over your word and guarded your covenant.

33.zh: 他们要将你的典章教训雅各，将你的律法教训以色列。他们要把香焚在你面前，把全牲的燔祭献在你的坛上。
33.en: He teaches your precepts to Jacob and your law to Israel. He offers incense before you and whole burnt offerings on your altar.

33.zh: 求耶和华降福在他的财物上，悦纳他手里所办的事。那些起来攻击他和恨恶他的人，愿你刺透他们的腰，使他们不得再起来。
33.en: Bless all his skills, O Lord , and be pleased with the work of his hands. Smite the loins of those who rise up against him; strike his foes till they rise no more."

33.zh: 论便雅悯说：耶和华所亲爱的必同耶和华安然居住；耶和华终日遮蔽他，也住在他两肩之中。
33.en: About Benjamin he said: "Let the beloved of the Lord rest secure in him, for he shields him all day long, and the one the Lord loves rests between his shoulders."

33.zh: 论约瑟说：愿他的地蒙耶和华赐福，得天上的宝物 、 甘露，以及地里所藏的泉水；
33.en: About Joseph he said: "May the Lord bless his land with the precious dew from heaven above and with the deep waters that lie below;

33.zh: 得太阳所晒熟的美果，月亮所养成的宝物；
33.en: with the best the sun brings forth and the finest the moon can yield;

33.zh: 得上古之山的至宝，永世之岭的宝物；
33.en: with the choicest gifts of the ancient mountains and the fruitfulness of the everlasting hills;

33.zh: 得地和其中所充满的宝物，并住荆棘中上主的喜悦。愿这些福都归于约瑟的头上，归于那与弟兄迥别之人的顶上。
33.en: with the best gifts of the earth and its fullness and the favor of him who dwelt in the burning bush. Let all these rest on the head of Joseph, on the brow of the prince among his brothers.

33.zh: 他为牛群中头生的，有威严；他的角是野牛的角，用以抵触万邦，直到地极。这角是以法莲的万万，玛拿西的千千。
33.en: In majesty he is like a firstborn bull; his horns are the horns of a wild ox. With them he will gore the nations, even those at the ends of the earth. Such are the ten thousands of Ephraim; such are the thousands of Manasseh."

33.zh: 论西布伦说：西布伦哪，你出外可以欢喜。以萨迦阿，在你帐棚里可以快乐。
33.en: About Zebulun he said: "Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out, and you, Issachar, in your tents.

33.zh: 他们要将列邦召到山上，在那里献公义的祭；因为他们要吸取海里的丰富，并沙中所藏的珍宝。
33.en: They will summon peoples to the mountain and there offer sacrifices of righteousness; they will feast on the abundance of the seas, on the treasures hidden in the sand."

33.zh: 论迦得说：使迦得扩张的应当称颂！迦得住如母狮；他撕裂膀臂，连头顶也撕裂。
33.en: About Gad he said: "Blessed is he who enlarges Gad's domain! Gad lives there like a lion, tearing at arm or head.

33.zh: 他为自己选择头一段地，因在那里有设立律法者的分存留。他与百姓的首领同来；他施行耶和华的公义和耶和华与以色列所立的典章。
33.en: He chose the best land for himself; the leader's portion was kept for him. When the heads of the people assembled, he carried out the Lord 's righteous will, and his judgments concerning Israel."

33.zh: 论但说：但为小狮子，从巴珊跳出来。
33.en: About Dan he said: "Dan is a lion's cub, springing out of Bashan."

33.zh: 论拿弗他利说：拿弗他利阿，你足沾恩惠，满得耶和华的福，可以得西方和南方为业。
33.en: About Naphtali he said: "Naphtali is abounding with the favor of the Lord and is full of his blessing; he will inherit southward to the lake."

33.zh: 论亚设说：愿亚设享受多子的福乐，得他弟兄的喜悦，可以把脚蘸在油中。
33.en: About Asher he said: "Most blessed of sons is Asher; let him be favored by his brothers, and let him bathe his feet in oil.

33.zh: 你的门闩（门闩或作：鞋）是铜的，铁的。你的日子如何，你的力量也必如何。
33.en: The bolts of your gates will be iron and bronze, and your strength will equal your days.

33.zh: 耶书仑哪，没有能比神的。他为帮助你，乘在天空，显其威荣，驾行穹苍。
33.en: "There is no one like the God of Jeshurun, who rides on the heavens to help you and on the clouds in his majesty.

33.zh: 永生的神是你的居所；他永久的膀臂在你以下。他在你前面撵出仇敌，说：毁灭罢。
33.en: The eternal God is your refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms. He will drive out your enemy before you, saying, 'Destroy him!'

33.zh: 以色列安然居住；雅各的本源独居五谷新酒之地。他的天也滴甘露。
33.en: So Israel will live in safety alone; Jacob's spring is secure in a land of grain and new wine, where the heavens drop dew.

33.zh: 以色列阿，你是有福的！谁像你这蒙耶和华所拯救的百姓呢？他是你的盾牌，帮助你，是你威荣的刀剑。你的仇敌必投降你；你必踏在他们的高处。
33.en: Blessed are you, O Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by the Lord ? He is your shield and helper and your glorious sword. Your enemies will cower before you, and you will trample down their high places. "

34.zh: 摩西从摩押平原登尼波山，上了那与耶利哥相对的毘斯迦山顶。耶和华把基列全地直到但，
34.en: Then Moses climbed Mount Nebo from the plains of Moab to the top of Pisgah, across from Jericho. There the Lord showed him the whole land-from Gilead to Dan,

34.zh: 拿弗他利全地，以法莲 、 玛拿西的地，犹大全地直到西海，
34.en: all of Naphtali, the territory of Ephraim and Manasseh, all the land of Judah as far as the western sea,

34.zh: 南地和棕树城耶利哥的平原，直到琐珥，都指给他看。
34.en: the Negev and the whole region from the Valley of Jericho, the City of Palms, as far as Zoar.

34.zh: 耶和华对他说：这就是我向亚伯拉罕 、 以撒 、 雅各起誓应许之地，说：我必将这地赐给你的后裔。现在我使你眼睛看见了，你却不得过到那里去。
34.en: Then the Lord said to him, "This is the land I promised on oath to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob when I said, 'I will give it to your descendants.' I have let you see it with your eyes, but you will not cross over into it."

34.zh: 于是，耶和华的仆人摩西死在摩押地，正如耶和华所说的。
34.en: And Moses the servant of the Lord died there in Moab, as the Lord had said.

34.zh: 耶和华将他埋葬在摩押地 、 伯毘珥对面的谷中，只是到今日没有人知道他的坟墓。
34.en: He buried him in Moab, in the valley opposite Beth Peor, but to this day no one knows where his grave is.

34.zh: 摩西死的时候年一百二十岁；眼目没有昏花，精神没有衰败。
34.en: Moses was a hundred and twenty years old when he died, yet his eyes were not weak nor his strength gone.

34.zh: 以色列人在摩押平原为摩西哀哭了三十日，为摩西居丧哀哭的日子就满了。
34.en: The Israelites grieved for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days, until the time of weeping and mourning was over.

34.zh: 嫩的儿子约书亚；因为摩西曾按手在他头上，就被智慧的灵充满，以色列人便听从他，照著耶和华吩咐摩西的行了。
34.en: Now Joshua son of Nun was filled with the spirit of wisdom because Moses had laid his hands on him. So the Israelites listened to him and did what the Lord had commanded Moses.

34.zh: 以后以色列中再没有兴起先知像摩西的。他是耶和华面对面所认识的。
34.en: Since then, no prophet has risen in Israel like Moses, whom the Lord knew face to face,

34.zh: 耶和华打发他在埃及地向法老和他的一切臣仆，并他的全地，行各样神迹奇事，
34.en: who did all those miraculous signs and wonders the Lord sent him to do in Egypt- to Pharaoh and to all his officials and to his whole land.

34.zh: 又在以色列 . 众人眼前显大能的手，行一切大而可畏的事。
